Volume_Info: 慶長十年、／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）、足利學ノ三要（閑室元佶）ニ　旨有リテ印行令メラルヽ、活字版ノ一也。其始末、孔子家語ノ條ニ詳ナリ。鹿苑ノ（西笑）承兌カ跋ニ云、頃蒙／（双擡）大將軍〈御諱〉公鈞命印行周易、其志要弘聖道於萬年トアリ。此本／（双擡）有德大君（德川吉宗）御前ニ置レシヲ、後御小納戸ヨリ御庫ニ移サル。是ヨリ後、享保中、御小納戸ヨリ出ルト云モノ、皆コノ類也。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、昆陽漫錄〈靑木文藏敦＊著ス。〉ニ、慶長官刻ノ家語、易經ヲ得テ官ニ上ルト云ヘルハ、則此書ナルヘシ。一タヒ官ニ逸セシヲ、靑木文藏是ヲ獻シテ、再ヒ其舊ヲ補フモノナリ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ ("Respectfully, I note / on humble consideration:")
- 昆陽漫錄〈靑木文藏敦著ス。〉ニ ("In the *Kon'yō Manroku* [written by Aoki Bunzō, personal name Atsushi],")
- 慶長官刻ノ家語、易經ヲ得テ官ニ上ルト云ヘルハ ("the statement that he obtained the Keichō-era officially printed *Kago* [Confucian Family Sayings] and *Ekikyō* [Book of Changes] and submitted them to the government,")
- 則此書ナルヘシ ("must precisely be this very book.")
- 一タヒ官ニ逸セシヲ ("Having once been lost to the government [i.e., dropped out of the official collection],")
- 靑木文藏是ヲ獻シテ ("Aoki Bunzō presented this [copy],")
- 再ヒ其舊ヲ補フモノナリ ("and it is a thing that once more made up for / restored what had formerly been [there].")
Summary:
The annotator identifies this volume as the Keichō-era official-print text that Aoki Bunzō (Konyō) is said to have obtained and presented to the shogunal government, thereby restoring a copy that had earlier dropped out of the official collection.

Volume_Info: 北宋槧本。端洪元年秦奭等カ表文アリ。廟諱ノ字缺筆セリ。密行疏字、字格楷正ナリ。卷三、卷四、卷六、卷十一ニ、僧圓種朱點ヲ加ル識語アリ。其卷六ニ、嘉元二年甲辰卯月二十二日、拭老眼粗加朱點畢、佛子圓種流年六旬ト記セリ。餘卷點ヲ施サス。　本邦ニ傳リテ尙五百年ノ書也。久シク散落シテ殘闕セシカ、各所ノ寺院、民家等ヨリ出ルヲ聚テ全本トス。林大學頭衡（述齋）獻言シ、享和三年二月、御庫ニ收ム。金澤文庫ノ印記アリ。歸源ノ印記、鎌倉圓光寺＊ノ子院、歸源院ノ藏印ナリ。此書、舊ト金澤文庫ヨリ散シテ浮屠氏ノ收藏トナリシニヤ、亦浮屠氏ノ本金澤ニ入レルニヤ、共ニ知ルヘカラス。金澤文庫ノ印記、各卷ニ散見ス。是ヨリ後、金澤文庫本ト云モノ、復印記ヲ錄セス。餘コレニ倣フ。

元板古譯本ナリ。板刻ノ年月ヲ錄セス。紙墨字樣ヲ撿スルニ、斷然トシテ元槧ナリ。首ニ林希逸カ序、遠甫カ手帖、嚴粲カ自序アリ。又淸濁音圖ノ末ニ、余氏栞于家塾ノ七（＊六）字、目錄ノ終ニ、勤有書堂刻梓ノ六字アリ。卷十六ノ後ニ、余志安刊于家塾ノ字アリ。元人余志安カ塾刊本ナリ。弱水三萬里ノ印記、各卷ニ散見ス。何人ノ鑑藏ナルヲ詳ニセス。淸ノ天祿琳琅書目ニ、詩緝三種ヲ收ム。皆宋板中ニ入ル。實ハ明ノ趙厚煜＊カ居敬堂ニ刊スルノ本ナリ。然レハ元槧ノ者、旣ニ彼邦ニ絶タルコト、知ル可シ。亦珍ナラスヤ。此書、嘗テ毛利伊勢守高標カ收藏トナリ、後其孫出雲守高翰カ獻スル所ナリ。餘出雲守獻本中ノ一ト謂モノ、皆此類ナリ。
韓板ニシテ、卷首副葉ニ、萬曆十五年二月日、內賜行同知中樞府事尹卓然詩傳一件、命除謝恩、右承旨臣鄭押字トアリ。又宣賜之記ノ印記アリ。コレ韓ノ臣下ニ賜フ者ナリ。是ヨリ後、韓ノ內賜本ト云モノ、印記ヲ著サス。餘コレニ倣フ。

韓板活字ナリ。此書、慶長十九年七月／（双擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ヨリ、成瀨（正武）豐後守ヲシテ駿府ニ赴カシメ、／御起居ヲ候セラレシ時ニ、／（双擡）東照大君ヨリ、御書籍三十種ヲ／（双擡）台德大君ヘ　賜ハル。後／（双擡）台德大君、御判書ヲ以テ、駿府ノ老臣本多上野介（正純）ヘ　謝シタマフ。其時、駿府ヨリ副スル所ノ書目及ヒ書簡、皆與安法印宗哲ト、林道春（羅山）ト、二人ノ名ヲ書ス。又關東ヨリ土井（利勝）大炊頭カ、宗哲、道春ヘ贈レル書竝ニ、閑齋、永喜（林東舟）ヨリ兩人ヘノ返簡アリ。其判書及ヒ往復ノ書、久シク林大學頭ノ家ニ傳シヲ、今ノ林衡ニ至リテ、　呈上シテ覽ニ備フ。寬政十年九月、奉行ニ　命シテ糺サレシニ、三十種ノ中二十二種、尙ヲ御庫ニ現存セリ。此本亦其一ナリ。後慶長賜本ノ一ト記セルハ、皆是ヲ謂フナリ。

淸原秀賢、宋板ヲ影寫セルナリ。卷二十二ノ後ニ、右一策防州山口神光寺住僧果明、在洛閒雇筆了、慶長四年仲春吏部淸原押字ト記セリ。又卷三十九ノ後ニ、右一册以／（双擡）內府〈御諱〉公ノ本、課朝鮮文士鄭鴻業令謄寫者也、于時文祿三年戊戌臘月吏部秀賢ト記セリ。每卷、淸原宣賢、淸門之統學、安太史平叔、司天臺、松本氏圖書記等ノ印記アリ。此書、舊ト淸家ノ藏本ナリシカ、後轉シテ、安部家＊ノ收藏トナル。松本氏、其人ヲ考ヘス。秀賢ハ、船橋式部太輔＊、宣賢ハ、其子大炊助（秀雄）ナリ。慶長十九年九月七日、宣賢駿府ニ於テ始メテ／（双擡）神祖（德川家康）ニ見エ奉リ、父秀賢カ遺物トシテ三代實錄五十卷ヲ獻スト、駿府記ニ見エタルハ、卽此人ナリ。此書、久シク民閒ニ散シ書賈ノ手ニ落タルヲ、／（双擡）神祖ノ御本ヲ謄寫ストアルヲ以テ、今其原本ノ御庫ニ佚スルカ爲ニ、林衡建言シテ、享和二年七月、收ム。
元天曆二年ノ刊本ニシテ、古譯アリ。每册首後ノ印記、辨スヘカラス。
宋板ニシテ、金澤文庫ノ印記及ヒ古譯アリ。宋嘉定丙子興國軍ノ學ニ刊スル所也。紙質堅固ニシテ、字マタ鮮明ナリ。明祝允明カ家藏ノ印記アリ。餘印、其人ヲ詳ニセス。金澤文庫、祝氏ノ二印、篆刻雅ナラス。今定テ贋造トス。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
北宋槧本ニシテ、板鋟ノ年月ヲ記サス。撫刻極テ精シ。金澤文庫ノ收藏ナリ。宋欽宗以上ノ諱字、廟諱皆闕筆セリ。檇李顧煕雝藏書ノ印記アリ。又支干ヲ印セリ。蓋シ逐年聚貯ノモノナルヘシ。顧煕雝、其人ヲ詳ニセス。
元板。古譯本ナリ。卷首ニ、富沙碧灣吳氏德新堂印行トアリ。卷上ノ後ニ、至元歳次丁丑菊節德新堂印トアリ。蓋至元三年刊行、元初ノ本ナリ。首附禮部牒文及ヒ中書ノ牒文、蒙古ノ字ヲ以テ各名氏ヲ記セリ。卷上ノ後ニ、天文九年庚子秋七月二十一日、乾三叟守棱漫加朱、卷下ニ、九月二十二日加朱トアリ。又文博士淸原押字ト記セリ。每卷ノ後ニ、國賢ノ印記アリ。淸原國賢カ藏本ナリ。又每卷東字ノ印アリ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。

明人姜立綱書本ニシテ、東宮進讀本也。此書、紙質絶美、四旁寬大ニシテ、字大サ寸餘、墨色鮮新、王世貞、趙用賢カ跋アリ。趙カ跋ニ、張幼于カ藏スル所ト云フ。又王泰吉ノ印記アリ。後散シテ、張氏、王氏ノ藏書トナル。泰吉、其人ヲ考ヘス。世貞跋曰、故姜太僕立綱書、此四子全文句讀、各有圏甚精、當是先朝春宮進讀書本也、結法圓熟端勁、妙不可言、初見絶以爲沈度學士書、徐覺其波磔處小露鋒鎩、乃敢定爲姜筆、噫嘻、兩制諸君不復能辨此矣、吳郡王世貞題。又用賢跋曰、語孟中庸大學、今世誦習徧天下、然善本亦不易得、當披玩常、則精好難繼、學者不無臨文之嘆、此帙乃張幼于所藏、弇山先生鑑定以爲姜太僕筆、姜書法出沈學士度、爲本朝兩制、楷則或病其體多同、而格力不揚、然是書頗病譌僞、太常此本、如宿學老儒、雖姿字不至峻茂、而嚴正可畏、一展卷閒、令人神暢義融、法言琅琅、若聖賢在目、余謬以爲唯與太常書、爲合作耳、吳郡趙用賢謹識トアリ。
姜立綱、字廷憲。瑞安人。七歳以能書命翰林院秀才。天順中授中書舎人、歷官大常少卿。善楷書〈書史會要〉。
王世貞、字元美。太倉人。嘉靖二十六年進士、授刑部主事。萬曆中爲南京刑部尙書。贈太子少保〈明史〉。
趙用賢、字汝師。常熟人。隆慶五年進士、選庶吉士、擢南京禮部右侍郞。天啓初贈太子少保、禮部尙書〈明史〉。
張幼于、名獻翼。長洲人。年十六以詩贄文徵明。徵明語其徒陸子傳曰、吾與倶弗及也。獻翼好易、十年中箋注三易。晩年與王穉登爭不能勝、頽然自放〈蘇州府志〉。
元至正年閒ノ重鋟本ニシテ、撫印極メテ精シ。蓋シ初印ノ本ナリ。紙墨トモニ精潔、元槧中ノ善本ナリ。卷一ノ後ニ、至正乙未仲夏日新書堂重刊トアリ。原本ハ宋紹興三十年毛光＊撰刻ノ本ナリ。高平隆長印記、其人ヲ考ヘス。

明萬曆板ニシテ、明歸化人戴笠ノ藏書ナリ。每卷、觀道人、戴觀胤字子辰等ノ印記アリ。書中、批點及ヒ改正ノ所アリ。又卷八ニ、紅筆ヲ以テ副葉ニ、白墮醉畱花外月、靑山濃綴杖頭春、戊寅春日醉花偶成ト題セリ。又卷九ニ、香夢筆牀花案晝、碧學書帶草庭春、老鉏漫草ト題ス〈學字誤ナラン〉。草體ニシテ、絶テ妙ナリ。戴笠、初名觀胤、字曼公、初字子辰、號荷鉏人。草隸ヲ善スルヲ以テ聞フ。後釋門ニ入テ名ヲ性易トイヒ、字ヲ獨立ト云。又天外一閑人ト號ス。明陳文沂移情集、濮澹軒集ニ、唱和ノ詩見エタリ。
戴笠曼公、杭州人。博學能詩、兼工篆隸。不欲以儒術顯、乃潛究素門諸書、懸壺濮里。崇禎中楚蜀擾亂、公慨然曰、此君子避世時耶。遂從番禺人乘桴入海、後不知所終〈桐卿縣志＊〉。
南宋淳煕年閒ノ槧本、金澤文庫ノ印、又蟠桃院ノ印記アリ。四方寬廣ニシテ、字五分餘、紙質完シ。然トモ板マタ拘滯ス。田世卿跋曰、此板久已磨滅、不復有也、前年蒙恩、將屯安康、偶得蜀本、字多舛誤、閒亦脫漏、嘗從暇日、委官挍正ト云フ。又淳煕乙巳九月至丁未五月、僅能畢工ト記セリ。
明板ニシテ、紙板共ニ美ナリ。周易卷首副葉ニ、明人題シテ內府十三經ト記シ、各目ヲ載ス。東閣、東書閣、謙謙君子等ノ印記アリ。明內府東閣ノ遺書ナランカ。內爾雅ヲ逸セリ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、文淵閣書目楊士奇序文云、永樂十九年南京取回來、一向于左順門北廊收貯、未有完整書目、近來奉聖旨、移貯于文淵閣、東閣云。又明史ニ、洪武中作＊宋制置華蓋殿、武英殿、文淵閣、東閣等諸大學士トアリ。然レハ此書、東閣ノ藏書ナルヘシ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ: "Respectfully, I note/examine:"
- 文淵閣書目楊士奇序文云: "The preface by Yang Shiqi to the *Wenyuange shumu* (Catalogue of the Wenyuan Pavilion) says:"
- 永樂十九年南京取回來: "In the 19th year of Yongle (1421), [the books] were fetched back from Nanjing,"
- 一向于左順門北廊收貯: "and all along were received and stored in the north corridor of the Zuoshun Gate;"
- 未有完整書目: "there was as yet no complete catalogue."
- 近來奉聖旨: "Recently, in obedience to an imperial edict,"
- 移貯于文淵閣、東閣云: "they were moved and stored in the Wenyuan Pavilion and the Eastern Pavilion" (the closing 云 ends the quotation).
- 又明史ニ: "Further, in the *Ming shi* (History of the Ming):"
- 洪武中作＊宋制置華蓋殿、武英殿、文淵閣、東閣等諸大學士: "During the Hongwu era, [the court] made/followed ＊ the Song system [the character marked ＊ is illegible or missing in the source; possibly "imitating"] and established Grand Secretaries of the Huagai Hall, Wuying Hall, Wenyuan Pavilion, Eastern Pavilion, and so on,"
- トアリ: "so it is written."
- 然レハ: "That being so,"
- 此書、東閣ノ藏書ナルヘシ: "this book must be a holding from the library of the Eastern Pavilion."
Summary:
The annotator cites Yang Shiqi's preface (books brought from Nanjing in 1421, kept in the Zuoshun Gate north corridor, then moved by imperial order to the Wenyuan and Eastern Pavilions) and the *Ming shi* on the Grand Secretaries' pavilions to infer that this book came from the Eastern Pavilion collection.

Volume_Info: 板式前ニ同シ。刷印ヤヽ後ル。內本紀三卷ヲ佚ス。又本紀卷四、卷五、卷六、列傳卷六〈二葉〉、卷十三〈五葉〉、卷五十二、卷五十三、卷五十四、卷五十五、卷五十六〈十七葉〉ヲ佚ス。補闕ヲ以テ全卷トナル。天龍金剛藏海印文常住ノ印記アリ。山城嵯峨天龍寺ノ子院、金剛院ノ藏海トイヘルモノヽ印記ナリ。毛利（高翰）出雲守獻本中ノ一也。

宋板ニテ、柴（市、朱筆校改）野光彥＊（迷庵）ノ所藏ニシテ、同人ノ印記、跋アリ。是ヲ見テ、此書ノ來歷ヲ知ルヘシ。宋板三國志全部、魏志帝記一册缺、蜀志卷首有咸平六年中書門下牒、系補寫可惜也、又每卷有眞淨院朱印、惜陰墨印、雅素可愛、又魏志卷七末書、戊午夏五戊寅晩閒挍對、旵、又魏志八末書、戊午建午中八夜挍、旵、所謂旵者、未考其人、顧五山釋氏之徒也、卽爲四五百年所傳舊物矣、今夏曝書於楼上、乃記如此、文政庚辰六月迷菴光彦ト記シ、又咸平六年牒、後人所補足、當刪之、予嘗觀宋板前後漢書、皆南宋本也、此本與前後漢書同種、足以證明焉ト書シ、又足利學所藏毛詩注疏本詩譜末朱書、大荒落晩夏小晝日＊燈下一看絶句、光彥續錄（＊四字錯誤）訖、藤旵、此書所謂旵者、豈非斯人乎、然則此書、出於足利學舊藏焉、壬午七月五日迷菴光彥再識トアリ。享和年閒、柴野彥助邦彥（栗山）ト云ヘル官儒アリ。年序ヲ以テ考ルニ、光彥ハ邦彥ノ子ナルモ、知ルヘカラス。又卷中ニ、賜盧文庫＊ノ印記アリ。誰氏ノ藏ナルヤ、詳ナラス。新見豐前守（正興）獻本五種ノ一ナリ。
Remarks_Notes: ＊市野光彥，＊盡日，＊賜蘆文庫，＊江戸市野光／彥藏書記，＊賜蘆文庫

Volume_Info: 明正德官板ニシテ、撫印最初ノ本ナリ。明ノ內府藏本ナリ。廣運之寶、表章經史之寶ノ璽鈐アリ。
明官板。萬曆十七年刊スル所ニシテ、大本闊字ナリ。撫印ヤヽ後ル。內逸卷、唐人補闕セリ。每卷、蔣琦ノ印記アリ。其人ヲ詳ニセス。

韓板。活字刷印ニシテ、殘闕最モ夥シ。印本什ノ一ヲ存ス。補闕、明板ヲ原本トナス。其補卷目錄ノ上卷ニ、明朝列大夫國子監祭酒臣方從哲、承德郞右春坊右中允管國子監司業事臣黃汝良等、奉敕重挍刊トアリ。又卷四十七ノ後ニ、康煕庚辰年江寧府儒學敎授荆子邁挍ノ十六字アリ。按ニ、明板淸補刊ノ本ヲ以テ補闕セルカ。印本每册ニ、上洛金紐氏受賜之記ノ印記アリ。韓ノ賜本ナリ。補闕目錄三卷、本紀二十卷、表三卷、志四十四卷、傳八十六卷。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。

宋板ニシテ、紙質精緻、字樣正雅ニシテ、マタ善本ト云フヘシ。眉山程氏カ藏板ナリ。卷首副葉ニ小記アリ。其文曰、東都事略、宋刻僅見此本、先君最所寶愛榮、本樓牙籤萬軸、獨闕此書、牧翁屢求不獲、心頗嗛焉、先君家道中落、要索頻煩、始終不忍棄捐、吾子孫其愼守之勿失、右見讀書敏求記、按近来富宋本者、莫錢遵王若也、然其言如此、則當寶藏、可知也、故表出之、示後之獲此者ト見エタリ。然ルニ何人ノ記ナルコトヲ詳ニセス。卷第八十六ヨリ九十三ニ至ルマテ八卷及ヒ、卷第百二十二ノ一卷ヲ散逸セリ。マタ卷第一、卷第二、卷第四、卷第五、卷第六、卷第七、卷第八、卷第九、卷第十、卷第十二、卷第十四、卷第十五、卷第十六、卷第十七、卷第十八、卷第十九、卷第二十、卷第六十二、卷第六十三、卷第六十四、卷第六十五、卷第六十六、卷第七十一、卷第七十二、卷第八十一、卷第八十二、卷第九十四、卷第九十五、卷第九十六、卷第九十七、卷第九十八、卷第九十九、卷第一百十六、卷第一百十九、卷第一百二十、卷第一百二十三、卷第一百二十九、凡テ三十六卷、補寫ニ係ル。其他、卷中一二葉、或ハ四五葉補寫スルモノアリ。其書、古色アリテ、珍トスルニ堪ヘタリ。マタ鄞江衞氏ノ印記アリテ、其人ヲ詳ニセス。新見豐前守獻本五種ノ一ナリ。
慶長中、　命アリテ印行スル活字板ノ一ナリ。鹿苑（西笑）承兌ノ跋ニ云フ、唐太宗皇帝者、創業成一代、英武之賢君也、千載之下、仰其德慕其風者、今之／（双擡）內大臣〈御諱〉公、是也、故令前學校三要老禪、挍訂貞觀政要、去歳開家語於板、今歳政要刻於梓、遵聖賢前軌、而作國家治要ト記セリ。又慈眼刊トアリ。
近衞家煕公、手書挍刊スル所ノ書也。延享中彼家ニ　旨アリテ、雁皮紙ヲ以テ新ニ刷印令メラルヽ所ナリ。
明萬曆官板。大本ニシテ初印ノ本ナリ。此書、張居正等カ進本ヲ、史館ニ附シテ其副本ヲ挍刊セシメ、刻成テ進ムル所ノ書也。明人題シテ、御覽帝鑑圖說ト云フ。王業浩印、吉日〈字闕〉、松儔竹伴等ノ印記アリ。諸印考フル所ナシ。
韓板活字ニシテ、駿府御文庫本ナリ。卷首副葉ニ、嘉靖三十七年十一月、內賜弘文館直提學尹毅中文獻通考一件、命除謝恩、左副承旨臣沈押字トアリ。卷首、宣賜之記ノ印記アリ。コレ又韓ノ賜本ナリ。其內、卷百三十六、卷百三十七ヲ缺ク。享保中　旨アリテ補寫セリ。御本日記ニ載スル、林道春（羅山）所司ノ書也。印記前ニ見エタリ。

明官板ニシテ、淸ノ琳琅書目ニ擧ル、嘉靖官板ト同シ。二泉精舎、國賢ノ印記アリ。明ノ邵寶カ藏本ナリ。卷二十五ヨリ卷三十ニ至ルマテ、唐人ノ書本ニ係ル。又寶カ印記ナシ。明馮天馭カ挍刊本ヲ以テ補寫ス。蓋シ補闕、他人ノ手ニ出ルモノナラン。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
邵寶、字國賢。無錫人。學者稱爲二泉先生。成化二十年進士、歷官南京禮部尙書。卒贈太子太保、謚文莊〈明史〉。
北宋槧本ニシテ、字畫楷正ナリ。卷百ヨリ卷二百ニ至ルマテ、散逸セシヲ書寫セリ。其紙墨奇古ニシテ、書中紅靑筆ヲ以テ挍正スル所アリ。此書、曾テ朝鮮國王ノ藏トナル。經筵ノ印記、高麗國藏書ノ印記アリ。案スルニ、宋ノ建中靖國元年ハ、今ヲ距ルコト七百有餘年、實ニ奇世ノ珍ナリ。此書、民閒ニ藏セシヲ、林大學頭衡（述齋）上言シテ、文化十四年六月收ム。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、朝鮮史略、高麗國十四葉辛巳ノ歳ハ、肅宗ノ六年ナリ。肅宗、名顒、字天常、初名煕。宣宗母弟。東國通鑑、天常ヲ大常ニ作ル。
Remarks_Notes: ＊高麗國十四葉辛巳歳／藏書大宋建中靖國／元年大遼乾統元年
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ (Respectfully, I note / In my humble examination):
- 朝鮮史略、高麗國十四葉辛巳ノ歳ハ (In the *Chōsen ryaku-shi* [*Abridged History of Korea*], under the Koryŏ state, at the 14th leaf [or: 14th in the line of reigns], the year of the Xinsi [辛巳] cycle sign)
- 肅宗ノ六年ナリ (is the sixth year of King Sukjong [Shukusō]).
- 肅宗、名顒、字天常、初名煕 (Sukjong: personal name Ong [顒], courtesy name Tenjō/Cheonsang [天常], first name Hŭi [煕]).
- 宣宗母弟 (He was the full younger brother, by the same mother, of Seonjong).
- 東國通鑑、天常ヲ大常ニ作ル (The *Dongguk tonggam* writes "天常" as "大常").

Note: 十四葉 is ambiguous. It could be a folio number or a count of generations. The year 辛巳 matches Sukjong's 6th year (1101).
Summary:
This passage does not describe any movement or acquisition of a book. It is a scholarly annotation that fixes Koryŏ King Sukjong's 6th year as the Xinsi year (1101), gives his names and his relation to Seonjong, and notes a variant character in the *Dongguk tonggam* (天常 written as 大常).

Volume_Info:
唐人ノ書本ニシテ、明末變革ノ事ヲ紀ス。虞山錢曾カ藏本ナリ。書手一ナラス。然レトモ印記ヲ案スルニ、奇書手自鈔トアルハ、曾カ手抄ナルヘシ。各卷ニ散見セリ。北略ニ印記ヲ蹈セス。此書、卷帙錯雜シ、完壁（＊璧）ト云ヘカラス。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
錢曾、字遵王、自號也是翁。常熟人。家富圖籍、多蓄舊笈、其最佳之本、手所題識、倣歐陽修集古錄之意云〈四庫全書提要〉。
錢曾、副使順德之族、元孫。少穎敏、善學於經史諸子百家。過目卽能成誦。工擧子業、數奇不售、遂倂力詩古文。又逑（＊述）古堂藏書、多善本。撰讀書敏求記、識其源委云〈蘇州府志〉。
元至正十一年、崇化余志安勤有堂ノ刊本ナリ。撫刻紙質、倶ニ賤劣ニシテ、元時ノ坊本ナリ。姑蘇吳岫家藏ノ印記アリ。其人ヲ詳ニセス。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
明萬曆刊板ニシテ、安太史平叔、黃白堂ノ印記アリ。安部家＊ノ藏本ナリ。黃白堂モ、安部平叔＊カ自號ナルヘシ。天文陰陽ノ博士家ナルヲ以テ、天經黃白ノ二道ヲ取テ、其齋ニ名ツクルナルヘシ。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一ナリ。
明板。刊刻ノ年月ヲ載セス。內府藏書、知止堂ノ印記アリ。二印共ニ考ル所ナシ。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
元板。古譯本ナリ。鋟板ノ年月ヲ記載セス。字畫端正ニシテ、紙墨共ニ完美ナリ。鑑藏家ノ印記アリ。
宋板ニシテ、蝴蝶裝ニ製セリ。惜ラクハ殘闕甚多シ。實ニ吉光ノ片羽ト云ヘシ。金澤文庫ノ印記、各卷ニ散見セリ。

明萬曆重修本ナリ。明謝肇淛カ藏本ニシテ、印記アリ。徐氏筆精ニ、予友謝方伯肇淛、有書嗜。銳意蒐羅、不施批點ト云ヘリ。今御文庫中、肇淛ノ藏本七八種ヲ收ム。一モ批點ヲ加ル者ナシ。徐■(火孛)カ言ニ符ス。
謝肇淛、字在杭。福建長樂人。萬曆壬辰進士。官至廣西布政使〈明史〉。

明萬曆重修本ナリ。明徐■(火孛)カ藏本ニシテ、印記アリ。又嘉■（鼎刀）氏、句章外史ノ印記アリ。句章地名、今ノ鄞縣ナリ。山海經ニ、句章山ト云フ、是ナリ。然レトモ其人ヲ詳ニセス。
徐■(火孛)、字惟起、又字興公。閩縣人。永寧令■（木昂）之子也。博學工文、善草隸書。萬曆閒與曹能始狎、主閩中詞盟、後進皆稱興公詩派。嗜古學、家多藏書。著筆精、榕陰新檢等書。以博洽稱於時云。
明板。徐■(火孛)カ藏本ナリ。又彭城呂氏綠玉山房ノ印記アリ。其人ヲ考ヘス。
明板。徐■(火孛)藏本ナリ。印記前ニ同シ。
明隆慶板。謝肇淛ノ藏本ナリ。印記前ニ同シ。右五種トモニ、毛利出雲守獻本中ノ書也。

明嘉靖板。明毛晉カ藏本、汲古閣ノ印記アリ。又彭城開國ノ印記アリ。其人ヲ詳ニセス。
毛晉、元名鳳苞、字子晉。蘇州常熟人。晉奮起爲儒、游錢謙益之門、強記博覽。搆汲古閣、藏書萬卷。刻十三經、十七史、古今百家之書、手自挍讐、世皆購之。入門僮僕、皆能抄書。著述甚富〈蘇州府志〉。
明天啓重修本。徐■(火孛)藏本ナリ。又京師ノ醫、靑木東菴カ印記アリ。閩中徐惟起藏書ノ印、前ニ見エタリ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。
慶長四年、活字板ノ木字數十萬ヲ作ラシメ、足利學ノ三要（閑室元佶）ニ賜ヒ、伏見ノ圓光寺ニ局ヲ開キ、數十種ヲ刷印令メラル。其初メニ此書ヲ印行スルヨシ、三要カ跋ニ、／（双擡）內府〈御諱〉公、于文于武得其名、故興廢繼絶、爲後學刻梓文字數十萬而賜、予退爲謝／（単擡）公之恩惠、初開家語〈云云〉。慶長第四龍集己亥仲夏吉辰、前學校三要野衲於城南伏見里書焉ト記セリ。又慈眼刊之ノ字アリ。コレ國家官板ノ權輿ナリ。

古寫卷軸ニシテ、金澤文庫本ナリ。印記、卷ノ首後ニアリ。御本日記ニ載スル所ノ、駿府御文庫本ナリ。每卷後ニ題識アリ。其文枚擧スヘカラス。建長、康元、正喜＊、正元、文應、建治、嘉元、德治、延慶、文永年閒ニ至ルマテ、淸原敎隆、隆重、賴業、又藤原經雄、俊國、敦周、敦綱、敦經等、依越州使君敎命加點畢トアリ。卷十五、卷十六、卷十八、卷十九、卷二十一、卷二十二、卷二十四ニ、文永中越後守顯時重ネテ書寫挍點スト、手自書スル識語押字アリ。又卷二十八、卷二十九、卷三十ニ、嘉元中越後守貞顯書寫重挍スト、手自書スル識語押字アリ。文永ヨリ今ヲ距ルコト五百餘年、奇書ト云フヘシ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、羣書治要、唐書藝文志雜家ニ入ル。宋史ヨリ以下其書ヲ逸ス。又諸家ノ書目ニ見ル所ナシ。三代實錄貞觀十七年、先是天皇讀羣書治要、至是講竟トアレハ、此書、彼ニ佚シテ我ニ傳フルコト、久シキヲ知ルヘシ。
Literal_English_Translation:
謹案ニ (Humbly considering / respectfully noting:)
羣書治要、 (the *Qunshu zhiyao* [Gunsho chiyō],)
唐書藝文志雜家ニ入ル。 (is entered under the "Miscellaneous Schools" category in the Bibliographical Treatise of the *Tang shu*.)
宋史ヨリ以下 (From the *Song shi* onward,)
其書ヲ逸ス。 (that book is lost.)
又諸家ノ書目ニ (Moreover, in the bibliographic catalogues of the various authorities)
見ル所ナシ。 (there is nowhere it is seen.)
三代實錄貞觀十七年、 (In the *Sandai jitsuroku*, Jōgan 17 [875],)
先是天皇讀羣書治要、 (it says "Previously, the Emperor read the *Gunsho chiyō*,)
至是講竟 (and at this point the lectures [on it] were completed,")
トアレハ、 (and since it says so,)
此書、 (this book,)
彼ニ佚シテ (having been lost over there [in China],)
我ニ傳フルコト、 (its being transmitted in our country,)
久シキヲ知ルヘシ。 (one should understand to be of long standing.)
Summary:
The annotator argues that the *Qunshu zhiyao*, recorded in the Tang bibliographic treatise but lost in China from the Song period onward and absent from later catalogues, must have been transmitted to Japan long ago, as shown by the *Sandai jitsuroku* entry of 875 recording the Emperor's reading and the completion of lectures on it. (The text gives no specific acquisition event or transmission route, only evidence of early Japanese possession and survival.)

Volume_Info: 元和二年正月／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）、活字ノ便ナルヲ以テ、駿府ニ於テ別ニ銅字數萬ヲ製セラレ、此書ヲ刷印令メラル。畔柳壽學、林道春（羅山）、釋（以心）崇傳等其事ニ預ル。後ニ銅字ヲ紀伊家ニ傳與セラレ、今ニ存スト云フ。／（双擡）有德大君（德川吉宗）、大統ヲ繼キタマフニ及ヒテ、銅板刷印ノ羣書治要、大藏一覽等、數部紀府ニ存スルヲ以テ、元文五年七月、其二部ヲ御庫ニ收メラル。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、林信勝年譜元和元年、赴駿府、奉　旨覽監羣書治要、大藏一覽開板之事トアルハ、此時ノ事ニシテ、初メ三要ニ賜ハリシ木板ニアラス。又元和二年、／（双擡）大神君棄羣臣、信勝配分官庫御書、附義直卿、賴宣卿、賴房卿之家臣トアリ。羣書治要、大藏一覽等、多ク紀府ニ存スルモ、其故ナルヘシ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ ("Respectfully I note:")
- 林信勝年譜元和元年、赴駿府、奉　旨覽監羣書治要、大藏一覽開板之事トアルハ ("The chronology of Hayashi Nobukatsu says that in Genna 1 (1615) he went to Sunpu, received an order to examine the *Qunshu zhiyao* (Gunsho Chiyō), and that there was the matter of cutting the printing blocks for the *Daizō Ichiran*. As for this,")
- 此時ノ事ニシテ、初メ三要ニ賜ハリシ木板ニアラス ("it is a matter of this time, and is not the wooden printing blocks first bestowed on Sanyō.")
- 又元和二年、／（双擡）大神君棄羣臣 ("Furthermore, in Genna 2 (1616), the Great Divine Lord [Ieyasu; the line break and double raise in the original are honorific] abandoned his assembled retainers [i.e., died],")
- 信勝配分官庫御書、附義直卿、賴宣卿、賴房卿之家臣トアリ ("and the record says that Nobukatsu apportioned the honorable books of the official storehouse and assigned them to the retainers of Lord Yoshinao, Lord Yorinobu and Lord Yorifusa.")
- 羣書治要、大藏一覽等、多ク紀府ニ存スルモ、其故ナルヘシ ("That the *Gunsho Chiyō*, *Daizō Ichiran* and others mostly survive in the Kii domain is probably for that reason.")
Summary:
The note argues that the *Gunsho Chiyō* and *Daizō Ichiran* blocks and books were handled by Hayashi Nobukatsu at Sunpu in 1615, not the blocks first given to Sanyō, and that after Ieyasu's death in 1616 Nobukatsu distributed the shogunal storehouse books to the three Tokugawa branch houses (Owari, Kii and Mito), which explains why many of these books are in the Kii collection.

Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、武英殿聚珍板製題注云、此書、康煕年閒編纂古今圖書集成、刻銅字爲活板。排印藏工＊、貯之武英殿。歷年旣久、銅字或被竊缺少、司事者懼于咎。適値乾隆初年、京師錢貴、遂請毀銅字供鑄、從之。所得有限、而所耗甚多、已爲非計。且使銅字尙存、則今之印書、不更事半功倍乎。深爲惜之ト見エタリ。然ハ彼ノ土ニ於テモ、今復得カタキノ書ナリ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ: "Respectfully considering this..."
- 武英殿聚珍板製題注云: "The inscription-note on the making of the Wuying Hall movable-type (Juzhen) edition says:"
- 此書、康煕年閒編纂古今圖書集成: "As for this book: in the Kangxi years the Gujin tushu jicheng was compiled,"
- 刻銅字爲活板: "copper characters were carved to make movable type,"
- 排印藏工＊: "set and printed, [and] stored/completed ... (the last character, marked ＊, is illegible or uncertain in the source; the phrase is probably corrupt or garbled),"
- 貯之武英殿: "and it was kept in the Wuying Hall."
- 歷年旣久: "Many years passed, a long time already;"
- 銅字或被竊缺少: "some of the copper characters were stolen and became deficient;"
- 司事者懼于咎: "the officials in charge feared blame."
- 適値乾隆初年、京師錢貴: "It happened that in the early Qianlong years, copper cash was dear in the capital;"
- 遂請毀銅字供鑄: "so they petitioned to destroy the copper characters to supply the minting,"
- 從之: "and this was granted."
- 所得有限、而所耗甚多、已爲非計: "What was gained was limited, while what was lost was very great; it was already an unsound plan."
- 且使銅字尙存、則今之印書、不更事半功倍乎: "Moreover, had the copper characters still survived, would not today's book-printing take half the effort for double the result?"
- 深爲惜之: "It is deeply regrettable."
- ト見エタリ: "So it appears [in the text]."
- 然ハ彼ノ土ニ於テモ: "That being so, even in that land (China),"
- 今復得カタキノ書ナリ: "this is a book now hard to obtain again."
Summary:
Citing a Qing note, the passage explains that the Kangxi-era copper movable-type set used for the Gujin tushu jicheng was stolen from in part and then melted down for coin in the early Qianlong years, so the copper-type edition is now hard to obtain even in China. It records no actual transfer or acquisition of a specific copy, only the reason for the book's rarity.

Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、慶長十九年八月六日、大藏一覽釋崇傳上ル。明年　命アリテ、銅板活字ヲ以テ刷印令メラル。林道春、其事ヲ領ス。撫印成リテ進呈ス。凡一百二十五部。又每部朱印ヲ加ヘテ、諸寺ニ寄附スヘキノ／命アリ。其事、駿府日記ニ詳ナリ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ ("Respectfully, upon examination,")
- 慶長十九年八月六日、 ("on the sixth day of the eighth month of Keichō 19 [1614],")
- 大藏一覽 釋崇傳 上ル。 ("the monk Sūden presented the *Daizō Ichiran*.")
- 明年 命アリテ、 ("In the following year there was an order, and")
- 銅板活字ヲ以テ刷印令メラル。 ("it was caused to be printed with copper-plate movable type.")
- 林道春、其事ヲ領ス。 ("Hayashi Dōshun took charge of that matter.")
- 撫印成リテ進呈ス。 ("When the impressions [printing] were completed, they were presented [to the court/shogunal authority]." Note: 撫印 is an unusual wording, probably used for 刷印 or 摺印, "rubbed/pressed impression.")
- 凡一百二十五部。 ("In all, about 125 copies.")
- 又 每部 朱印ヲ加ヘテ、 ("Furthermore, a vermilion seal was to be added to each copy, and")
- 諸寺ニ寄附スヘキノ命アリ。 ("there was an order that they should be donated to the various temples.")
- 其事、駿府日記ニ詳ナリ。 ("The details of this matter are set out in the *Sunpu Nikki* [Sunpu Diary].")
Summary:
Sūden presented the *Daizō Ichiran* in 1614. The next year it was printed in about 125 copies with copper movable type under Hayashi Dōshun's supervision, and the copies were presented and then ordered to be given, each with a vermilion seal, to various temples, as recorded in the *Sunpu Nikki*.

此書、永樂七年、濠ノ貞陰老人伍德カ本ヲ、嘉靖中挍刻セルヲ、亦抄寫セルナリ。モト明人ノ收藏ニテ、後淸ノ季振宜カ藏書トナル。書中、紅筆ヲ以テ數本ニヨリ挍正ス。題識ニ據リテ見ルヘシ。馮氏印記、空居閣印記アリ。卷首序後ニ紅筆ヲ以テ、此書先借何氏刻本印抄、因誤多不可改正、崇禎庚午先將英華文粹諸本挍過、至己卯始得葉林宗抄本、對得二十卷、存五卷未遇善本始俟之。錢牧齋云、復缺五卷、非全書也トアリ。卷八後ニ、崇禎己卯用錢牧齋抄本挍、共增四葉、十月十日ト記シ、空居閣ノ印記ヲ蹈ス。卷十七ノ後ニ、崇禎己卯借葉氏抄本挍過スト記シ、空居閣ノ印記ヲ蹈ス。又墨筆ヲ以テ、九月十一日夜、夢到一處、若看榜者、見榜中亦有余名、意頗悵惘、徐行而歸、似是邸舎、取筆書紅牋、作七言近體一首中、僅憶二句、比曉起又忘一句、其一句云、萬燈明裏哭孤身、回顧目前、無一人識面者、邸中亦竝新人、僕僮亦非舊從、若有無家之戚、嗚呼、余不作此夢矣、意境忡忡、豈隔世耶、他生耶、是時正閱此書、便筆記此、孱守居士ト記シ、己倉父ノ印記ヲ蹈ス。卷二十五ノ終ニ、天啓丁卯八月二十九錄完、十月初九釘成袠、二十九粗挍過、淨護居士記于含碧樓トアリテ、又空居閣ノ印記ヲ蹈ス。名家ノ藏本ヲ以テ、數次挍正スルノ書ナレハ、實ニ希珍ト云フヘシ。上賞ノ印記アリ。收本中ノ、最モ佳ナルヲ以テナリ。毛晉カ收本、宋槧ニ宋本ノ印ヲ蹈シ、亦甲乙ノ二印ヲ以テ、其書ヲ次第スルノ例ナリ。季振宜、前ニ見エタリ。或ハ孱守ト云フ、或ハ淨護ト云フ、皆記スルニ隱名ヲ以テス。今其人ヲ詳ニセス。馮氏印記、亦考フルトコロナシ。

宋槧本。年月脫落シテ考フヘカラス。金澤文庫ノ收藏印記アリ。殘闕半ニ過ク。現存卷二十六至卷三十一、卷八十至卷八十五、卷百二十至卷百二十五。紙墨トモニ淸朗ニシテ、蝴蝶裝本也。四庫總目ニ、此書久佚、今從永樂大典裒次、釐爲六十卷トアリ。彼ニ佚シテ吾ニ傳フノ、久キコトヲ知ルヘシ。又本傳ニ集百卷ト稱シ、宋志及ヒ文獻通考共ニ百五十卷トシ、陳氏書錄及ヒ焦氏經籍志マタ百卷ト稱シテ、記載互ニ殊ナリ。今殘編中卷百二十五アルヲ以テ見レハ、宋志及ヒ通考ニ稱スル所、百五十卷本ノ眞面目タルコト昭昭タリ。殘闕多シト雖トモ、希珍ト云ヘキ也。
元板ニテ、刻板ノ年月ヲ載セス。總目ノ後ニ、建安魏忠卿刊梓于家塾トアリ。撫刻分明ニシテ、元刻ノ善本也。官庫、藏書、龜字ノ印記アリ。　本邦收書家ノ印ニシテ、其人ヲ考ヘス。又簡端ニ古譯アリ。
韓板活字ニテ、韓人題シテ蘇內翰詩ト云フ。禮賢ノ印アリ。韓ノ鈐印ナリ。卷末ニ、野閒三竹白雲書庫ノ印記アリ。前ニ見エタリ。
元板。撫印楮墨トモニ精潔ニシテ、刊刻ノ年月ヲ載セス。重屋、宗珍、宗通、宗栢ノ印記アリ。皆茶事ニ聞エアリ。右八種倶ニ、毛利出雲守（高翰）獻本中ノ書也。
宋板ニテ、刊刻ノ年月ヲ載セス。紙墨共ニ美ナリ。每卷首ニ、賜盧文庫＊ノ印記アリ。誰氏ノ藏ナルヤ詳ナラス。其他、印記亦詳ナラス。新見豐前守（正興）獻本五種ノ一ナリ。
元板ニテ、撫刻楮墨、トモニ佳ナラス。刻板ノ年月ナシ。四向庵＊、吟風弄月ノ印記アリ。篇首ニ、芳春常住ト記ス。釋家ノ收藏ナリ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。

宋板ニテ、金澤文庫ノ印記、每卷首後ニアリ。柴野彥助邦彥（栗山）自筆鑑定ノ文、是ニ附ス。其文中ニ、此本古色鬱紛、其爲當初原板、不可疑焉、首有金澤文庫印記、上杉氏舊藏也。流轉近歸于翫月堂小倉氏焉、凡宋刻傳者、唐人猶爲罕遘、況於萬里之外、其可不寶愛乎、借觀數十日、詳其編纂、僅止所職之文、制誥口宣批答及靑詞致語等之外、無一文及別題、蓋所謂制稾二十二卷者矣、其他奏議文集、知大體而剴切者、皆不可見、爲可惜已、小倉名祐利、以鬻書爲業ト記ス。附錄一卷、西垣類稾二卷ヲ倂セテ一本トシテ、金澤文庫ノ印記ナシ。新見豐前守獻本五種ノ一ナリ。
韓板活字本ナリ。宣賜之記ノ鈐印アリ。韓ノ賜本ナリ。卷首副葉ニ、嘉靖二十一年六月日、內賜司諫院正言閔起文朱子大全一件、命除謝恩、都承旨臣洪押字トアリ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。

明板。謝肇淛ノ藏本ナリ。印記前ニ同シ。
明萬曆刊本ニテ、徐■(火孛)カ藏本ナリ。徐■(火孛)、前ニ見エタリ。印記、前ニ同シ。

明萬曆板ニテ、內府藏書、王業浩印アリ。
右二種トモニ、毛利出雲守獻本ナリ。

宋板。大本闊字ニテ、楮墨トモニ完好ナリ。廟諱缺筆セリ。卷一ノ後ニ、左從政郞充贛州州學敎授張之綱覆挍、州學司書蕭鵬挍對、鄕貢進士李大成挍勘トアリテ、刊板ノ年月ヲ載セス。宋時州學ノ監本ナリ。是書、駿府御文庫ヨリ遷サル。卷一後ニ、應永三十四四月三日、寫朱墨畢、重志、卷二後ニ、右卷應永三十四年丁未四月十二日、三更三點、於雲巢西窗寫點畢、重志、卷八後ニ、潛齋點之、卷二十六後ニ、舊本云、安元三年三月五、以文章博士敦周朝臣家本移點挍合畢、正五位下行助敎中原朝臣師直、又應永二十九菊月十一日、寫點畢、鼎子誌之ト記セリ。御本日記ニ、南化本ト題セルモノ是ナリ。僧南化玄興カ所藏ヲ上リシモノナリ。玄興カ印記アリ。
韓板活字ニテ、卷首ニ、嘉靖三十四年五月日、內賜承文院判挍任輔臣文章辨體一件、命除謝恩、右副承旨臣白押字トアリ。宣賜之記ノ鈐印アリ。

韓板活字ニテ、卷首ニ、嘉靖三十五年四月日、內賜承政院同副承旨臣朴押字トアリ。印記前ニ同シ。
右二種トモニ韓ノ賜本ニシテ、慶長賜書二十二種中也。
明板。朱墨本ニテ、釋獨立カ藏本也。獨立前ニ見エタリ。戴觀胤、字子辰、炎上人二印、亦前ニ出ツ。
明泰昌刊板ニテ、字分明ニシテ初印ノ本ナリ。每册副葉ニ名媛ノ姓氏ヲ摘記ス。其書、細楷ニシテ最モ善書ナリ。
韓板活字ナリ。卷首ニ宣賜之記ノ鈐印アリ。韓ノ賜本ナリ。卷末ニ、圓光寺常住押字ト記セリ。南都一乗寺邑ノ、圓光寺ノ僧徒ノ藏本也。敬復齋ノ印記アリ。韓人ノ私印ナリ。

元至正年閒ノ槧本ニテ、字漫漶シ紙斷爛ス。榊原玄輔ノ藏本ニシテ、識語印記アリ。殘闕ノトコロ、玄輔補寫完全ス。玄輔最モ書名アリ。嘗テ官本ノ標題ヲ書セリ。今ニ存スルモノ少カラス。卷七十五ノ後ニ、此本數歷裝釘、紙幅減損、旣迫匡郭、釘痕甚多、不可復裝裁也、後之得焉者、勿改鑽之、元祿十三年重陽之後三日、榊原玄輔希翊識于江都紀邸之北玉照齋トアリ。又右以淸種德堂重訂行之本補完訖、近刻文字、尤多謬誤、此本雖苦麻沙、比近刻則最爲愈矣、古本可以其漫滅、而忽之如此矣、元祿十三年九月二十五日ト記セリ。玄輔、字希翊、篁洲ト號ス。木下順庵ノ門人ナリ。紀府ニ筮仕ス。最律學ニ長セリ。印記ハ其手刻スルトコロナリト云フ。

此書、諺文ヲ以テ譯ス。卷首ニ宣賜ノ印アリ。副葉ニ、萬曆十八年七月、內賜安東鄕挍＊孟子諺解一件、左副承旨臣押字ト記セリ。又韓人ノ私印アリ。印記辨スヘカラス。

金澤文庫考〈附足利學校〉杉山精一謹編
北條越後守（實時）、武州久良郡六浦庄金澤ニ文庫ヲ建テ、和漢ノ書ヲ收儲シ金澤文庫ノ印記ヲ蹈ス〈金澤ノ稱名寺、其遺蹤ナルヲ以テ稱名寺文庫トモ云フ〉。一ニ越後守實時カ建ル所ナリト云ヒ、一ニ其子顯時カ建ル所ナリト云フ。又ハ其子貞顯カ建ル所ナリト云フ。當時ノ記載、徵スヘキモノ無ケレハ、其然否ヲ必トセス。今其儲藏ヲ以テ考ルニ、卷子本アリ、册本アリ。官ニ收スル卷本左傳、羣書治要、令義解、本朝文粹＊等ノ識語ニ、弘長、文永、建治中書寫挍合畢、越州剌史＊押字ト記スルハ、實時カ自記スル也。羣書治要卷二十九ノ識語ニ、嘉元四年二月二十八日以右大辨三位經雄卿本書寫點挍畢、此書祖父越州之時被終一部之功處、後年少少紛失、仍書加之而已、從五位上行越後守平貞顯ト自記セルヲ以テ考フレハ、實時ナルコトヲ知ルヘシ。又左傳卷十四ノ識語ニ、弘安元年九月二十二日以音博士俊隆眞人之本書寫點挍畢、從五位下行左近衞將監平朝臣押字トアリ。又弘安元年十月十二日授申越後左近大夫將監尊閤畢、此書至二十九卷捧說先畢、而十四十五先君御時回祿成孳＊、重以有書點之閒、越卷有訓說之故也ト淸原俊隆記セル等ヲ以テ見レハ、顯時ナリ。又嘉元德治中ノ識語ニ、從五位下或ハ正五位下行越後守貞顯ト記シ、或ハ某年某月書寫挍合畢、貞顯ト自識スル識語ニヨリテ、父子三世相ヒ繼テ、好學ナルコトヲ見ルヘシ。然トモ文庫經始ノコト見ル所ナシ。册本ハ、上杉安房守憲實管領タル日、置モノナラム〈憲實ハ、上杉民部大輔房方カ三男ナリ。憲基嗣ナシ。八歳ニシテ越後ヨリ鎌倉ニ至リ、其封ヲ襲キ、應永二十六年、關東管領トナリ、永享十年、領國上野ニ退居ス。十一年、管領職ヲ弟兵庫頭淸方ニ讓リテ、長棟庵主ト號ス。後諸國ヲ周流シ、周防ノ山口大寧寺ニ住ス。文正元年卒、年五十四、其子右京亮憲忠、寶德元年、職ヲ襲キテ管領トナリ、享德三年、害ニ遇フ。年二十二〉。故ニ金澤ノ印記アリテ跋語ナシ。後文庫ノ廢蕪ニ至ルハ、貞顯執權ヲ致シ、其子貞將戰沒ノ後、廢スルナルヘシ〈釋義堂（周信）カ空華集ニ、觀金澤文庫而作ノ詩ヲ載ス。其詩ニ、玉帳修文講武餘、遣人來覓舊藏書、牙籤映日窺科斗、■（糸偏稟）帙＊乘晴走蠹魚、圯上一編看不足、鄴侯三萬欲何如、照心古敎君家有、收在胸中壓五車トアリ。義堂ハ、相州崇福ニ住持ス。貞治康曆ノ閒ニアリ。貞顯致仕ヲ距ルコト三十餘年ナレハ、此詩崇福ニ住セサル以前ノ作ナリヤ、詳ニセス。文庫三閣アルヨシ、元亨三年、稱名寺ノ住僧湛睿カ結界作法圖ニ見エタリ。茲ニヨリテ考レハ、元來稱名寺ノ中ハ、文庫ヲ建ル所ト見ユ。又釋萬里（集九）カ梅花無盡藏ニ、文明龍集丙午十有八年小春二十有七己亥、進入金澤稱名寺ト見ユ。又太田持資カ慕京集ニ、二月釋菜、金澤文庫ニテ行ヨシ見エタリ。然ハ寺中ニテ緇流ノ徒、コノ禮ヲ主サトリ、修セルコトヽ見エタリ〉。再興ハ、應永二十六年、上杉憲實將軍持氏ノ管領トナリ、相州山內ニ邸ヲ搆ルトキ、復古セルナルヘシ。惜カナ、是亦往日ノ記載ナケレハ、其詳ナルコトヲ知ルヘカラス。鎌倉大草紙ニ、武州金澤ノ學校ハ、北條氏繁盛ノ日學問ノ所ナリ。野州足利學ハ〈大草紙、鎌倉志共ニ上州足利ニ作ル。今改正ス〉、京鎌倉將軍家ノ稱呼ニ係ルヲ以テ其學ヲ再興シ、文籍ヲ異域ニ捜索シテ收ムト云フ。是故ニ、兩學宋槧ノ書ハ、皆憲實ノ置モノナルヘシ。再ヒ廢スルハ、憲實ノ子憲忠、結城成朝等カ爲ニ害ニ遇シ後、廢スルナルヘシ〈按ニ、前ノ如ク、文明ノ比マテハ、浮屠氏釋菜ノ禮ヲ修シテ、其庫ノ廢頽ニ至ラサルヲ見ルヘシ〉。北條氏ノ事詳ナラス。其槪略ヲ附記シテ、金澤本ノ考證ニ備フト云。
北條越後守平實時ハ、右京權大夫義時カ孫、陸奧五郞實泰カ男ナリ。曆仁元年三月十八日任掃部助宣陽明院藏人、建長五年二月加評定、七年十二月十三日任越後守、康元三年四月爲三番引付眾頭、文永元年六月十六日爲二番頭、十月二十五日爲越訴奉行、二年六月二十七日敍從五位上、四年四月辭越訴奉行、十年六月二十五日爲一番頭、建治元年五月依所勞籠居六浦、二年十月二十三日卒於六浦別業、年五十三〈關東評定傳〉。其子左近大夫將監顯時、弘安元年二月加評定、三年十一月任越後守、四年十月爲四番引付眾頭〈同上〉。其子貞顯、乾元元年中務大輔、七月二十六日入洛住南方、號金澤大輔、德治元年越後守、延慶二年正月十七日下著鎌倉、三年左馬權頭、正和元年武藏守、四年七月十一日合判事、元亨二年修理權大夫、正中元年修理大夫、嘉曆元年二月執權、四月二十六日出家〈執權記〉。〈本朝通鑑、三月十三日執權。東鑑、四月十六日出家、號金澤殿。本朝通鑑、四月朔日號崇顯、退居於金澤。案ニ、羣書治要卷二十九嘉元四年二月跋ニ、從五位上行越後守平朝臣貞顯ト署セリ。嘉元中越後守ニ任スルコト、見ルヘシ。又卷十四德治二年正月跋ニ從五位上ト署シ、二月跋ニ正五位下ト署ス。德治二年二月正五位下ニ敍セラルヽコト、跋語ニヨリテ證スヘシ。〉

Literal_English_Translation:
Hōjō Echigo-no-kami Taira no Sanetoki was a grandson of Udaishō/Ukyō-gon-no-daibu Yoshitoki and a son of Mutsu Gorō Sane'yasu.
- Ryakunin 1 (1238), 3rd month, 18th day: appointed Kamon-no-suke and Senyōin kurōdo.
- Kenchō 5 (1253), 2nd month: added to the Hyōjō (Council of State).
- Year 7 (Kenchō 7), 12th month, 13th day: appointed Echigo-no-kami.
- Kōgen 3 (as written), 4th month: became head of the Third Hikitsuke (Court of Pleadings).
- Bun'ei 1 (1264), 6th month, 16th day: became head of the Second [Hikitsuke].
- 10th month, 25th day: became Ossō bugyō (commissioner for appeals).
- Year 2 (1265), 6th month, 27th day: conferred Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade.
- Year 4 (1267), 4th month: resigned as Ossō bugyō.
- Year 10 (1273), 6th month, 25th day: became head of the First [Hikitsuke].
- Kenji 1 (1275), 5th month: because of illness, secluded himself in Mutsura.
- Year 2 (1276), 10th month, 23rd day: died at his country villa in Mutsura, aged 53. (Source: *Kantō Hyōjōden*.)

His son, Sakon-taifu Shōgen Akitoki:
- Kōan 1 (1278), 2nd month: added to the Hyōjō.
- Year 3 (1280), 11th month: appointed Echigo-no-kami.
- Year 4 (1281), 10th month: became head of the Fourth Hikitsuke. (Same source.)

His son Sadaaki:
- Kengen 1 (1302): Nakatsukasa-no-taifu.
- 7th month, 26th day: entered the capital and lived at the Southern Office [of Rokuhara]. He was called the Kanazawa Taifu.
- Tokuji 1 (1306): Echigo-no-kami.
- Enkyō 2 (1309), 1st month, 17th day: arrived in Kamakura.
- Year 3 (1310): Sama-gon-no-kami.
- Shōwa 1 (1312): Musashi-no-kami.
- Year 4 (1315), 7th month, 11th day: took part in the joint-signature judgments (gōhan).
- Genkō 2 (1322): Shuri-gon-no-daibu.
- Shōchū 1 (1324): Shuri-no-daibu.
- Karyaku 1 (1326), 2nd month: Shikken (regent).
- 4th month, 26th day: took Buddhist vows. (Sources: *Shikkenki* and *Honchō Tsugan*.)

The notes then give variant dates:
- *Honchō Tsugan* says he became Shikken on the 13th day of the 3rd month.
- *Azuma Kagami* says he took vows on the 16th day of the 4th month and was called "Kanazawa-dono."
- *Honchō Tsugan* says that on the 1st day of the 4th month he took the name Sūken and retired to Kanazawa.

The compiler's own remarks ("Examination:"):
- The colophon to *Gunsho Chiyō* vol. 29, dated the 2nd month of Kagen 4 (1306), is signed "Junior Fifth Rank Upper, acting Echigo-no-kami, Taira no Ason Sadaaki." From this one can see that he was appointed Echigo-no-kami during the Kagen era.
- The colophon to vol. 14, dated the 1st month of Tokuji 2 (1307), is signed "Junior Fifth Rank Upper," while the colophon of the 2nd month is signed "Senior Fifth Rank Lower."
- That he was raised to Senior Fifth Rank Lower in the 2nd month of Tokuji 2 can therefore be confirmed from the colophons.
Summary:
This is a genealogical and official-career record of three generations of the Kanazawa Hōjō (Sanetoki, Akitoki, Sadaaki) rather than an account of a book changing hands. The only book-related content is the compiler's use of Sadaaki's signed colophons on his *Gunsho Chiyō* copies (vols. 29 and 14) to correct and confirm the dates of his Echigo-no-kami appointment and his promotion to Senior Fifth Rank Lower.

Volume_Info:
足利學校考
下野足利學ハ、承和六年、小野篁其國司タリシ時草創スト云ヒ、或ハ篁カ家塾ナリト云ヒ、或ハ天長九年八月、篁敕ヲ奉テ草創スト〈日本史ニ相傳、下野足利學校篁嘗讀書處、上杉憲實創爲學校、聖廟傍有一室、安置篁木主、今見存焉〉。大草紙ニ、承和九年、篁陸奧ノ守トナルヲ以テ廢スト云。文德實錄ニ、承和六年春正月、遂捍詔爲庶人、配流隱岐國トアリ。又日本史ニ、小野篁身奉綸旨、出使外境、而稱病不行、準據律條、可處絞刑、今特宥死罪一等、處之遠流、因免爲庶人、竄于隱岐トアレハ、其國司タリシトキ創立ト云フ、亦陸奧ノ守トナルヲ以テ廢スト云フ、皆誤ナルヘシ。年代綿邈ニシテ、其詳ナルヲ知ルヘカラス。又大草紙ニ、應仁元年、長尾爲景カ舊蹟存スルヲ以テ、今ノ所ニ移スト云〈爲景一作景久〉。文明中、釋快元、儒釋同一ノ學ヲ以テ中興ス。永享中、上杉憲實再興シ、釋菜ノ例ヲ行ヒ、生徒ノ庖廩ヲ次ス。又五經注疏等ノ書ヲ收ム。其子憲忠、其子憲房、相ヒ繼テ寄進ノ書アリ。其書今現存ス。慶長中、／神祖（德川家康）菜地ヲ　賜ヒ、又三要（閑室元佶）ニ活字十餘萬ヲ　賜フテ、剏メテ孔子家語ヲ刷印シ、繼キテ周易、貞觀政要、七書、東鑑等ヲ印行ス。三要及ヒ鹿苑ノ（西笑）承兌等ニ、跋語ヲ書セ令ラル。是ヲ慶長活字板、復ハ足利本ト云フ。林恕（鵝峯）カ續本朝通鑑、其顚末ヲ記セリ。左ニ附錄シ孝槪＊ニ示セリ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP:
永享十一年閏正月、憲實納五經注疏於下野國足利學校。傳稱、足利學者、小野篁家塾也。中葉以來、僧徒住焉。然不稱長老和尙、而稱先生、以敎授兒童。且有求者、講五經及六韜等。或曰、（足利）尊氏曾祈勝軍之事於足利學校、稱有驗。而招京師儒官管之。其人＊水土之變、而不幾早世。自是儒官厭東行而不來、故禪徒窺文字者領之云。
又學校有憲實文狀〈原書係諺語〉。
凡漢土自國學至鄕校、非儒者無司業。聞綿竹惟以僧爲之主。今本朝州學存者僅有數焉。率亦以僧爲之主、野之＊爲最。古者＊曰、畛服而爲縫腋之行、何乖戾甚。雖然文字敎授、有庶幾焉。故我以五經注疏本若干卷、安置于學舎。自今講習無怠、則文化之行、自家達于鄕、達于州、達于國天下、指日而可竢矣。嗟夫寶惜珍藏、壽齊金石。主者思之。
又有條目一通。其一曰、收蓄之固、其扃鑰針滕、勿浪借與人。若有志於披閱者、就舎內、看一册畢、可輙送還、不許將歸出閫外。其二曰、主事者進退時、新舊兩人相對、撿定每部卷數、而後可交代。其三曰、借讀者勿以丹墨加妄句、勿令紙背生毛、勿觸寒具手。其四曰、夏月梅雨濕糊櫃蒸、則至風凉可曝乾之、勿中屋瓦之漏濕。至冬月、則可嚴火禁之備。其五曰、或質于庫、或鬻于市、或爲穿窬所獲、則罪莫大焉。永享十一年己未閏正月初吉、前房州剌＊史藤原憲實。
〈此注疏本、每册首閫外有上杉安房守憲實寄進、每册後有不許學校出閫外、又郭上有足利學公用。〉
〈右注疏本中周易、題上杉右京亮憲忠寄進。蓋憲實所置之逸、憲忠補之乎。〉
Remarks_Notes: ＊考槪，＊依水土之變，＊野之學，＊言者，＊刺史
Literal_English_Translation:
(Note: ＊ marks characters missing or illegible in the source. Renderings near them are tentative.)

- In the 11th year of Eikyō, intercalary first month, Norizane deposited the *Five Classics with commentaries and sub-commentaries* in the Ashikaga School of Shimotsuke Province.
- Tradition says: the Ashikaga school was the family private school of Ono no Takamura.
- From the middle period onward, Buddhist monks resided there.
- Yet they were not called "elder" or "oshō." They were called "sensei," and they taught children.
- Moreover, when there were people who requested it, they lectured on the Five Classics, the *Six Secret Teachings*, and the like.
- Some say: (Ashikaga) Takauji once prayed at the Ashikaga School for success in a military campaign, and it was said to be efficacious.
- And he summoned a Confucian official from the capital to administer it.
- That man [＊ – perhaps "was afflicted by"] the change of water and soil, and before long died young.
- Since then, Confucian officials disliked going east and did not come. Therefore Zen monks who had peeped into letters took charge of it, so it is said.
- Also, the school holds a written statement by Norizane (the original text is in the vernacular).
- Generally, in China, from the national academy down to the village school, no one but a Confucian scholar holds the post of director.
- I hear that at Mianzhu alone a monk is made the head.
- Of the provincial schools surviving in our realm today, there are only a few.
- Mostly these too take a monk as head, and that of Shimotsuke [＊] is the foremost.
- The ancients [＊] said: "To wear [畛服, meaning unclear, presumably monastic dress] yet behave in the manner of the wide-sleeved scholar's robe: how grossly perverse!"
- Even so, in teaching letters there is something to be hoped for.
- Therefore I am placing in the school building an edition of the Five Classics with commentaries and sub-commentaries, a certain number of volumes.
- If from now on lecturing and study are not neglected, the practice of culture will extend from the household to the village, to the province, to the state, and to all under heaven. One can wait for it, pointing to the day.
- Alas! Treasure and cherish it, store it as a precious thing, and may its lifespan equal metal and stone. Let those in charge consider this.
- There is also one set of regulations.
- First: keep the storage secure, with locks, bolts and cords; do not carelessly lend to others. If anyone wishes to read, he is to come into the school building, finish one volume, and promptly return it. It is not permitted to take it out beyond the gate.
- Second: when the person in charge enters or leaves office, the old and new men face each other, inspect and fix the number of volumes of each work, and only then hand over.
- Third: borrowers/readers must not add red or black ink marks and punctuation at random, must not let the back of the paper grow fuzz, and must not touch the books with hands that have handled oily fried cakes (*kangu*).
- Fourth: in the summer plum-rain season, when damp makes the paste in the cabinets steam, then when the wind turns cool, air and dry them. Do not let them be wetted by leaks through the roof tiles. In the winter months, strictly prepare against fire.
- Fifth: if they are pawned at a storehouse, sold in the market, or taken by a burglar, no crime is greater.
- Dated: Eikyō 11, year *tsuchinoto-hitsuji*, first day of the intercalary first month. Former Governor of Bōshū [刺＊史, i.e. 刺史], Fujiwara Norizane.
- (Note: on this commentary edition, at the head of each volume, outside the border frame, is inscribed "Donated by Uesugi, Governor of Awa, Norizane." After each volume is inscribed "Not permitted to leave the school beyond the gate." On the outer frame is also "For public use of the Ashikaga School.")
- (Note: among the commentary volumes above, the *Zhouyi* (*Yijing*) is inscribed "Donated by Uesugi, Assistant Director of the Right Capital Office, Norichika." Probably Norizane's set had been lost, and Norichika made up the deficiency.)
Summary:
In the first intercalary month of 1439, Uesugi Norizane donated a set of the Five Classics with commentaries to the Zen-monk-run Ashikaga School and issued rules forbidding its removal, lending, pawning or sale. The *Zhouyi* volumes were later supplied by Uesugi Norichika, apparently to replace a lost original.

Volume_Info: 御文庫ノ設ハ／（三擡）東照大君（德川家康）、駿府御在城ノ時ニ始マル。林道春信勝（羅山）、ソノ管鑰ヲ掌トルコト、載テソノ年譜ニ見ユ。慶長十九年七月、駿府ヨリ／（三擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ニ御書籍三十部ヲ賜フ。コノ時ニ、道春ト與安法印宗哲ト、連署ノ書アリ。江戸ヨリモ、永喜（林東舟）ト閑齋法印トノ答簡アリ。是ヲモテ考フレハ、與安法印モマタ、道春ト共ニ典籍ヲ司トリシナルヘシ。當時江戸御文庫ノコト、今詳ニシカタシ〈永喜、初名ハ信澄。道春ノ弟ニシテ江城ニ奉仕ス。與安、名ハ宗哲。醫ヲモテ駿府ニ奉仕ス。閑齋ノ履歷、詳ナラス〉。抑慶長元和ノ閒、四方多事ノ日ニ當リテ廣ク典籍ヲ蒐メ、駿府官庫ニ藏メテ、稽古右文ノ用ニ備ヘタマフ。元和二年／（三擡）東照大君薨去ノ後、道春　遺命ヲ奉シテ、（德川）義直卿、（德川）賴宣卿、（德川）賴房卿ニ分チ、日本ノ舊記オヨヒ希世ノ書ハ、江戸ノ御文庫ニ收メシヨシ、信勝カ年譜、駿府日記等ニ載ス。コレヨリ駿府御文庫ハ遂ニ廢シヌ。今御文庫ニ存スル道春ノ御本日記ハ、コノ時ノ目錄ナルニヤ、明據ナシ。寬永十年十二月二十日、奧向勤仕關兵三郞（正成）〈ノチ兵左衞門ト改ム〉、御納戸星合豬左衞門（具枚）、大御番三雲內記（成賢）、西尾加右衞門（正保）ヲモテ、始メテ御書物奉行ニ　命セラル。コレ司籍ノ官ヲ置ル權輿ナリ〈始メテ奉行ヲ　命セラレヽ＊ヲモテ書ス。ソノ餘ハ後ノ履歷ノ條ニ詳ナレハ記セス。モシソノ異常ノ者アレハ特書ス〉。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案スルニ、豬左衞門等カ家譜ニ云フ、寬永十三年丙子／（三擡）仙洞御所ヨリ律令ノ書ヲ求メ給フ。松平伊豆守（信綱）　旨ヲ奉シ、十月鎌倉ノ建長寺、圓覺寺ノ西堂オヨヒ緇徒二十餘人ヲ江戸ノ海禪寺ニ招キ、金澤文庫ノ律令ヲ書寫セシメラレ、林道春（羅山）、林永喜（東舟）コレヲ挍正シ、豬左衞門等ソノ事ヲ奉行ス。マタ十八年庚辰、太田備中守（資宗）　旨ヲ奉シテ、諸家ノ系圖ヲ撰フ。豬左衞門等、ソノ席ノ奉行タリト云フ。今採錄シテ考據ニ備フ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案スルニ: "Respectfully examining [the matter]:"
- 豬左衞門等カ家譜ニ云フ: "The family genealogy of Inoza'emon (豬左衞門) and his kin says:"
- 寬永十三年丙子: "In the 13th year of Kan'ei, the hinoe-ne year (1636),"
- （三擡）仙洞御所ヨリ律令ノ書ヲ求メ給フ: "(the text is raised three spaces here as a mark of honor) from the Sentō Palace (the Retired Emperor's residence), [he] deigned to request books of the ritsuryō (legal codes)."
- 松平伊豆守（信綱）旨ヲ奉シ: "Matsudaira, Lord of Izu (Nobutsuna), receiving the command,"
- 十月鎌倉ノ建長寺、圓覺寺ノ西堂オヨヒ緇徒二十餘人ヲ江戸ノ海禪寺ニ招キ: "in the tenth month summoned to Kaizen-ji in Edo the 'western hall' senior monks of Kenchō-ji and Engaku-ji in Kamakura, together with more than twenty black-robed monks,"
- 金澤文庫ノ律令ヲ書寫セシメラレ: "and had them copy the ritsuryō held in the Kanazawa Bunko;"
- 林道春（羅山）、林永喜（東舟）コレヲ挍正シ: "Hayashi Dōshun (Razan) and Hayashi Eiki (Tōshū) collated and corrected it;"
- 豬左衞門等ソノ事ヲ奉行ス: "Inoza'emon and the others administered that undertaking."
- マタ十八年庚辰: "Again, in the 18th year [of Kan'ei], the kanoe-tatsu year (1641),"
- 太田備中守（資宗）旨ヲ奉シテ、諸家ノ系圖ヲ撰フ: "Ōta, Lord of Bitchū (Sukemune), receiving the command, compiled the genealogies of the various houses."
- 豬左衞門等、ソノ席ノ奉行タリト云フ: "Inoza'emon and the others are said to have been the administrators of that assembly/office."
- 今採錄シテ考據ニ備フ: "Now I select and record this, to provide for reference and evidence."
Summary:
According to the family record of Inoza'emon and others, in 1636 (Kan'ei 13) Matsudaira Nobutsuna, responding to a request for legal codes from the Retired Emperor's palace, had monks from Kamakura temples copy the ritsuryō manuscripts of the Kanazawa Bunko at Kaizen-ji in Edo, with the Hayashi scholars proofreading and Inoza'emon's family overseeing the work, and the same family later administered the 1641 compilation of daimyo genealogies, which the annotator records as evidence.

Volume_Info: 五月、伊豫守（本多忠統）　命ヲ傳ヘテ、寬文、貞享、正德ノ御朱印副本ヲ、平川口御櫓ニ移ス〈近年新收ノ書多ク、御庫ニ充牣スルヲモテ、請フトコロヲ允セラルヽナリ〉。
二月十一日、享保、延享中ノ御朱印副本ヲ、例ニヨリテ平川口渡御櫓ヘ轉置ス。
六月十一日、今度御朱印ノ副本收貯ノ命アリ。ヨリテ寶曆中ノ御朱印ヲ、平川口渡御多門ヘ移サンコトヲ、若年寄靑山大膳亮（幸完）ヘ言ス。十八日、ソノ請ヒヲ許サル。
七月十一日、御朱印副本、平川口渡御多門ヨリ、百人組番所後二重御櫓ヘ轉置ス。
右／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）御前ノ書也。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、本草綱目、林信勝（羅山）、慶長十二年　命ヲ奉シテ長崎ニ赴キ、歸ルニ當リテ此等ノ書ヲ獻スルコト、家傳ニ存スト云フ。則此書ナリヤ。又駿府日記ニ、慶長十八（九）年四月二十八日、本草綱目ヲ江戸ニ賜フトアリ。信勝所獻ノ本ナリヤ、亦別本ナリヤ、今詳ニスルコトアタハス。
Literal_English_Translation:
謹案ニ (Respectfully, upon consideration / "I humbly note:") ―
本草綱目、 (the *Bencao gangmu* [Honzō kōmoku],)
林信勝（羅山）、 (Hayashi Nobukatsu [Razan],)
慶長十二年 (in Keichō 12 [1607],)
命ヲ奉シテ (receiving an order / acting on a command,)
長崎ニ赴キ、 (went to Nagasaki,)
歸ルニ當リテ (and at the time of returning,)
此等ノ書ヲ獻スルコト、 (the presenting of these books [to the shogun/Ieyasu],)
家傳ニ存スト云フ。 (is said to be preserved in the family tradition.)
則 (Then,)
此書ナリヤ。 (is this the book in question?)
又 (Moreover,)
駿府日記ニ、 (in the *Sunpu nikki*,)
慶長十八（九）年 (in Keichō 18 [sic; (or 19)],)
四月二十八日、 (on the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month,)
本草綱目ヲ (the *Honzō kōmoku*)
江戸ニ賜フ (was bestowed upon Edo)
トアリ。 (so it is recorded.)
信勝所獻ノ本ナリヤ、 (Is it the copy that Nobukatsu presented?)
亦別本ナリヤ、 (or again, is it a different copy?)
今 (at present)
詳ニスルコトアタハス。 (it cannot be determined in detail.)

Notes: The date in the Sunpu diary is given with a parenthetical correction "(九)" in the source, so the year is uncertain (Keichō 18 or 19). "Edo" here likely refers to the shogunal seat/Hidetada's court. The subject of 獻スル (presenting) is understood to be Nobukatsu to Ieyasu.
Summary:
The annotator records that, according to Hayashi Razan's family tradition, he brought back the *Bencao gangmu* from Nagasaki in 1607 and presented it, while the *Sunpu nikki* notes a copy being given to Edo on the 28th day of the 4th month of Keichō 18/19, but whether these were the same copy or different ones cannot now be established.

Volume_Info: 慶長十年、／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）、足利學ノ三要（閑室元佶）ニ　旨有リテ印行令メラルヽ、活字版ノ一也。其始末、孔子家語ノ條ニ詳ナリ。鹿苑ノ（西笑）承兌カ跋ニ云、頃蒙／（双擡）大將軍〈御諱〉公鈞命印行周易、其志要弘聖道於萬年トアリ。此本／（双擡）有德大君（德川吉宗）御前ニ置レシヲ、後御小納戸ヨリ御庫ニ移サル。是ヨリ後、享保中、御小納戸ヨリ出ルト云モノ、皆コノ類也。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、昆陽漫錄〈靑木文藏敦＊著ス。〉ニ、慶長官刻ノ家語、易經ヲ得テ官ニ上ルト云ヘルハ、則此書ナルヘシ。一タヒ官ニ逸セシヲ、靑木文藏是ヲ獻シテ、再ヒ其舊ヲ補フモノナリ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ ("Respectfully, I consider/note that")
- 昆陽漫錄〈靑木文藏敦＊著ス。〉ニ ("in the *Konyō manroku* [written by Aoki Bunzō Atsushi; the ＊ is a mark in the source text]")
- 慶長官刻ノ家語、易經ヲ得テ官ニ上ルト云ヘルハ ("the statement that he obtained the Keichō-era officially printed *Kego* [Confucius's *Jiayu*] and *Ekikyō* [Book of Changes] and presented them to the government")
- 則此書ナルヘシ ("must be, namely, this very book")
- 一タヒ官ニ逸セシヲ ("having once been lost from official [government] holdings")
- 靑木文藏是ヲ獻シテ ("Aoki Bunzō presented this")
- 再ヒ其舊ヲ補フモノナリ ("and it is a thing that once more made up for the old [lost] holdings")

Note: the phrasing 家語、易經 lists two titles, so "this book" is probably one of the two. The excerpt does not say which.
Summary:
The cataloguer notes that this Keichō-era official edition is probably the one that Aoki Bunzō (Aoki Konyō) says in his *Konyō manroku* he obtained and presented to the shogunate, which restored a copy that had earlier been lost from the government collection.

Volume_Info: 淸原秀賢、宋板ヲ影寫セルナリ。卷二十二ノ後ニ、右一策防州山口神光寺住僧果明、在洛閒雇筆了、慶長四年仲春吏部淸原押字ト記セリ。又卷三十九ノ後ニ、右一册以／（双擡）內府〈御諱〉公ノ本、課朝鮮文士鄭鴻業令謄寫者也、于時文祿三年戊戌臘月吏部秀賢ト記セリ。每卷、淸原宣賢、淸門之統學、安太史平叔、司天臺、松本氏圖書記等ノ印記アリ。此書、舊ト淸家ノ藏本ナリシカ、後轉シテ、安部家＊ノ收藏トナル。松本氏、其人ヲ考ヘス。秀賢ハ、船橋式部太輔＊、宣賢ハ、其子大炊助（秀雄）ナリ。慶長十九年九月七日、宣賢駿府ニ於テ始メテ／（双擡）神祖（德川家康）ニ見エ奉リ、父秀賢カ遺物トシテ三代實錄五十卷ヲ獻スト、駿府記ニ見エタルハ、卽此人ナリ。此書、久シク民閒ニ散シ書賈ノ手ニ落タルヲ、／（双擡）神祖ノ御本ヲ謄寫ストアルヲ以テ、今其原本ノ御庫ニ佚スルカ爲ニ、林衡建言シテ、享和二年七月、收ム。
韓板活字ニシテ、韓人ノ藏本ナリ。來歷詳カナラス。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、惺窩行狀ニ、慶長五年侍／（双擡）源君（德川家康）、讀東萊十七史トアリ。然レハ此書、御本日記ニ載セスト雖トモ、駿府御文庫本ナルモ亦知ルヘカラス。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ: "Respectfully, I consider / on respectful examination,"
- 惺窩行狀ニ: "in the *Seika Gyōjō* (the 'Record of the Conduct' of Fujiwara Seika),"
- 慶長五年: "in Keichō 5 (1600),"
- 侍／(双擡)源君(德川家康): "[he] attended upon the Lord Minamoto (Tokugawa Ieyasu) [the text has a line break and a double-raised honorific space before the name]"
- 讀東萊十七史トアリ: "and read the 'Tōrai Seventeen Histories' – so it is written."
- 然レハ: "That being so,"
- 此書: "this book,"
- 御本日記ニ載セスト雖トモ: "although it is not recorded in the *Gohon nikki* (the diary or register of the shogunal books),"
- 駿府御文庫本ナルモ: "that it may have been a book of the Sunpu Bunko (the honorable library at Sunpu),"
- 亦知ルヘカラス: "also cannot be known (i.e., it cannot be ruled out)."
Summary:
The annotator argues that, because the *Seika Gyōjō* says Fujiwara Seika read the *Tōrai Seventeen Histories* in attendance on Tokugawa Ieyasu in 1600, this book may have belonged to Ieyasu's Sunpu Bunko collection even though the *Gohon nikki* does not list it.

Volume_Info: 元和二年正月／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）、活字ノ便ナルヲ以テ、駿府ニ於テ別ニ銅字數萬ヲ製セラレ、此書ヲ刷印令メラル。畔柳壽學、林道春（羅山）、釋（以心）崇傳等其事ニ預ル。後ニ銅字ヲ紀伊家ニ傳與セラレ、今ニ存スト云フ。／（双擡）有德大君（德川吉宗）、大統ヲ繼キタマフニ及ヒテ、銅板刷印ノ羣書治要、大藏一覽等、數部紀府ニ存スルヲ以テ、元文五年七月、其二部ヲ御庫ニ收メラル。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、林信勝年譜元和元年、赴駿府、奉　旨覽監羣書治要、大藏一覽開板之事トアルハ、此時ノ事ニシテ、初メ三要ニ賜ハリシ木板ニアラス。又元和二年、／（双擡）大神君棄羣臣、信勝配分官庫御書、附義直卿、賴宣卿、賴房卿之家臣トアリ。羣書治要、大藏一覽等、多ク紀府ニ存スルモ、其故ナルヘシ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ ("Respectfully considering this:") 
- 林信勝年譜元和元年、赴駿府、 ("the chronology of Hayashi Nobukatsu says that in Genna 1 [1615] he went to Sunpu,")
- 奉旨覽監羣書治要、大藏一覽開板之事トアルハ、 ("and, receiving an order, he inspected and supervised the *Gunsho Chiyō*; and the matter of the *Daizō Ichiran* being block-printed. What is recorded as this")
- 此時ノ事ニシテ、 ("is a matter of this time,")
- 初メ三要ニ賜ハリシ木板ニアラス。 ("and is not the wooden printing material that was originally granted to Sanyō.")
- 又元和二年、 ("Further, in Genna 2 [1616],")
- 大神君棄羣臣、 ("when the Great Divine Lord [Ieyasu] abandoned his assembled retainers [i.e., died] (the 'double raising' note marks honorific spacing),")
- 信勝配分官庫御書、 ("Nobukatsu apportioned the books of the official storehouse,")
- 附義直卿、賴宣卿、賴房卿之家臣トアリ。 ("and attached them to the retainers of Lords Yoshinao, Yorinobu, and Yorifusa, so it says.")
- 羣書治要、大藏一覽等、 ("The *Gunsho Chiyō*, *Daizō Ichiran*, and the like,")
- 多ク紀府ニ存スルモ、 ("exist in large numbers in the Kii domain (Kishū house);")
- 其故ナルヘシ。 ("that is probably the reason.")
Summary:
The annotator argues that the 1615 Sunpu printing work of Hayashi Nobukatsu was distinct from the wooden printing material first given to Sanyō, and that after Ieyasu's death in 1616 Nobukatsu distributed the shogunal storehouse books among the Owari, Kii, and Mito lords' households, which explains why many copies, such as the *Gunsho Chiyō* and *Daizō Ichiran*, survive in the Kii collection.

Volume_Info:
足利學校考
下野足利學ハ、承和六年、小野篁其國司タリシ時草創スト云ヒ、或ハ篁カ家塾ナリト云ヒ、或ハ天長九年八月、篁敕ヲ奉テ草創スト〈日本史ニ相傳、下野足利學校篁嘗讀書處、上杉憲實創爲學校、聖廟傍有一室、安置篁木主、今見存焉〉。大草紙ニ、承和九年、篁陸奧ノ守トナルヲ以テ廢スト云。文德實錄ニ、承和六年春正月、遂捍詔爲庶人、配流隱岐國トアリ。又日本史ニ、小野篁身奉綸旨、出使外境、而稱病不行、準據律條、可處絞刑、今特宥死罪一等、處之遠流、因免爲庶人、竄于隱岐トアレハ、其國司タリシトキ創立ト云フ、亦陸奧ノ守トナルヲ以テ廢スト云フ、皆誤ナルヘシ。年代綿邈ニシテ、其詳ナルヲ知ルヘカラス。又大草紙ニ、應仁元年、長尾爲景カ舊蹟存スルヲ以テ、今ノ所ニ移スト云〈爲景一作景久〉。文明中、釋快元、儒釋同一ノ學ヲ以テ中興ス。永享中、上杉憲實再興シ、釋菜ノ例ヲ行ヒ、生徒ノ庖廩ヲ次ス。又五經注疏等ノ書ヲ收ム。其子憲忠、其子憲房、相ヒ繼テ寄進ノ書アリ。其書今現存ス。慶長中、／神祖（德川家康）菜地ヲ　賜ヒ、又三要（閑室元佶）ニ活字十餘萬ヲ　賜フテ、剏メテ孔子家語ヲ刷印シ、繼キテ周易、貞觀政要、七書、東鑑等ヲ印行ス。三要及ヒ鹿苑ノ（西笑）承兌等ニ、跋語ヲ書セ令ラル。是ヲ慶長活字板、復ハ足利本ト云フ。林恕（鵝峯）カ續本朝通鑑、其顚末ヲ記セリ。左ニ附錄シ孝槪＊ニ示セリ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP:
永享十一年閏正月、憲實納五經注疏於下野國足利學校。傳稱、足利學者、小野篁家塾也。中葉以來、僧徒住焉。然不稱長老和尙、而稱先生、以敎授兒童。且有求者、講五經及六韜等。或曰、（足利）尊氏曾祈勝軍之事於足利學校、稱有驗。而招京師儒官管之。其人＊水土之變、而不幾早世。自是儒官厭東行而不來、故禪徒窺文字者領之云。
又學校有憲實文狀〈原書係諺語〉。
凡漢土自國學至鄕校、非儒者無司業。聞綿竹惟以僧爲之主。今本朝州學存者僅有數焉。率亦以僧爲之主、野之＊爲最。古者＊曰、畛服而爲縫腋之行、何乖戾甚。雖然文字敎授、有庶幾焉。故我以五經注疏本若干卷、安置于學舎。自今講習無怠、則文化之行、自家達于鄕、達于州、達于國天下、指日而可竢矣。嗟夫寶惜珍藏、壽齊金石。主者思之。
又有條目一通。其一曰、收蓄之固、其扃鑰針滕、勿浪借與人。若有志於披閱者、就舎內、看一册畢、可輙送還、不許將歸出閫外。其二曰、主事者進退時、新舊兩人相對、撿定每部卷數、而後可交代。其三曰、借讀者勿以丹墨加妄句、勿令紙背生毛、勿觸寒具手。其四曰、夏月梅雨濕糊櫃蒸、則至風凉可曝乾之、勿中屋瓦之漏濕。至冬月、則可嚴火禁之備。其五曰、或質于庫、或鬻于市、或爲穿窬所獲、則罪莫大焉。永享十一年己未閏正月初吉、前房州剌＊史藤原憲實。
〈此注疏本、每册首閫外有上杉安房守憲實寄進、每册後有不許學校出閫外、又郭上有足利學公用。〉
〈右注疏本中周易、題上杉右京亮憲忠寄進。蓋憲實所置之逸、憲忠補之乎。〉
Remarks_Notes: ＊考槪，＊依水土之變，＊野之學，＊言者，＊刺史
Literal_English_Translation:
[Eikyō 11 (1439), intercalary first month] Norizane deposited the *Wujing zhushu* (Commentaries and Subcommentaries on the Five Classics) in the Ashikaga School of Shimotsuke Province.

Tradition says the Ashikaga school was the family school of Ono no Takamura. From the middle period onward, Buddhist monks lived there. They were not called "elder" or "reverend" but "sensei," and they taught children. Moreover, for those who sought it, they lectured on the Five Classics, the *Liutao*, and the like.

Someone says: Ashikaga Takauji once prayed at the Ashikaga school for victory in war and it was said to be efficacious. He then summoned a Confucian official from the capital to administer it. That man [≈ was afflicted by] the change of climate and soon died young. From then on, Confucian officials disliked going east and did not come, so it is said that Zen followers who had a glimpse of letters took charge.

Also, the school has Norizane's written statement (the original is in vernacular speech).

"Generally, in China, from the national academy down to village schools, no one but a Confucian holds the post of director. I hear that at Mianzhu only a monk is made head. Of the provincial schools surviving in our country today, there are only a few. Most likewise make a monk their head, and the one in Shimotsuke [text damaged: ＊] is foremost. The ancients [damaged: ＊] said: 'Wearing a distinct (monastic) garb yet acting as one in the wide-sleeved robe (of a Confucian), how very perverse!' Even so, in the teaching of letters there is something one may hope for. Therefore I place a number of volumes of the Five Classics commentary edition in the school building. If from now on lecture and study are without slackness, then the spread of civilizing culture will reach from the household to the village, to the province, to the state and all under heaven, and one can await it by pointing to the day. Alas! Treasure it, cherish it, store it away; may its longevity equal metal and stone. Let the one in charge think on this."

There is also one set of regulations.
1. Keep the storage secure, with its bolts, locks, and binding cords; do not carelessly lend to people. If someone wishes to read, he is to go inside the building, view one volume, and promptly return it when done; carrying it out beyond the threshold is not permitted.
2. When the administrator takes or leaves office, the old and new men face each other, inspect and fix the number of volumes in each work, and only then may they hand over.
3. Borrowers must not add red or black ink with arbitrary punctuation, must not let fuzz arise on the back of the paper, and must not touch the books with hands that have handled fried dough.
4. In summer, when the plum rains dampen the paste and the cases steam, air-dry the books at the time of cool breezes, and do not let leaks from the roof tiles wet them. In winter, make strict preparations against fire.
5. If they are pawned at a storehouse, sold in the market, or taken by thieves, the guilt is greatest.

Eikyō 11, year *kinoto-hitsuji* [sic: 己未], intercalary first month, first day. Former governor of Bōshū (Awa) [text: 刺＊史, with a damaged character], Fujiwara Norizane.

(Note: In each volume, outside the frame at the head, is "Donated by Uesugi, Awa-no-kami Norizane." After each volume is "Not permitted to take out of the school beyond the threshold." On the frame is also "Ashikaga School, public use.")

(Note: Among the commentary volumes above, the *Zhouyi* is inscribed "Donated by Uesugi, Ukyō-no-suke Noritada." Probably a volume Norizane had placed was lost and Noritada supplied it.)
Summary:
In 1439 Uesugi Norizane donated a set of the Five Classics commentary-subcommentary editions to the Ashikaga School, each volume marked as his gift and stamped as school property not to leave the premises, with five regulations against lending, loss, damage, pawning, sale, and theft. The *Zhouyi* volumes were later supplied by Uesugi Noritada to replace a lost set.

Volume_Info: 文化六年二月廿八日、林大學頭衡（述齋）及ヒ成島邦之助（東岳）、讓（筑山）等、　旨ヲ奉シテ編輯ス。上ハ／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）ニ始マリ、下ハ／（双擡）浚明大君（德川家治）ニ至ルマテ、十代ノ御事蹟ヲ備載シ、御言行ノ如キハ別ニ御附錄ヲ附ス。嘉永二年十月九日、御庫ニ收ム。
慶長十九年十月二十七日、／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）、林道春（羅山）、僧（以心）崇傳ニ　命セラレ、五山ノ僧侶ヲシテ、南禪寺金地院ニ於テ諸家ノ記錄ヲ寫サシム。各三部ヲ寫シ、一部ハ／（双擡）禁裏ヘ獻セラレ、其餘ハ江府、駿府ニ收貯セラル。此書亦其一也。此後、／（双擡）禁裏仙洞及諸家ヨリ出ルト云モノ三十三種、皆慶長ノ寫本ナリ。事ハ林信勝年譜、崇傳日記及ヒ駿府日記等ニ詳載セリ。
卷後ニ、右一册予遂書寫功者也、時慶長十六神龍院梵舜押字トアリ。梵舜ハ吉田ノ社僧ニテ、／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）ニ寵遇アリシ者ナリ。駿府日記ニ、慶長十六年八月十六日、吉田神龍院梵舜進藤原氏系圖一卷トアルハ、卽チ是書ナルヘシ。
舊說ニ云フ、天正十八年、豐臣秀吉公小田原ノ北條氏政ヲ征伐ノ時、黑田勘解由孝高〈後薙髪號如水〉ヲシテ和平ヲ整ヘシム。氏直、其謝儀トシテ佩刀〈號日光一文字〉、白貝〈軍陣所用〉、書本東鑑ヲ以テ孝高ニ贈ル。其子筑前守長政ニ至リテ、東鑑ヲ／（双擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ニ獻スト云フ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案スルニ、黑田家譜云フ、慶長九年三月、備前守長政父勘解由孝高沒後、遺物トシテ／（単擡）東照大君（德川家康）ニ備前長光ノ刀、木丸ノ茶壺ヲ獻シ、／（単擡）台德大君ニ東鑑一部ヲ獻スト云フ、卽是ナリ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案スルニ — "Respectfully considering/examining (this matter),"
- 黑田家譜云フ — "the *Kuroda Kafu* (Kuroda family genealogy) says:"
- 慶長九年三月 — "In the third month of Keichō 9 (1604),"
- 備前守長政、父勘解由孝高沒後 — "Nagamasa, Bizen-no-kami, after the death of his father Kageyu (Kanjo) Yoshitaka [Takataka],"
- 遺物トシテ — "as bequeathed articles (keepsakes of the deceased),"
- （単擡）東照大君（德川家康）ニ — "[line-raised for honor] to the Great Lord Tōshō (Tokugawa Ieyasu),"
- 備前長光ノ刀、木丸ノ茶壺ヲ獻シ — "presented a sword by Nagamitsu of Bizen and a tea jar of 'Kimaru' [name as given], and"
- （単擡）台德大君ニ — "[line-raised for honor] to the Great Lord Taitoku (Tokugawa Hidetada)"
- 東鑑一部ヲ獻スト云フ — "presented one set of the *Azuma Kagami*, it is said."
- 卽是ナリ — "This is precisely the matter (i.e., the very item in question)."
Summary:
In 1604, after the death of his father Kuroda Yoshitaka, Kuroda Nagamasa presented a complete set of the *Azuma Kagami* to Tokugawa Hidetada as a bequest from the deceased, together with a Nagamitsu sword and a tea jar given to Ieyasu, and the annotator identifies this as the origin of the book at hand.

Volume_Info: 御文庫ノ設ハ／（三擡）東照大君（德川家康）、駿府御在城ノ時ニ始マル。林道春信勝（羅山）、ソノ管鑰ヲ掌トルコト、載テソノ年譜ニ見ユ。慶長十九年七月、駿府ヨリ／（三擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ニ御書籍三十部ヲ賜フ。コノ時ニ、道春ト與安法印宗哲ト、連署ノ書アリ。江戸ヨリモ、永喜（林東舟）ト閑齋法印トノ答簡アリ。是ヲモテ考フレハ、與安法印モマタ、道春ト共ニ典籍ヲ司トリシナルヘシ。當時江戸御文庫ノコト、今詳ニシカタシ〈永喜、初名ハ信澄。道春ノ弟ニシテ江城ニ奉仕ス。與安、名ハ宗哲。醫ヲモテ駿府ニ奉仕ス。閑齋ノ履歷、詳ナラス〉。抑慶長元和ノ閒、四方多事ノ日ニ當リテ廣ク典籍ヲ蒐メ、駿府官庫ニ藏メテ、稽古右文ノ用ニ備ヘタマフ。元和二年／（三擡）東照大君薨去ノ後、道春　遺命ヲ奉シテ、（德川）義直卿、（德川）賴宣卿、（德川）賴房卿ニ分チ、日本ノ舊記オヨヒ希世ノ書ハ、江戸ノ御文庫ニ收メシヨシ、信勝カ年譜、駿府日記等ニ載ス。コレヨリ駿府御文庫ハ遂ニ廢シヌ。今御文庫ニ存スル道春ノ御本日記ハ、コノ時ノ目錄ナルニヤ、明據ナシ。寬永十年十二月二十日、奧向勤仕關兵三郞（正成）〈ノチ兵左衞門ト改ム〉、御納戸星合豬左衞門（具枚）、大御番三雲內記（成賢）、西尾加右衞門（正保）ヲモテ、始メテ御書物奉行ニ　命セラル。コレ司籍ノ官ヲ置ル權輿ナリ〈始メテ奉行ヲ　命セラレヽ＊ヲモテ書ス。ソノ餘ハ後ノ履歷ノ條ニ詳ナレハ記セス。モシソノ異常ノ者アレハ特書ス〉。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案スルニ、豬左衞門等カ家譜ニ云フ、寬永十三年丙子／（三擡）仙洞御所ヨリ律令ノ書ヲ求メ給フ。松平伊豆守（信綱）　旨ヲ奉シ、十月鎌倉ノ建長寺、圓覺寺ノ西堂オヨヒ緇徒二十餘人ヲ江戸ノ海禪寺ニ招キ、金澤文庫ノ律令ヲ書寫セシメラレ、林道春（羅山）、林永喜（東舟）コレヲ挍正シ、豬左衞門等ソノ事ヲ奉行ス。マタ十八年庚辰、太田備中守（資宗）　旨ヲ奉シテ、諸家ノ系圖ヲ撰フ。豬左衞門等、ソノ席ノ奉行タリト云フ。今採錄シテ考據ニ備フ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案スルニ: "Respectfully considering this,"
- 豬左衞門等カ家譜ニ云フ: "the family genealogy of Inozaemon [reading of the name uncertain] and others says:"
- 寬永十三年丙子: "In Kan'ei 13 (1636), the year hinoe-ne,"
- （三擡）仙洞御所ヨリ: "from the Sentō Palace, the residence of the retired emperor [the "three-raised" note marks the line raised in the original as a sign of honor],"
- 律令ノ書ヲ求メ給フ: "he (the retired emperor) requested books of the ritsuryō (legal codes)."
- 松平伊豆守（信綱）旨ヲ奉シ: "Matsudaira Izu-no-kami (Nobutsuna), receiving the directive,"
- 十月鎌倉ノ建長寺、圓覺寺ノ西堂オヨヒ緇徒二十餘人ヲ江戸ノ海禪寺ニ招キ: "in the tenth month summoned the seidō (senior retired abbots) of Kenchōji and Engakuji in Kamakura, together with over twenty black-robed monks, to Kaizenji in Edo,"
- 金澤文庫ノ律令ヲ書寫セシメラレ: "and had them copy the ritsuryō of the Kanazawa Bunko;"
- 林道春（羅山）、林永喜（東舟）コレヲ挍正シ: "Hayashi Dōshun (Razan) and Hayashi Eiki (Tōshū) collated and corrected it;"
- 豬左衞門等ソノ事ヲ奉行ス: "Inozaemon and others administered the affair as magistrates."
- マタ十八年庚辰: "Again, in the 18th year [Kan'ei 18; but the cyclical sign 庚辰 matches Kan'ei 17, 1640, so the source has a discrepancy],"
- 太田備中守（資宗）旨ヲ奉シテ: "Ōta Bitchū-no-kami (Sukemune), receiving a directive,"
- 諸家ノ系圖ヲ撰フ: "compiled the genealogies of the various families."
- 豬左衞門等、ソノ席ノ奉行タリト云フ: "Inozaemon and others are said to have served as magistrates of that session."
- 今採錄シテ考據ニ備フ: "Now I have excerpted and recorded this, to provide material for reference and verification."
Summary:
According to the Inozaemon family genealogy, in 1636 the retired emperor requested ritsuryō books, so Matsudaira Nobutsuna had Kamakura monks copy the Kanazawa Bunko ritsuryō manuscripts at Kaizenji in Edo, with Hayashi Razan and Eiki collating the copies and Inozaemon and others administering the work, and the same men later oversaw the compilation of family genealogies.

Volume_Info: 十二月二十日、／（三擡）東照大君（德川家康）位記口宣ノ寫、御庫ニ收ムヘキヨシ、老中松平左近將監（乘邑）コレヲ達ス。若年寄板倉佐渡守（勝淸）侍座セリ〈コレヨリサキ、桂山三郞左衞門（義樹）ニ　命セラレル。紅葉山　御宮ニ入リテ謄寫スルトコロナリ〉。
十月六日、慶長中／（三擡）東照大君（德川家康）ヨリ／（三擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ヘ御讓リノ御書籍三十部ヲ査檢スヘキヨシ、攝津守（堀田正敦）達ス。同月十一日、仙藏（成島峯雄）三十部ノ御書籍有無、異同等ヲ錄シ、本書ニソヘテ攝津守ヘ呈ス。
右新井君美（白石）侍講ノ時　披覽シタマフ書也ト云。別ニ、貞享板近思錄集解有リ。（德川）齊順卿、紀藩ニ入ラルヽ時賜ハレリ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、右四部ノ書ハ、櫻田邸ノ書目ニ記スルノミニシテ、其事ヲ詳ニ載スルモノ無シト雖モ、局中ニ存スル所ノ始末ヲ記セル片紙ト、元文中、參政ニ進言セシ時ノ書トヲ以テ考ルニ、當時／御前ニ置レシ所ニシテ、諸本ト同フスヘキニアラス。因リテ、恭ク　御手澤本ノ後ニ附錄ス。且享保中、御小納戸ヨリ移サルヽ所ノ御本、又謠曲本ノ如キモ、裝𧝒函櫝ノ美ヲ極ムルヲ以テ考レハ、共ニ／御手澤ノ物ナリヤ、知ルヘカラス。今倂セテ附錄ス。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ: "Respectfully considering the matter,"
- 右四部ノ書ハ: "the four works listed above"
- 櫻田邸ノ書目ニ記スルノミニシテ: "are merely recorded in the book catalogue of the Sakurada residence,"
- 其事ヲ詳ニ載スルモノ無シト雖モ: "and although there is no document recording the circumstances in detail,"
- 局中ニ存スル所ノ始末ヲ記セル片紙ト: "judging from a scrap of paper kept within the office that records the particulars,"
- 元文中、參政ニ進言セシ時ノ書トヲ以テ考ルニ: "together with the document from when it was put to a senior councillor (rōjū) during the Genbun era,"
- 當時／御前ニ置レシ所ニシテ: "they were kept in the (shogun's) presence at that time,"
- 諸本ト同フスヘキニアラス: "and so ought not to be treated the same as the other books."
- 因リテ、恭ク　御手澤本ノ後ニ附錄ス: "Therefore, with reverence, they are appended after the books bearing the (shogun's) personal touch."
- 且享保中、御小納戸ヨリ移サルヽ所ノ御本: "Furthermore, the books transferred from the Oko-nando (the shogun's attendants) during the Kyōhō era,"
- 又謠曲本ノ如キモ: "and likewise such items as the Noh-libretto (utai) volumes,"
- 裝𧝒函櫝ノ美ヲ極ムルヲ以テ考レハ: "judging from the utmost beauty of their bindings and boxes/cases,"
- 共ニ／御手澤ノ物ナリヤ、知ルヘカラス: "may both be items of the (shogun's) personal handling? This cannot be known."
- 今倂セテ附錄ス: "Now they are appended together."
Summary:
The compiler explains that four works known only from the Sakurada residence's catalogue, which an office memo and a Genbun-era submission to a senior councillor show were kept in the shogun's presence, are appended after the "personally handled" books, together with the Kyōhō-era volumes transferred from the Oko-nando and the finely bound Noh-libretto books, which may also have been the shogun's own.

Volume_Info: 淸原秀賢、宋板ヲ影寫セルナリ。卷二十二ノ後ニ、右一策防州山口神光寺住僧果明、在洛閒雇筆了、慶長四年仲春吏部淸原押字ト記セリ。又卷三十九ノ後ニ、右一册以／（双擡）內府〈御諱〉公ノ本、課朝鮮文士鄭鴻業令謄寫者也、于時文祿三年戊戌臘月吏部秀賢ト記セリ。每卷、淸原宣賢、淸門之統學、安太史平叔、司天臺、松本氏圖書記等ノ印記アリ。此書、舊ト淸家ノ藏本ナリシカ、後轉シテ、安部家＊ノ收藏トナル。松本氏、其人ヲ考ヘス。秀賢ハ、船橋式部太輔＊、宣賢ハ、其子大炊助（秀雄）ナリ。慶長十九年九月七日、宣賢駿府ニ於テ始メテ／（双擡）神祖（德川家康）ニ見エ奉リ、父秀賢カ遺物トシテ三代實錄五十卷ヲ獻スト、駿府記ニ見エタルハ、卽此人ナリ。此書、久シク民閒ニ散シ書賈ノ手ニ落タルヲ、／（双擡）神祖ノ御本ヲ謄寫ストアルヲ以テ、今其原本ノ御庫ニ佚スルカ爲ニ、林衡建言シテ、享和二年七月、收ム。
金澤文庫ノ收藏。軸本ニシテ、淸家ノ古譯本ナリ。每卷ノ後ニ、仁平、久壽ヨリ建長ニ至リテ、識語ノ摹アリ。又文應、弘長、文永、弘安、嘉元中、淸原博士以家說授越後守ノ識語及ヒ、應永中、釋怡於相之醉醒軒一覽セルノ識語アリ。初メ駿府御文庫ニ收メラレ、後今ノ御庫ニ收メラル。林信勝（羅山）カ御本日記ニ、此名ヲ列ス。御本日記ハ、駿府御文庫ノ書目ナリ。今其中ニアルモノハ、每每コレヲ書シテ、其書ノ傳來ヲ明ス。

駿府御文庫本ニテ、西三條內府（三條西）實隆公手書ナリ。御本日記、三條殿手書史記四十册ト記セルモノ、是ナリ。每卷ノ後ニ、永正某年某月書寫挍正スト記セリ。又卷七、卷十ノ後ニ、去冬以來凌老眼染惡筆、使諫議羽林郞公條卿摹點了、所謂舊本者、紀傳朱點也、而今爲令易讀、傚江湖之新樣、用朱墨之點云云。永正辛未孟秋上澣、槐陰迍虛子ト記セリ。此書、逍遙院實隆公、元板ヲ影鈔シ、其子稱名院（三條西）公條公ヲシテ、朱墨ノ點ヲ加ヘシムルモノナリ。

元大德九年ノ刊本ニシテ、應德、保安、保元、壽永、建長、弘安、文安年閒古博士識語ノ摹アリ。壽永ノ識語ニ、壽永二年夾鐘二十一日、以說授猶子隆才子、于時夜雨新霽、今日朝覲之行幸也、人皆觀輦路、予獨畱文窗矣、散位敦經トアリ。件ノ本ヲ以テ、大永元年十月二日加點ト、卷三十ノ後ニ記セリ。又文永六年二月十四日天子御讀畢云云、以件天龍寺本加點、于時享祿三年五月二十日都督郞ト記セリ。駿府御文庫本ニシテ、御本日記ニ記セル、前後漢書七十册トアルモノ、是ナリ。
朝鮮板、駿府御文庫本。御本日記ニ、林道春所司、唐書朝鮮板ト云フ、是ナリ。
韓板活字ニシテ、駿府御文庫本ナリ。卷首副葉ニ、嘉靖三十七年十一月、內賜弘文館直提學尹毅中文獻通考一件、命除謝恩、左副承旨臣沈押字トアリ。卷首、宣賜之記ノ印記アリ。コレ又韓ノ賜本ナリ。其內、卷百三十六、卷百三十七ヲ缺ク。享保中　旨アリテ補寫セリ。御本日記ニ載スル、林道春（羅山）所司ノ書也。印記前ニ見エタリ。
韓板活字ニシテ、韓人ノ藏本ナリ。來歷詳カナラス。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、惺窩行狀ニ、慶長五年侍／（双擡）源君（德川家康）、讀東萊十七史トアリ。然レハ此書、御本日記ニ載セスト雖トモ、駿府御文庫本ナルモ亦知ルヘカラス。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ ("Respectfully, I consider:")
- 惺窩行狀ニ ("In the Biographical Record of [Fujiwara] Seika,")
- 慶長五年 ("in Keichō 5 [1600],")
- 侍／（双擡）源君（德川家康） ("he attended Lord Minamoto (Tokugawa Ieyasu). The line break and raised characters are an honorific device.")
- 讀東萊十七史トアリ ("and read the 'Tōrai Seventeen Histories' [Lü Zuqian's Shichijūshi]; so it is written.")
- 然レハ ("If that is so,")
- 此書 ("this book,")
- 御本日記ニ載セスト雖トモ ("even though it is not recorded in the Diary of the Honorable Books (Gohon nikki),")
- 駿府御文庫本ナルモ ("that it was a book of the Sunpu Honorable Library")
- 亦知ルヘカラス ("also cannot be ruled out / cannot be known.")
Summary:
The annotator cites Seika's biography, which says Seika read the "Tōrai Seventeen Histories" before Tokugawa Ieyasu in 1600, to suggest that this book may have belonged to Ieyasu's Sunpu library even though the Gohon nikki does not list it.

Volume_Info: 明官板ニシテ、四旁寬大、紙質潔白ナリ。御本日記ニ載ル所ノ、駿府御文庫本ナリ。

古寫卷軸ニシテ、金澤文庫本ナリ。印記、卷ノ首後ニアリ。御本日記ニ載スル所ノ、駿府御文庫本ナリ。每卷後ニ題識アリ。其文枚擧スヘカラス。建長、康元、正喜＊、正元、文應、建治、嘉元、德治、延慶、文永年閒ニ至ルマテ、淸原敎隆、隆重、賴業、又藤原經雄、俊國、敦周、敦綱、敦經等、依越州使君敎命加點畢トアリ。卷十五、卷十六、卷十八、卷十九、卷二十一、卷二十二、卷二十四ニ、文永中越後守顯時重ネテ書寫挍點スト、手自書スル識語押字アリ。又卷二十八、卷二十九、卷三十ニ、嘉元中越後守貞顯書寫重挍スト、手自書スル識語押字アリ。文永ヨリ今ヲ距ルコト五百餘年、奇書ト云フヘシ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、羣書治要、唐書藝文志雜家ニ入ル。宋史ヨリ以下其書ヲ逸ス。又諸家ノ書目ニ見ル所ナシ。三代實錄貞觀十七年、先是天皇讀羣書治要、至是講竟トアレハ、此書、彼ニ佚シテ我ニ傳フルコト、久シキヲ知ルヘシ。
Literal_English_Translation:
謹案ニ (Respectfully, I note / on careful examination:)
羣書治要、 (the *Qunshu zhiyao* [Jp. *Gunsho chiyō*],)
唐書藝文志雜家ニ入ル。 (is listed under the "Miscellaneous Schools" [雜家] category of the Bibliographical Treatise of the *Tang shu* [New Book of Tang].)
宋史ヨリ以下 (From the *Song shi* [History of Song] onward,)
其書ヲ逸ス。 (this book is lost [no longer recorded].)
又諸家ノ書目ニ見ル所ナシ。 (Moreover, there is nothing to be seen of it in the bibliographic catalogs of the various authorities.)
三代實錄貞觀十七年、 (In the *Nihon Sandai jitsuroku*, Jōgan year 17 [875],)
先是天皇讀羣書治要、 (it says: "Before this, the Emperor had been reading the *Qunshu zhiyao*,)
至是講竟トアレハ、 (and now the lectures [on it] were completed";)
此書、 (therefore, this book—)
彼ニ佚シテ (having been lost in that country [China],)
我ニ傳フルコト、 (it has been transmitted in ours [Japan];)
久シキヲ知ルヘシ。 (one should know that this has been so for a long time.)
Summary:
The annotator argues that the *Qunshu zhiyao*, which disappeared from Chinese records after the Song dynasty, had already been transmitted to and studied in Japan by 875 (as the *Sandai jitsuroku* attests), showing it survived in Japan long after being lost in China.

Volume_Info: 宋槧。金澤文庫ノ收藏ヲ經テ、駿府御文庫本トナル。闕卷ノ所、宋板ヲ影寫シテ補ヘリ。故ニ金澤ノ印記或ハアリ、或ハナシ。御本日記ニ、兌長老本二函ト記セル者、恐ラクハ此本ナルヘシ。補闕卷四百六十至四百六十九、卷五百四十五至五百五十五、卷五百六十六。
寬政中、多紀永壽院元德（藍溪）建白シテ、尾張家ノ藏本ヲ以テ新ニ一通ヲ寫シ、御庫ニ收ム。永壽院ノ次子安道、安肅及ヒ、弟子三人共ニ繕寫シ、永壽院安長（桂山）コレヲ挍正ス。原本ハ駿府御文庫本ニシテ、宋板金澤御文庫本ナリ。半殘缺セルヲ、書本ニテ足成セリ。每册、御本ノ鈐印アリ。又永壽院、別ニ永正年閒ノ古寫本ヲ以テ挍正スト云ヘリ。
慶長中、　命アリテ、五山ノ僧侶ヲシテ書寫令メラルル所ノ一ナリ。御本日記ニ、／（双擡）院御所ヨリ出ルト云フ、則是ナリ。

宋板。大本闊字ニテ、楮墨トモニ完好ナリ。廟諱缺筆セリ。卷一ノ後ニ、左從政郞充贛州州學敎授張之綱覆挍、州學司書蕭鵬挍對、鄕貢進士李大成挍勘トアリテ、刊板ノ年月ヲ載セス。宋時州學ノ監本ナリ。是書、駿府御文庫ヨリ遷サル。卷一後ニ、應永三十四四月三日、寫朱墨畢、重志、卷二後ニ、右卷應永三十四年丁未四月十二日、三更三點、於雲巢西窗寫點畢、重志、卷八後ニ、潛齋點之、卷二十六後ニ、舊本云、安元三年三月五、以文章博士敦周朝臣家本移點挍合畢、正五位下行助敎中原朝臣師直、又應永二十九菊月十一日、寫點畢、鼎子誌之ト記セリ。御本日記ニ、南化本ト題セルモノ是ナリ。僧南化玄興カ所藏ヲ上リシモノナリ。玄興カ印記アリ。

Literal_English_Translation: Respectfully considering [the matter]: the family genealogy of Inozaemon (豬左衞門) and others says: / In the 13th year of Kan'ei, the year bingzi (丙子) [1636], / [honorific three-character raise in the original] the Sentō Palace (the Retired Emperor) requested books of the ritsuryō (律令, legal codes). / Matsudaira Izu-no-kami (Nobutsuna), receiving the command, in the tenth month summoned the seidō (西堂, senior monks) and more than twenty monks (緇徒, "black-robed" ones) of Kenchō-ji and Engaku-ji in Kamakura to Kaizen-ji in Edo, / and had them transcribe the ritsuryō of the Kanazawa Bunko. / Hayashi Dōshun (Razan) and Hayashi Eiki (Tōshū) proofread them, / and Inozaemon and the others administered the affair as magistrates (奉行). / Again, in the 18th year [Kan'ei], the year gengchen (庚辰) [sic: gengchen is the 17th year, 1640; the 18th is xinsi], Ōta Bitchū-no-kami (Sukemune), receiving the command, compiled the genealogies of the various houses. / Inozaemon and the others are said to have been magistrates of that session. / Now I have selected and recorded this, to prepare it for use as evidence and reference.
Summary:
According to the family record of Inozaemon and others, in 1636 the Retired Emperor requested ritsuryō texts, and Matsudaira Nobutsuna had Kamakura monks transcribe the Kanazawa Bunko copies at Kaizen-ji in Edo, with the Hayashi scholars proofreading and Inozaemon's group supervising. The same group later oversaw the shogunate's compilation of genealogies, and the writer records all this as reference evidence.

In Edo-period bibliographic usage this term marks a book as a handwritten transcript. It is distinguished from a printed edition (板本/刊本), from an author's autograph or draft (稿本/自筆本), and from the original exemplar the copy was made from. It is a physical-format label, not a narrative clause.
Summary:
The text is only the two-character format notation "寫本" ("hand-copied manuscript"), so it records nothing about the book's movement, ownership, or acquisition. It says only that this copy is a manuscript transcription, and any provenance would have to come from other colophons, seals, or notes.

Volume_Info: 右／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）御前ノ書也。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、本草綱目、林信勝（羅山）、慶長十二年　命ヲ奉シテ長崎ニ赴キ、歸ルニ當リテ此等ノ書ヲ獻スルコト、家傳ニ存スト云フ。則此書ナリヤ。又駿府日記ニ、慶長十八（九）年四月二十八日、本草綱目ヲ江戸ニ賜フトアリ。信勝所獻ノ本ナリヤ、亦別本ナリヤ、今詳ニスルコトアタハス。
Literal_English_Translation:
謹案ニ (Respectfully, in my consideration/note:) 
本草綱目、 (the *Bencao gangmu*,) 
林信勝（羅山）、 (Hayashi Nobukatsu [Razan],) 
慶長十二年 (in Keichō 12 [1607],) 
命ヲ奉シテ (receiving [a] command,) 
長崎ニ赴キ、 (went to Nagasaki,) 
歸ルニ當リテ (and on the occasion of returning,) 
此等ノ書ヲ獻スルコト、 (the matter of presenting these books,) 
家傳ニ存スト云フ。 (is said to exist in the family tradition.) 
則此書ナリヤ。 (Then, is it this very book?) 
又駿府日記ニ、 (Also, in the *Sunpu nikki*,) 
慶長十八（九）年四月二十八日、 (on the 28th day of the 4th month of Keichō 18 [or 19, per the variant reading],) 
本草綱目ヲ (the *Bencao gangmu*) 
江戸ニ賜フ (was bestowed upon Edo) 
トアリ。 (so it states.) 
信勝所獻ノ本ナリヤ、 (Is it the copy that Nobukatsu presented?) 
亦別本ナリヤ、 (Or again, is it a different copy?) 
今詳ニスルコトアタハス。 (At present, it is not possible to determine in detail.)
Summary:
According to Hayashi Razan's family tradition, he obtained the *Bencao gangmu* in Nagasaki in 1607 and presented it to the shogunate, while the *Sunpu nikki* records a copy being sent to Edo in 1613 (or 1614), but the annotator cannot determine whether these were the same copy or two different ones.

Volume_Info: 右／（双擡）嚴有大君（德川家綱）御前ノ書也。
右新井君美（白石）侍講ノ時　披覽シタマフ書也ト云。別ニ、貞享板近思錄集解有リ。（德川）齊順卿、紀藩ニ入ラルヽ時賜ハレリ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、右四部ノ書ハ、櫻田邸ノ書目ニ記スルノミニシテ、其事ヲ詳ニ載スルモノ無シト雖モ、局中ニ存スル所ノ始末ヲ記セル片紙ト、元文中、參政ニ進言セシ時ノ書トヲ以テ考ルニ、當時／御前ニ置レシ所ニシテ、諸本ト同フスヘキニアラス。因リテ、恭ク　御手澤本ノ後ニ附錄ス。且享保中、御小納戸ヨリ移サルヽ所ノ御本、又謠曲本ノ如キモ、裝𧝒函櫝ノ美ヲ極ムルヲ以テ考レハ、共ニ／御手澤ノ物ナリヤ、知ルヘカラス。今倂セテ附錄ス。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ: "Respectfully I consider / humbly note:"
- 右四部ノ書ハ: "the four works listed above"
- 櫻田邸ノ書目ニ記スルノミニシテ: "are merely entered in the book-catalogue of the Sakurada residence,"
- 其事ヲ詳ニ載スルモノ無シト雖モ: "and although there is no document that records the matter in detail,"
- 局中ニ存スル所ノ始末ヲ記セル片紙ト: "still, from a scrap of paper kept in the office that records the circumstances,"
- 元文中、參政ニ進言セシ時ノ書トヲ以テ考ルニ: "and from the document of the time in the Genbun era (1736–41) when a proposal was made to the councillor(s), judging by these,"
- 當時／御前ニ置レシ所ニシテ: "they were items that at that time were kept in the lord's presence (the honorific break marks respect),"
- 諸本ト同フスヘキニアラス: "and so ought not to be treated the same as the other books."
- 因リテ、恭ク　御手澤本ノ後ニ附錄ス: "Therefore, reverently, I append them after the 'books bearing the lord's own handling' (goshutaku-bon)."
- 且享保中、御小納戸ヨリ移サルヽ所ノ御本: "Moreover, the books transferred during the Kyōhō era (1716–36) from the O-konando (the lord's personal attendants' storage),"
- 又謠曲本ノ如キモ: "and likewise the utai (Noh libretto) books,"
- 裝𧝒函櫝ノ美ヲ極ムルヲ以テ考レハ: "considering that their bindings, mountings, cases and boxes attain the utmost beauty,"
- 共ニ／御手澤ノ物ナリヤ、知ルヘカラス: "it cannot be known whether both groups were items handled by the lord himself."
- 今倂セテ附錄ス: "Now I append them together as well."
Summary:
The compiler explains that four works recorded only in the Sakurada residence's catalogue (and supported by an office memo and a Genbun-era proposal) were kept in the lord's presence, and he therefore appends them, together with the Kyōhō-era books transferred from the O-konando and the finely mounted Noh-libretto volumes, as an appendix after the main section of the lord's personally handled books, though he cannot confirm that all of them were handled by the lord himself.

Volume_Info: 慶長十年、／（双擡）東照大君（德川家康）、足利學ノ三要（閑室元佶）ニ　旨有リテ印行令メラルヽ、活字版ノ一也。其始末、孔子家語ノ條ニ詳ナリ。鹿苑ノ（西笑）承兌カ跋ニ云、頃蒙／（双擡）大將軍〈御諱〉公鈞命印行周易、其志要弘聖道於萬年トアリ。此本／（双擡）有德大君（德川吉宗）御前ニ置レシヲ、後御小納戸ヨリ御庫ニ移サル。是ヨリ後、享保中、御小納戸ヨリ出ルト云モノ、皆コノ類也。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、昆陽漫錄〈靑木文藏敦＊著ス。〉ニ、慶長官刻ノ家語、易經ヲ得テ官ニ上ルト云ヘルハ、則此書ナルヘシ。一タヒ官ニ逸セシヲ、靑木文藏是ヲ獻シテ、再ヒ其舊ヲ補フモノナリ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ (Respectfully, I note / on careful consideration:)
- 昆陽漫錄〈靑木文藏敦＊著ス。〉ニ (In the *Konyō Manroku* [written by Aoki Bunzō, personal name Atsushi; the "＊" is a mark in the original text],)
- 慶長官刻ノ家語、易經ヲ得テ官ニ上ルト云ヘルハ (the statement that he obtained the government-printed Keichō-era *Kego* [Confucian Analects of the School] and *Ekikyō* [Book of Changes] and presented them to the government)
- 則此書ナルヘシ。 (is, namely, probably this very book.)
- 一タヒ官ニ逸セシヲ、 (Having once been lost from the government's holdings,)
- 靑木文藏是ヲ獻シテ、 (Aoki Bunzō presented it,)
- 再ヒ其舊ヲ補フモノナリ。 (and it is thus a thing that again made good its former [place in the collection].)
Summary:
The cataloguer reasons that this Keichō-era government-printed Confucian text is the copy Aoki Bunzō (Aoki Konyō) obtained and presented to the shogunate, so a volume once lost from the official collection was restored through his donation.

元板古譯本ナリ。板刻ノ年月ヲ錄セス。紙墨字樣ヲ撿スルニ、斷然トシテ元槧ナリ。首ニ林希逸カ序、遠甫カ手帖、嚴粲カ自序アリ。又淸濁音圖ノ末ニ、余氏栞于家塾ノ七（＊六）字、目錄ノ終ニ、勤有書堂刻梓ノ六字アリ。卷十六ノ後ニ、余志安刊于家塾ノ字アリ。元人余志安カ塾刊本ナリ。弱水三萬里ノ印記、各卷ニ散見ス。何人ノ鑑藏ナルヲ詳ニセス。淸ノ天祿琳琅書目ニ、詩緝三種ヲ收ム。皆宋板中ニ入ル。實ハ明ノ趙厚煜＊カ居敬堂ニ刊スルノ本ナリ。然レハ元槧ノ者、旣ニ彼邦ニ絶タルコト、知ル可シ。亦珍ナラスヤ。此書、嘗テ毛利伊勢守高標カ收藏トナリ、後其孫出雲守高翰カ獻スル所ナリ。餘出雲守獻本中ノ一ト謂モノ、皆此類ナリ。
韓板ニシテ、卷首副葉ニ、萬曆十五年二月日、內賜行同知中樞府事尹卓然詩傳一件、命除謝恩、右承旨臣鄭押字トアリ。又宣賜之記ノ印記アリ。コレ韓ノ臣下ニ賜フ者ナリ。是ヨリ後、韓ノ內賜本ト云モノ、印記ヲ著サス。餘コレニ倣フ。

韓板活字ナリ。此書、慶長十九年七月／（双擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ヨリ、成瀨（正武）豐後守ヲシテ駿府ニ赴カシメ、／御起居ヲ候セラレシ時ニ、／（双擡）東照大君ヨリ、御書籍三十種ヲ／（双擡）台德大君ヘ　賜ハル。後／（双擡）台德大君、御判書ヲ以テ、駿府ノ老臣本多上野介（正純）ヘ　謝シタマフ。其時、駿府ヨリ副スル所ノ書目及ヒ書簡、皆與安法印宗哲ト、林道春（羅山）ト、二人ノ名ヲ書ス。又關東ヨリ土井（利勝）大炊頭カ、宗哲、道春ヘ贈レル書竝ニ、閑齋、永喜（林東舟）ヨリ兩人ヘノ返簡アリ。其判書及ヒ往復ノ書、久シク林大學頭ノ家ニ傳シヲ、今ノ林衡ニ至リテ、　呈上シテ覽ニ備フ。寬政十年九月、奉行ニ　命シテ糺サレシニ、三十種ノ中二十二種、尙ヲ御庫ニ現存セリ。此本亦其一ナリ。後慶長賜本ノ一ト記セルハ、皆是ヲ謂フナリ。
宋紹煕年閒ノ槧本ニシテ、足利學ニアリテ、永享中、上杉安房守（憲實）ノ置ク所ナリ。其本每卷、上杉安房守藤原憲實寄進ト記セリ。內、原本卷三十三ヨリ卷四十ニ至ルマテ佚セシヲ、豐後ノ僧一華、別本ヲ以テ補寫セリ。其紙墨ヲ審ニスルニ、古代ノモノナリ。寬政六年、林衡／旨ヲ奉シテ、書手ヲ擇ミ影鈔シ、其蠹蝕アルハ、萬曆ノ刻本ヲ照シテ補ヘリト云フ。八年三月、謄寫ノ功畢テ、覽ニ備フ。享和二年十二月、御庫ニ收ム。

淸原秀賢、宋板ヲ影寫セルナリ。卷二十二ノ後ニ、右一策防州山口神光寺住僧果明、在洛閒雇筆了、慶長四年仲春吏部淸原押字ト記セリ。又卷三十九ノ後ニ、右一册以／（双擡）內府〈御諱〉公ノ本、課朝鮮文士鄭鴻業令謄寫者也、于時文祿三年戊戌臘月吏部秀賢ト記セリ。每卷、淸原宣賢、淸門之統學、安太史平叔、司天臺、松本氏圖書記等ノ印記アリ。此書、舊ト淸家ノ藏本ナリシカ、後轉シテ、安部家＊ノ收藏トナル。松本氏、其人ヲ考ヘス。秀賢ハ、船橋式部太輔＊、宣賢ハ、其子大炊助（秀雄）ナリ。慶長十九年九月七日、宣賢駿府ニ於テ始メテ／（双擡）神祖（德川家康）ニ見エ奉リ、父秀賢カ遺物トシテ三代實錄五十卷ヲ獻スト、駿府記ニ見エタルハ、卽此人ナリ。此書、久シク民閒ニ散シ書賈ノ手ニ落タルヲ、／（双擡）神祖ノ御本ヲ謄寫ストアルヲ以テ、今其原本ノ御庫ニ佚スルカ爲ニ、林衡建言シテ、享和二年七月、收ム。
元天曆二年ノ刊本ニシテ、古譯アリ。每册首後ノ印記、辨スヘカラス。
金澤文庫ノ收藏。軸本ニシテ、淸家ノ古譯本ナリ。每卷ノ後ニ、仁平、久壽ヨリ建長ニ至リテ、識語ノ摹アリ。又文應、弘長、文永、弘安、嘉元中、淸原博士以家說授越後守ノ識語及ヒ、應永中、釋怡於相之醉醒軒一覽セルノ識語アリ。初メ駿府御文庫ニ收メラレ、後今ノ御庫ニ收メラル。林信勝（羅山）カ御本日記ニ、此名ヲ列ス。御本日記ハ、駿府御文庫ノ書目ナリ。今其中ニアルモノハ、每每コレヲ書シテ、其書ノ傳來ヲ明ス。
宋板ニシテ、金澤文庫ノ印記及ヒ古譯アリ。宋嘉定丙子興國軍ノ學ニ刊スル所也。紙質堅固ニシテ、字マタ鮮明ナリ。明祝允明カ家藏ノ印記アリ。餘印、其人ヲ詳ニセス。金澤文庫、祝氏ノ二印、篆刻雅ナラス。今定テ贋造トス。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
宋淳煕中、閩山阮仲猷種德堂刊刻ノ板ニテ、每卷朱點ヲ加ヘ、殘缺補寫ノ所アリ。新見豐前守（正興）獻本五種ノ一ナリ。
北宋槧本ニシテ、板鋟ノ年月ヲ記サス。撫刻極テ精シ。金澤文庫ノ收藏ナリ。宋欽宗以上ノ諱字、廟諱皆闕筆セリ。檇李顧煕雝藏書ノ印記アリ。又支干ヲ印セリ。蓋シ逐年聚貯ノモノナルヘシ。顧煕雝、其人ヲ詳ニセス。
仁治、弘長、正安、延慶年閒、明經博士淸原家古譯ノ書ヲ原本トシ、嘉曆二年釋禪澄、加州白山八幡院玉泉坊ニ書スルノ識語、第一、第二、第三、第八、第九ニアリ。其第九ニ、嘉曆三年九月十八日、於燈下亥刻書之畢、筆者禪澄押字、同夜與霄、莫加＊朱墨點了、此編爲硏幼童之愚眼、先挑五常之燈、寄庄老＊之敎誨、令滯釋門之規矩矣トアリ。
元板。古譯本ナリ。卷首ニ、富沙碧灣吳氏德新堂印行トアリ。卷上ノ後ニ、至元歳次丁丑菊節德新堂印トアリ。蓋至元三年刊行、元初ノ本ナリ。首附禮部牒文及ヒ中書ノ牒文、蒙古ノ字ヲ以テ各名氏ヲ記セリ。卷上ノ後ニ、天文九年庚子秋七月二十一日、乾三叟守棱漫加朱、卷下ニ、九月二十二日加朱トアリ。又文博士淸原押字ト記セリ。每卷ノ後ニ、國賢ノ印記アリ。淸原國賢カ藏本ナリ。又每卷東字ノ印アリ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。

明人姜立綱書本ニシテ、東宮進讀本也。此書、紙質絶美、四旁寬大ニシテ、字大サ寸餘、墨色鮮新、王世貞、趙用賢カ跋アリ。趙カ跋ニ、張幼于カ藏スル所ト云フ。又王泰吉ノ印記アリ。後散シテ、張氏、王氏ノ藏書トナル。泰吉、其人ヲ考ヘス。世貞跋曰、故姜太僕立綱書、此四子全文句讀、各有圏甚精、當是先朝春宮進讀書本也、結法圓熟端勁、妙不可言、初見絶以爲沈度學士書、徐覺其波磔處小露鋒鎩、乃敢定爲姜筆、噫嘻、兩制諸君不復能辨此矣、吳郡王世貞題。又用賢跋曰、語孟中庸大學、今世誦習徧天下、然善本亦不易得、當披玩常、則精好難繼、學者不無臨文之嘆、此帙乃張幼于所藏、弇山先生鑑定以爲姜太僕筆、姜書法出沈學士度、爲本朝兩制、楷則或病其體多同、而格力不揚、然是書頗病譌僞、太常此本、如宿學老儒、雖姿字不至峻茂、而嚴正可畏、一展卷閒、令人神暢義融、法言琅琅、若聖賢在目、余謬以爲唯與太常書、爲合作耳、吳郡趙用賢謹識トアリ。
姜立綱、字廷憲。瑞安人。七歳以能書命翰林院秀才。天順中授中書舎人、歷官大常少卿。善楷書〈書史會要〉。
王世貞、字元美。太倉人。嘉靖二十六年進士、授刑部主事。萬曆中爲南京刑部尙書。贈太子少保〈明史〉。
趙用賢、字汝師。常熟人。隆慶五年進士、選庶吉士、擢南京禮部右侍郞。天啓初贈太子少保、禮部尙書〈明史〉。
張幼于、名獻翼。長洲人。年十六以詩贄文徵明。徵明語其徒陸子傳曰、吾與倶弗及也。獻翼好易、十年中箋注三易。晩年與王穉登爭不能勝、頽然自放〈蘇州府志〉。
元至正年閒ノ重鋟本ニシテ、撫印極メテ精シ。蓋シ初印ノ本ナリ。紙墨トモニ精潔、元槧中ノ善本ナリ。卷一ノ後ニ、至正乙未仲夏日新書堂重刊トアリ。原本ハ宋紹興三十年毛光＊撰刻ノ本ナリ。高平隆長印記、其人ヲ考ヘス。
此書、刊刻ノ年月ヲ著ハサス。板マタ漫漶ス。蓋シ元時ノ坊刻ナルヘシ。右三種、毛利出雲守獻本ナリ。
南宋淳煕年閒ノ槧本、金澤文庫ノ印、又蟠桃院ノ印記アリ。四方寬廣ニシテ、字五分餘、紙質完シ。然トモ板マタ拘滯ス。田世卿跋曰、此板久已磨滅、不復有也、前年蒙恩、將屯安康、偶得蜀本、字多舛誤、閒亦脫漏、嘗從暇日、委官挍正ト云フ。又淳煕乙巳九月至丁未五月、僅能畢工ト記セリ。
唐文宗開成二年、鄭覃等挍定シテ石ニ上セシ打本ナリ。案スルニ、新唐書文宗紀、大學勒石、而鄭覃與周墀等挍定九經文字上石、及覃以宰相兼祭酒、於是進石壁九經一百六十卷。又案スルニ、鄭覃傳云、太和中覃以經籍刓謬、博士陋淺不能正、建言、願與鉅學鴻生共力讐刊、準漢舊事、鐫石大學、示萬世法、詔可、乃表周墀、崔球、張次宗、孔温業等是正其文、刻于石。其石經ノ始末ハ、淸顧炎武、萬斯同カ石經考ニ詳ナレハ、茲ニ悉セス。
元至元年閒ノ槧本ニシテ、古博士ノ譯本ナリ。卷三十七ノ後ニ、永享十二年二月十七日、加點於惠峯舎雪齋下畢ト、紅筆ヲ以テ記セリ。

駿府御文庫本ニテ、西三條內府（三條西）實隆公手書ナリ。御本日記、三條殿手書史記四十册ト記セルモノ、是ナリ。每卷ノ後ニ、永正某年某月書寫挍正スト記セリ。又卷七、卷十ノ後ニ、去冬以來凌老眼染惡筆、使諫議羽林郞公條卿摹點了、所謂舊本者、紀傳朱點也、而今爲令易讀、傚江湖之新樣、用朱墨之點云云。永正辛未孟秋上澣、槐陰迍虛子ト記セリ。此書、逍遙院實隆公、元板ヲ影鈔シ、其子稱名院（三條西）公條公ヲシテ、朱墨ノ點ヲ加ヘシムルモノナリ。
宋板。元大德補刊本ニシテ、古博士ノ註譯及ヒ、朱墨點アリ。駿府御文庫本ナリ。詳ニ下ノ後漢書ノ條ニ見エタリ。
板式前ニ同シ。刷印ヤヽ後ル。內本紀三卷ヲ佚ス。又本紀卷四、卷五、卷六、列傳卷六〈二葉〉、卷十三〈五葉〉、卷五十二、卷五十三、卷五十四、卷五十五、卷五十六〈十七葉〉ヲ佚ス。補闕ヲ以テ全卷トナル。天龍金剛藏海印文常住ノ印記アリ。山城嵯峨天龍寺ノ子院、金剛院ノ藏海トイヘルモノヽ印記ナリ。毛利（高翰）出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
明正統刊板ニシテ、古譯大德補刊本ニ同シ。

元大德九年ノ刊本ニシテ、應德、保安、保元、壽永、建長、弘安、文安年閒古博士識語ノ摹アリ。壽永ノ識語ニ、壽永二年夾鐘二十一日、以說授猶子隆才子、于時夜雨新霽、今日朝覲之行幸也、人皆觀輦路、予獨畱文窗矣、散位敦經トアリ。件ノ本ヲ以テ、大永元年十月二日加點ト、卷三十ノ後ニ記セリ。又文永六年二月十四日天子御讀畢云云、以件天龍寺本加點、于時享祿三年五月二十日都督郞ト記セリ。駿府御文庫本ニシテ、御本日記ニ記セル、前後漢書七十册トアルモノ、是ナリ。
元大德槧本、古譯竝ニ朱墨點アリ。卷十後ニ、正應五年正月二十三日夜、於燈下見畢、今日及兩卷、黃門郞判トアル本ヲ以テ、天文五年挍點ト記セリ。

宋板ニテ、柴（市、朱筆校改）野光彥＊（迷庵）ノ所藏ニシテ、同人ノ印記、跋アリ。是ヲ見テ、此書ノ來歷ヲ知ルヘシ。宋板三國志全部、魏志帝記一册缺、蜀志卷首有咸平六年中書門下牒、系補寫可惜也、又每卷有眞淨院朱印、惜陰墨印、雅素可愛、又魏志卷七末書、戊午夏五戊寅晩閒挍對、旵、又魏志八末書、戊午建午中八夜挍、旵、所謂旵者、未考其人、顧五山釋氏之徒也、卽爲四五百年所傳舊物矣、今夏曝書於楼上、乃記如此、文政庚辰六月迷菴光彦ト記シ、又咸平六年牒、後人所補足、當刪之、予嘗觀宋板前後漢書、皆南宋本也、此本與前後漢書同種、足以證明焉ト書シ、又足利學所藏毛詩注疏本詩譜末朱書、大荒落晩夏小晝日＊燈下一看絶句、光彥續錄（＊四字錯誤）訖、藤旵、此書所謂旵者、豈非斯人乎、然則此書、出於足利學舊藏焉、壬午七月五日迷菴光彥再識トアリ。享和年閒、柴野彥助邦彥（栗山）ト云ヘル官儒アリ。年序ヲ以テ考ルニ、光彥ハ邦彥ノ子ナルモ、知ルヘカラス。又卷中ニ、賜盧文庫＊ノ印記アリ。誰氏ノ藏ナルヤ、詳ナラス。新見豐前守（正興）獻本五種ノ一ナリ。

Volume_Info: 朝鮮板、駿府御文庫本。御本日記ニ、林道春所司、唐書朝鮮板ト云フ、是ナリ。
明正德官板ニシテ、撫印最初ノ本ナリ。明ノ內府藏本ナリ。廣運之寶、表章經史之寶ノ璽鈐アリ。
明官板。萬曆十七年刊スル所ニシテ、大本闊字ナリ。撫印ヤヽ後ル。內逸卷、唐人補闕セリ。每卷、蔣琦ノ印記アリ。其人ヲ詳ニセス。

韓板。活字刷印ニシテ、殘闕最モ夥シ。印本什ノ一ヲ存ス。補闕、明板ヲ原本トナス。其補卷目錄ノ上卷ニ、明朝列大夫國子監祭酒臣方從哲、承德郞右春坊右中允管國子監司業事臣黃汝良等、奉敕重挍刊トアリ。又卷四十七ノ後ニ、康煕庚辰年江寧府儒學敎授荆子邁挍ノ十六字アリ。按ニ、明板淸補刊ノ本ヲ以テ補闕セルカ。印本每册ニ、上洛金紐氏受賜之記ノ印記アリ。韓ノ賜本ナリ。補闕目錄三卷、本紀二十卷、表三卷、志四十四卷、傳八十六卷。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。

宋板ニシテ、紙質精緻、字樣正雅ニシテ、マタ善本ト云フヘシ。眉山程氏カ藏板ナリ。卷首副葉ニ小記アリ。其文曰、東都事略、宋刻僅見此本、先君最所寶愛榮、本樓牙籤萬軸、獨闕此書、牧翁屢求不獲、心頗嗛焉、先君家道中落、要索頻煩、始終不忍棄捐、吾子孫其愼守之勿失、右見讀書敏求記、按近来富宋本者、莫錢遵王若也、然其言如此、則當寶藏、可知也、故表出之、示後之獲此者ト見エタリ。然ルニ何人ノ記ナルコトヲ詳ニセス。卷第八十六ヨリ九十三ニ至ルマテ八卷及ヒ、卷第百二十二ノ一卷ヲ散逸セリ。マタ卷第一、卷第二、卷第四、卷第五、卷第六、卷第七、卷第八、卷第九、卷第十、卷第十二、卷第十四、卷第十五、卷第十六、卷第十七、卷第十八、卷第十九、卷第二十、卷第六十二、卷第六十三、卷第六十四、卷第六十五、卷第六十六、卷第七十一、卷第七十二、卷第八十一、卷第八十二、卷第九十四、卷第九十五、卷第九十六、卷第九十七、卷第九十八、卷第九十九、卷第一百十六、卷第一百十九、卷第一百二十、卷第一百二十三、卷第一百二十九、凡テ三十六卷、補寫ニ係ル。其他、卷中一二葉、或ハ四五葉補寫スルモノアリ。其書、古色アリテ、珍トスルニ堪ヘタリ。マタ鄞江衞氏ノ印記アリテ、其人ヲ詳ニセス。新見豐前守獻本五種ノ一ナリ。
明萬曆官板。大本ニシテ初印ノ本ナリ。此書、張居正等カ進本ヲ、史館ニ附シテ其副本ヲ挍刊セシメ、刻成テ進ムル所ノ書也。明人題シテ、御覽帝鑑圖說ト云フ。王業浩印、吉日〈字闕〉、松儔竹伴等ノ印記アリ。諸印考フル所ナシ。
韓板活字ニシテ、駿府御文庫本ナリ。卷首副葉ニ、嘉靖三十七年十一月、內賜弘文館直提學尹毅中文獻通考一件、命除謝恩、左副承旨臣沈押字トアリ。卷首、宣賜之記ノ印記アリ。コレ又韓ノ賜本ナリ。其內、卷百三十六、卷百三十七ヲ缺ク。享保中　旨アリテ補寫セリ。御本日記ニ載スル、林道春（羅山）所司ノ書也。印記前ニ見エタリ。

明官板ニシテ、淸ノ琳琅書目ニ擧ル、嘉靖官板ト同シ。二泉精舎、國賢ノ印記アリ。明ノ邵寶カ藏本ナリ。卷二十五ヨリ卷三十ニ至ルマテ、唐人ノ書本ニ係ル。又寶カ印記ナシ。明馮天馭カ挍刊本ヲ以テ補寫ス。蓋シ補闕、他人ノ手ニ出ルモノナラン。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
邵寶、字國賢。無錫人。學者稱爲二泉先生。成化二十年進士、歷官南京禮部尙書。卒贈太子太保、謚文莊〈明史〉。
北宋槧本ニシテ、字畫楷正ナリ。卷百ヨリ卷二百ニ至ルマテ、散逸セシヲ書寫セリ。其紙墨奇古ニシテ、書中紅靑筆ヲ以テ挍正スル所アリ。此書、曾テ朝鮮國王ノ藏トナル。經筵ノ印記、高麗國藏書ノ印記アリ。案スルニ、宋ノ建中靖國元年ハ、今ヲ距ルコト七百有餘年、實ニ奇世ノ珍ナリ。此書、民閒ニ藏セシヲ、林大學頭衡（述齋）上言シテ、文化十四年六月收ム。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、朝鮮史略、高麗國十四葉辛巳ノ歳ハ、肅宗ノ六年ナリ。肅宗、名顒、字天常、初名煕。宣宗母弟。東國通鑑、天常ヲ大常ニ作ル。
Remarks_Notes: ＊高麗國十四葉辛巳歳／藏書大宋建中靖國／元年大遼乾統元年
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ ("Respectfully, I submit this note:")
- 朝鮮史略、高麗國十四葉 ("In the *Chōsen shiryaku* (朝鮮史略), the Koryŏ section, leaf/folio 14 [十四葉 could also mean 'fourteenth generation', but 'leaf' fits a citation best]:")
- 辛巳ノ歳ハ ("the year *shinshi* (辛巳, the 'metal-snake' year)")
- 肅宗ノ六年ナリ ("is the sixth year of Sukchong (肅宗).")
- 肅宗、名顒、字天常、初名煕 ("Sukchong: personal name Ong (顒), courtesy name Chŏnsang (天常), originally named Hŭi (煕).")
- 宣宗母弟 ("He was the full younger brother, by the same mother, of Sŏnjong (宣宗).")
- 東國通鑑、天常ヲ大常ニ作ル ("The *Tōkoku tsugan* (東國通鑑, Korean *Tongguk t'onggam*) writes 天常 as 大常.")
Summary:
This is not a provenance record: it is a scholarly collation note that uses the *Chōsen shiryaku* to date King Sukchong's sixth year to the *shinshi* year (1101) and to give his names and lineage, while pointing out that the *Tōkoku tsugan* has a variant reading of his courtesy name. It records no book movement or acquisition.

唐人ノ書本ニシテ、明末變革ノ事ヲ紀ス。虞山錢曾カ藏本ナリ。書手一ナラス。然レトモ印記ヲ案スルニ、奇書手自鈔トアルハ、曾カ手抄ナルヘシ。各卷ニ散見セリ。北略ニ印記ヲ蹈セス。此書、卷帙錯雜シ、完壁（＊璧）ト云ヘカラス。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
錢曾、字遵王、自號也是翁。常熟人。家富圖籍、多蓄舊笈、其最佳之本、手所題識、倣歐陽修集古錄之意云〈四庫全書提要〉。
錢曾、副使順德之族、元孫。少穎敏、善學於經史諸子百家。過目卽能成誦。工擧子業、數奇不售、遂倂力詩古文。又逑（＊述）古堂藏書、多善本。撰讀書敏求記、識其源委云〈蘇州府志〉。
唐人書本ニシテ、元至正十二年壬辰ヨリ、熹宗天啓二年壬戌ニ至ルマテ、十二朝ノ實錄ナリ。內天啓元年ヨリ二年ニ至ルマテ、十二卷ヲ佚セリ。寬政中　旨アリテ、柴野彥助邦彥ヲシテ挍補セシメラル。
享保中、松平伊賀守忠周、冩本ヲ獻ス。郡山ノ儒臣、荻生惣右衞門茂卿（徂徠）ヲシテ考定令メラル。茂卿考ル所ノ一紙ヲ附ス。

享保十年、荻生惣七郞觀（北溪）ヲシテ挍訂繕冩令メラル。譯書一卷ヲ附ス。十五年　旨アリテ、淸人沈丙〈字燈煒號燮庵〉ヲシテ再訂セシム。丙、訂正ノ一卷ヲ附シテ上ル。又元文元年、淸ノ刑部尙書勵廷儀ニ、序文ヲ作ラシメテ獻ス。今官刻本ニ載スル、是ナリ。
勵廷儀、杜訥子。康煕庚辰進士、授翰林院編修。累選＊刑部尙書。世宗御書、矜愼平恕四字賜之。加太子少保、調吏部尙書。卒諡文恭。乾隆六年入祀賢良祠〈淸一統志〉。
元至正十一年、崇化余志安勤有堂ノ刊本ナリ。撫刻紙質、倶ニ賤劣ニシテ、元時ノ坊本ナリ。姑蘇吳岫家藏ノ印記アリ。其人ヲ詳ニセス。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
貞和年閒ノ冩本ナリ。案スルニ、宋志及ヒ遂書堂書目＊、直齋書錄共ニ收ムレトモ、元明以下ノ書目ニ見ル所ナシ。然レハ彼ニ佚スルノ久クシテ、亦吾ニ傳ルノ久シキヲ知ヘシ。每册ノ後ニ、貞和四年某月某日挍合畢、面山叟ト記セリ。
明萬曆刊板ニシテ、安太史平叔、黃白堂ノ印記アリ。安部家＊ノ藏本ナリ。黃白堂モ、安部平叔＊カ自號ナルヘシ。天文陰陽ノ博士家ナルヲ以テ、天經黃白ノ二道ヲ取テ、其齋ニ名ツクルナルヘシ。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一ナリ。
明板。刊刻ノ年月ヲ載セス。內府藏書、知止堂ノ印記アリ。二印共ニ考ル所ナシ。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
韓板活字ニシテ、韓人ノ藏本ナリ。來歷詳カナラス。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、惺窩行狀ニ、慶長五年侍／（双擡）源君（德川家康）、讀東萊十七史トアリ。然レハ此書、御本日記ニ載セスト雖トモ、駿府御文庫本ナルモ亦知ルヘカラス。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ ("Respectfully I consider / humble note:") "In my respectful opinion,"
- 惺窩行狀ニ ("In the Account of the Conduct of [Fujiwara] Seika") "in the *Seika Gyōjō* (Seika's biography),"
- 慶長五年 ("Keichō 5," i.e. 1600) "in the fifth year of Keichō,"
- 侍／（双擡）源君（德川家康） ("attending / [the line is raised in honorific style] Lord Minamoto (Tokugawa Ieyasu)") "[Seika] attended Lord Minamoto (Tokugawa Ieyasu), with the honorific line-raising (双擡) marked in the original,"
- 讀東萊十七史トアリ ("read the Donglai Seventeen Histories, so it says") "and read the *Tōrai Jūshichishi* (the Donglai Seventeen Histories); so it is written."
- 然レハ ("That being so") "If so,"
- 此書、御本日記ニ載セスト雖トモ ("this book, although it is not recorded in the *Gohon Nikki*") "although this book is not entered in the *Gohon Nikki* (the diary record of the shogun's books),"
- 駿府御文庫本ナルモ ("that it is a Sunpu Library book") "it may be a book of the Sunpu Gobunko (Ieyasu's Sunpu library),"
- 亦知ルヘカラス ("also cannot be known") "and this likewise cannot be ruled out (it cannot be known that it is not)."
Summary:
The annotator argues that, because Fujiwara Seika's biography records him reading the Donglai Seventeen Histories to Tokugawa Ieyasu in 1600, this book could have belonged to Ieyasu's Sunpu library even though the *Gohon Nikki* does not list it.

Volume_Info: 元板。古譯本ナリ。鋟板ノ年月ヲ記載セス。字畫端正ニシテ、紙墨共ニ完美ナリ。鑑藏家ノ印記アリ。
宋板ニシテ、鋟鐫ノ年月ヲ記サス。闕頁頗ル多シ。他本ヲ以テ補寫ス。丹筆ヲ以テ加點セリ。右三種倶ニ、毛利出雲守獻本中ノ書也。
明官板ニシテ、四旁寬大、紙質潔白ナリ。御本日記ニ載ル所ノ、駿府御文庫本ナリ。

明萬曆重修本ナリ。明謝肇淛カ藏本ニシテ、印記アリ。徐氏筆精ニ、予友謝方伯肇淛、有書嗜。銳意蒐羅、不施批點ト云ヘリ。今御文庫中、肇淛ノ藏本七八種ヲ收ム。一モ批點ヲ加ル者ナシ。徐■(火孛)カ言ニ符ス。
謝肇淛、字在杭。福建長樂人。萬曆壬辰進士。官至廣西布政使〈明史〉。

明萬曆重修本ナリ。明徐■(火孛)カ藏本ニシテ、印記アリ。又嘉■（鼎刀）氏、句章外史ノ印記アリ。句章地名、今ノ鄞縣ナリ。山海經ニ、句章山ト云フ、是ナリ。然レトモ其人ヲ詳ニセス。
徐■(火孛)、字惟起、又字興公。閩縣人。永寧令■（木昂）之子也。博學工文、善草隸書。萬曆閒與曹能始狎、主閩中詞盟、後進皆稱興公詩派。嗜古學、家多藏書。著筆精、榕陰新檢等書。以博洽稱於時云。
明板。徐■(火孛)カ藏本ナリ。又彭城呂氏綠玉山房ノ印記アリ。其人ヲ考ヘス。
明板。徐■(火孛)藏本ナリ。印記前ニ同シ。
明隆慶板。謝肇淛ノ藏本ナリ。印記前ニ同シ。右五種トモニ、毛利出雲守獻本中ノ書也。

明嘉靖板。明毛晉カ藏本、汲古閣ノ印記アリ。又彭城開國ノ印記アリ。其人ヲ詳ニセス。
毛晉、元名鳳苞、字子晉。蘇州常熟人。晉奮起爲儒、游錢謙益之門、強記博覽。搆汲古閣、藏書萬卷。刻十三經、十七史、古今百家之書、手自挍讐、世皆購之。入門僮僕、皆能抄書。著述甚富〈蘇州府志〉。
明天啓重修本。徐■(火孛)藏本ナリ。又京師ノ醫、靑木東菴カ印記アリ。閩中徐惟起藏書ノ印、前ニ見エタリ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。
舊題聖蹟圖ト云ヘリ。帖本ニシテ、宣府、大同、山西等處ノ三鎭ノ外、虜人部スル所ノ嶮要利便、繪テ圖ヲ作ル。督臣楊時寧カ序ニ、一タヒ圖ヲ按シテ彼己ノ要害、兵糧ノ虛實、攻守ノ方略、暸乎トシテ指顧ノ閒ニアリ、一日モ忽ニスヘカラサルコトヲ述ヘ、萬曆三十一年書成テ進ル所ナリト云フ。

古寫卷軸ニシテ、金澤文庫本ナリ。印記、卷ノ首後ニアリ。御本日記ニ載スル所ノ、駿府御文庫本ナリ。每卷後ニ題識アリ。其文枚擧スヘカラス。建長、康元、正喜＊、正元、文應、建治、嘉元、德治、延慶、文永年閒ニ至ルマテ、淸原敎隆、隆重、賴業、又藤原經雄、俊國、敦周、敦綱、敦經等、依越州使君敎命加點畢トアリ。卷十五、卷十六、卷十八、卷十九、卷二十一、卷二十二、卷二十四ニ、文永中越後守顯時重ネテ書寫挍點スト、手自書スル識語押字アリ。又卷二十八、卷二十九、卷三十ニ、嘉元中越後守貞顯書寫重挍スト、手自書スル識語押字アリ。文永ヨリ今ヲ距ルコト五百餘年、奇書ト云フヘシ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、羣書治要、唐書藝文志雜家ニ入ル。宋史ヨリ以下其書ヲ逸ス。又諸家ノ書目ニ見ル所ナシ。三代實錄貞觀十七年、先是天皇讀羣書治要、至是講竟トアレハ、此書、彼ニ佚シテ我ニ傳フルコト、久シキヲ知ルヘシ。
Literal_English_Translation:
謹案ニ (Respectfully, I note / Humbly considering:) 
羣書治要、唐書藝文志雜家ニ入ル。 (The *Qunshu zhiyao* [Jp. *Gunsho chiyō*] is entered under the "Miscellaneous Schools" [zajia] category in the Yiwenzhi [Bibliographic Treatise] of the *Tang shu* [Tang History].)
宋史ヨリ以下其書ヲ逸ス。 (From the *Song shi* [Song History] onward, that book is lost / is missing [from the records].)
又諸家ノ書目ニ見ル所ナシ。 (Moreover, there is nowhere it is seen in the book catalogues of the various scholars/collectors.)
三代實錄貞觀十七年、 (In the *Sandai jitsuroku*, in the 17th year of Jōgan [875],)
先是天皇讀羣書治要、至是講竟トアレハ、 (it states "Previously the Emperor had read the *Qunshu zhiyao*, and by this time the lecture on it was completed" — therefore,)
此書、彼ニ佚シテ我ニ傳フルコト、久シキヲ知ルヘシ。 (it should be understood that this book, having been lost over there [China] yet transmitted over here [Japan], has been so for a long time.)
Summary:
The annotator argues that the *Qunshu zhiyao*, recorded in the Tang bibliography but absent from Chinese records from the Song period onward, had been transmitted to and preserved in Japan since at least the Jōgan era (875, when the Emperor completed a lecture series on it, per the *Sandai jitsuroku*), so it survived in Japan long after being lost in China.
