Volume_Info: 慶長十五年、鎌倉ノ僧徒ニ　命シテ、金澤文庫ノ本ヲ影抄令メラルヽ所ナリ。是慶長寫本ノ其一也。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、崇傳日記慶長十五年九月十九日、羣書治要四十六卷、鎌倉ノ僧徒竝ヒニ淸見寺、臨濟寺ノ僧徒ニ／命セラレ、總持院ニ於テ書寫令メラルヽコトヲ載タリ。コレ其時ノ事ナルヘシ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案ニ ("Respectfully, upon consideration:") The compiler's note begins with a humble statement of his own view.
- 崇傳日記慶長十五年九月十九日、 ("In the Sūden Diary, entry of the 19th day of the 9th month, Keichō 15 [1610],")
- 羣書治要四十六卷、 ("the Qunshu zhiyao (Gunsho chiyō), forty-six fascicles,")
- 鎌倉ノ僧徒竝ヒニ淸見寺、臨濟寺ノ僧徒ニ ("to the monks of Kamakura, and also to the monks of Seiken-ji and Rinzai-ji,")
- ／命セラレ、 ("[a gap marking honorific respect] command was given, and")
- 總持院ニ於テ書寫令メラルヽコトヲ載タリ。 ("it records that the copying was carried out, by order, at Sōji-in.")
- コレ其時ノ事ナルヘシ。 ("This must be the affair of that time.")

The gap (／) before 命 is a scribal convention of respect. It implies that the order came from a very high authority, most likely Tokugawa Ieyasu, though the text does not name him.
Summary:
The annotator cites Sūden's diary entry for 19 September 1610 (Keichō 15), which says a 46-fascicle Gunsho chiyō was ordered copied by monks of Kamakura, Seiken-ji and Rinzai-ji at Sōji-in, and concludes that the present manuscript probably originated from that copying project.
---

Volume_Info: 宋紹興年閒ノ槧本、金澤文庫ノ藏本ナリ。字密ニ行疏ニシテ、紙墨共ニ美、蓋シ坊刻ノ書ナリ。金澤文庫ノ印卷一、卷五、卷六ニアリ。餘印、詳カナラス。毛利出雲守（高翰）獻本中ノ一也。
明板。謝肇淛藏本ナリ。印記アリ。爵里前ニ見エタリ。
明官板。永樂三年刊スル所ナリ。四旁寬大ニシテ、撫印最初ノ本ナリ。厚載之記ノ印アリ。明ノ中宮ノ鈐寶ナリ。明史徐后ノ傳ニ、所製勸善書、永樂三年頒行天下ト云フ。則此書ナリ。甘松寶ノ章、何人ヲ詳ニセス。
明官板。永樂十三年刊本ニシテ、明成祖自製ノ序アリ。首序、松儔竹伴、知止堂ノ印記アリ。前ニ見エタリ。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
明官板。正統十二年刊スル所ニシテ、英宗製序アリ。字寬ニ帙闊ニ、撫刻極メテ精シ。當時初印ノ本ナリ。明內府ノ藏本ニシテ、廣運之寶ノ璽鈐アリ。
明景泰官板。大本闊字、撫印最初ノ本ナリ。內府藏本ニシテ、鈐寶前ニ同シ。
明官板。永樂三年刊スル所、紙墨トモニ光潔ニシテ、大本闊字、當時初印ノ本ナリ。明史徐后ノ傳ニ、所製之內訓、永樂三年頒行天下ト云フ、則此書也。
明官板。嘉靖九年刊スル所、官板中ノ美本ナリ。明中宮ノ鈐印アリ。明史稾蔣后ノ傳ニ、弘治九年、所製之女訓頒天下トアリ。後序ニ、章聖慈仁皇太后昔在于藩邸、嘗著女訓一集、雖已梓刻、而傳播未廣也、近者我皇上、於中宮表而出之、乃命儒臣章（＊分）句折、以爲直解云トアリ。然レハ此書ハ、重鐫シテ天下ニ頒行スルトコロノ者ナルヘシ。
明板。梓刻ノ年月ヲ記サス。是亦王振藏本ナリ。印記前ニ同シ。

明嘉靖板ニシテ、梅溪精舎、玉蘭堂、辛夷館ノ印記アリ。明文徵明カ藏本ナリ。又淸季振宜カ藏書ノ記アリ。餘印、其人ヲ詳ニセス。徵明カ藏本、後轉シテ各家ノ收藏トナル。文氏、季氏、名家ノ款識アルヲ以テ珍奇トナス。
文徵明、長洲人。名璧、以字行。更字徵仲、別號衡山。父林温州知府。徵明幼不慧、稍長穎異挺發。學文於吳寬、學書於李應禎、學畫於沈周、皆父友也。與徐禎卿稱伯仲、名冠天下。嘉靖三十八年卒、年九十矣〈明史〉。
季振宜、字詵兮、號蒼葦。楊州泰興縣人。順治丁亥進士、授蘭溪令。歷刑戸兩曹、擢御史〈天祿琳琅書目〉。
右三種、毛利出雲守獻本中ノ書也。
松平（前田）加賀守吉治ノ藏本ヲ以テ、丹羽正伯ニ　命シテ謄寫令メラル。元文四年收ム。當時コレ等ノ書、世ニ罕ナルヲ以テナリ。
享保中、　旨アリテ、御庫ニ於テ謄寫セシム。原本ノ出ル所詳ナラス。是亦當時希世ノ書ナルヲ以テナリ。
韓板活字ニシテ、東林ノ印アリ。韓人ノ私印ナリ。卷末ニ、永樂七年四月日印トアリ。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一ナリ。
韓板活字本ナリ。卷首副葉ニ、萬曆五年十月日、內賜司憲府持平金鑽司馬法一件、命除謝恩、都承旨臣押字トアリ。

韓板活字本ナリ。卷首副葉ニ、萬曆五年十月日、內賜司憲府持平金鑽黃石公一件、命除謝恩、都承旨臣尹押字ト記セリ。七書一件ト記スヘキヲ黃石公ト記スルハ、韓人誤リテ首篇ノ目ヲ擧タルナリ。
右四部、宣賜之記ノ印アリ。共ニ韓ノ賜本ナリ。印記前ニ見ヘタリ。
林大學頭衡、足利學ノ藏本ヲ影抄シ、寬政八年十二月、御庫ニ收ム。原本ハ慶長活字板ノ一ナリ。今其書佚スルカ爲メナリ。釋元佶カ跋ニ、依／（双擡）內大臣〈御諱〉公之命刻梓焉、慶長五龍集庚子孟夏、於伏見城下書焉ト記セリ。
韓板活字ニシテ、首序ニ宣賜ノ印記アリ。韓ノ賜本ナリ。卷後ニ、正統二年丁卯八月印トアリ。
宋板。金澤文庫ノ收藏ナリ。書中、欽宗以上諱字嫌名、皆缺筆ス。板刻ノ年月ヲ著ハササレトモ、南渡以前ノ刻ナリ。今定メテ北板トナス。此書、劉義慶カ眞本ナリ。

此書、唐人ノ抄本ニシテ、撰人名氏ヲ著ハサス。烏絲欄紙ヲ用ユ。板心ニ、淡生堂抄本ノ五字アリ。明ノ祁承熯カ淡生堂書目ニ載スルハ、卽此書ナリ。鑑藏ノ數印、ミナ熯カ藏印ナリ。茲書、諸家ノ書目ニ見ル所ナシ。自己ノ書目ニノミ其書ヲ載ス。其鑑印中、曠翁手識ノ文ヲ以テ考フレハ、熯カ抄錄スルノミニテ、未タ刊布ヲナササルモノナルヘシ。東井文庫ノ印、醫官今大路家ノ藏ナリ。
祁承熯、字爾光。山陰人。萬曆甲辰進士。官至江西布政司參政〈四庫全書總目提要〉。
明正德三年愼獨齋ニ刊スト云フ。細楷鮮明ニシテ、元槧ノ如シ。新安胡氏藏本ナリ。其人ヲ詳ニセス。

元板ニシテ、刊刻ノ年月ヲ記サス。
右三種、毛利出雲守獻本中ノ書也。
明板。謝肇淛藏本ナリ。印記爵理、前ニ見ヘタリ。
宋槧。金澤文庫ノ收藏ヲ經テ、駿府御文庫本トナル。闕卷ノ所、宋板ヲ影寫シテ補ヘリ。故ニ金澤ノ印記或ハアリ、或ハナシ。御本日記ニ、兌長老本二函ト記セル者、恐ラクハ此本ナルヘシ。補闕卷四百六十至四百六十九、卷五百四十五至五百五十五、卷五百六十六。
明萬曆中、蘇熟ノ周堂カ活字刷印スル所ノ本ナリ。張同吉、元石、貞卿ノ印記アリ。其人ヲ考フル所ナシ。
古寫本ニシテ、卷尾ニ、時龍飛天正二年甲戌春三月十日書、時寓治下大明國王月軒筆ト記セリ。王氏ハ歸化ノ醫人ニヤ。其人ヲ詳ニセス。
古寫本ニシテ、駿府御文庫ヨリ移サルト云フ。
韓板活字ニテ、望月三英（鹿門）藏本ナリ。三英モト醫家ノ書ニ富ム。其孫三作、保守スルコト能ハス。因リテ其請ヒニ從ヒ、官ニ收ム。是其一也。後望月本ト云フ者、皆同シ。
古寫本。王氏月軒ノ書本ニテ、卷尾ニ、天正二年甲戌三月書、大明國王氏月軒書ト記セリ。
宋板ニテ、嚴用和カ寶祐癸丑年ノ序アリ。四庫總目ニ、原本久佚、今從永樂大典錄出、爲八卷ト云フ。此書十卷ナリ。コレ亦彼邦ニ佚シテ、吾土ニ存スルモノナリ。況ヤ宋槧ノ眞本ニシテ、珍トスルニ足レリ。內卷一ト卷八トハ、佚スルカ故ニ補寫ス。其紙墨共ニ古ナリ。卷六、卷十ハ、新寫セルナリ。

韓板活字ニテ、韓人德弟南（南賢中）ノ藏本、私印アリ。
右三種共ニ、望月本ナリ。
金澤文庫本ヲ影寫セシナリ。
寬政中、多紀永壽院元德（藍溪）建白シテ、尾張家ノ藏本ヲ以テ新ニ一通ヲ寫シ、御庫ニ收ム。永壽院ノ次子安道、安肅及ヒ、弟子三人共ニ繕寫シ、永壽院安長（桂山）コレヲ挍正ス。原本ハ駿府御文庫本ニシテ、宋板金澤御文庫本ナリ。半殘缺セルヲ、書本ニテ足成セリ。每册、御本ノ鈐印アリ。又永壽院、別ニ永正年閒ノ古寫本ヲ以テ挍正スト云ヘリ。
元槧ニテ、京師ノ醫官堅田絨造（獨得）、久シク家ニ傳ヘシヲ、多紀安長ニリヨリテ獻センコトヲ請ヒ、遂ニ京都町奉行ヨリ呈上セシト云ヘリ。此書、舊ト宋槧ト稱スレトモ、字樣ヲ詳ニスルニ、元槧ナリ。今改正ニ從フ。卷九至卷十五、缺タルヲ補寫セリ。
鋟板ノ年月ヲ記サス。目錄ノ後ニ、建安余彥國刊于勵賢堂トアリ。殘闕補寫ノ所アリ。道山、專勢ノ二印アリ。五山ノ僧徒ノ印信ナルヘシ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。
元文二年正月、松平加賀守吉治ニ　命セラレ、其家藏本ヲ以テ寫サシメラル。三月成リテ上ル。五年七月、御庫ニ收ム。
明板ニシテ、紙墨トモニ佳ナリ。徐璣ノ藏本ナリ。佐野氏、啓迪院ノ印記アリ。共ニ本邦ノ人ニシテ、其傳ヲ詳ニセス。毛利出雲守獻本中ノ一也。
明板刷印ニテ、謝肇淛藏本ナリ。印記前ニ見ユ。

明官板。大文闊帖ニシテ、帙千字文ヲ以テ排次ス。天字號ヨリ將字號ニ止ル。凡四百九十一帙〈明藝文志五百十二函ニ作ル。彙刻書目四百九十一函ニ作ル〉、內荒月盈宿寒閏餘律呂調騰致雨露崑岡劒夜光菓珍李柰菜重龍師火帝官人賓歸玉＊鳴履弗離節陛英杜稾鍾＊隸漆書壁經府羅將ノ五十二號ヲ佚ス。萬曆戊戌年七月、奉旨印造施行ストアリ。戊戌ハ神宗ノ二十六年ナリ。又英宗ノ製詩ヲ編首ニ繋ク。各卷ニ見ユ。現存四千百十五帖ナリ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。
鋟板ノ年月ヲ載セス。然レトモ紙質、墨色、字樣等ヲ考ルニ、五山ノ板ナリ。內卷二、卷二十九、卷三十ヲ闕ク。別本ヲ以テ補ヘリ。簡端ニ譯アリ。其書、最モ古色ヲ存ス。梁谷ノ印記アリ。餘印、文辨シカタシ。蓋浮圖氏ノ收藏也。

宋紹興板ニテ、芳春常住ト題セリ。吟風弄月ノ印記アリ。釋家ノ收本ナリ。又欄外ニ、芳春院公用トアリ。
右二種、毛利出雲守獻本中ノ書也。

韓板ニテ、成化中ノ刻本ナリ。此書、集ヲ以テ題スレトモ、奏議ノミ編纂シテ、一名翰苑集ト云フ。卷十九ノ後ニ、韓人題スル詩アリ。非翠＊爲樓重作梯、誰人獨宿倚門啼、夜坐寒燈達曉月、行行涯盡楚天關〈關字衍文ナルヘシ〉西、又卷二十ノ後ニ、柳碧黃鶯語、水靑白鳥來、江山無限景、盡入筆頭回、蓬原鄭押字トアリ。又卷二十二ノ後ニ、鳩鳴春洞幽、雨過新流碧、禪話有高僧、時來坐白石、亢冲撰トアリ。書中、文字核正ノ所、頗ル詳密ナリ。
韓板活字本ニテ、韓人ノ藏本印記アリ。

韓板活字本ナリ。
右五種、慶長賜書二十二種ノ中ナリ。

此書、永樂七年、濠ノ貞陰老人伍德カ本ヲ、嘉靖中挍刻セルヲ、亦抄寫セルナリ。モト明人ノ收藏ニテ、後淸ノ季振宜カ藏書トナル。書中、紅筆ヲ以テ數本ニヨリ挍正ス。題識ニ據リテ見ルヘシ。馮氏印記、空居閣印記アリ。卷首序後ニ紅筆ヲ以テ、此書先借何氏刻本印抄、因誤多不可改正、崇禎庚午先將英華文粹諸本挍過、至己卯始得葉林宗抄本、對得二十卷、存五卷未遇善本始俟之。錢牧齋云、復缺五卷、非全書也トアリ。卷八後ニ、崇禎己卯用錢牧齋抄本挍、共增四葉、十月十日ト記シ、空居閣ノ印記ヲ蹈ス。卷十七ノ後ニ、崇禎己卯借葉氏抄本挍過スト記シ、空居閣ノ印記ヲ蹈ス。又墨筆ヲ以テ、九月十一日夜、夢到一處、若看榜者、見榜中亦有余名、意頗悵惘、徐行而歸、似是邸舎、取筆書紅牋、作七言近體一首中、僅憶二句、比曉起又忘一句、其一句云、萬燈明裏哭孤身、回顧目前、無一人識面者、邸中亦竝新人、僕僮亦非舊從、若有無家之戚、嗚呼、余不作此夢矣、意境忡忡、豈隔世耶、他生耶、是時正閱此書、便筆記此、孱守居士ト記シ、己倉父ノ印記ヲ蹈ス。卷二十五ノ終ニ、天啓丁卯八月二十九錄完、十月初九釘成袠、二十九粗挍過、淨護居士記于含碧樓トアリテ、又空居閣ノ印記ヲ蹈ス。名家ノ藏本ヲ以テ、數次挍正スルノ書ナレハ、實ニ希珍ト云フヘシ。上賞ノ印記アリ。收本中ノ、最モ佳ナルヲ以テナリ。毛晉カ收本、宋槧ニ宋本ノ印ヲ蹈シ、亦甲乙ノ二印ヲ以テ、其書ヲ次第スルノ例ナリ。季振宜、前ニ見エタリ。或ハ孱守ト云フ、或ハ淨護ト云フ、皆記スルニ隱名ヲ以テス。今其人ヲ詳ニセス。馮氏印記、亦考フルトコロナシ。
宋板ニテ、曾魯カ考異本ナリ。紹興中ノ刊本。板式字樣賤陋ニシテ、坊刻ノ書ナリトイヘトモ、宋槧タルコト必セリ。

宋槧本。年月脫落シテ考フヘカラス。金澤文庫ノ收藏印記アリ。殘闕半ニ過ク。現存卷二十六至卷三十一、卷八十至卷八十五、卷百二十至卷百二十五。紙墨トモニ淸朗ニシテ、蝴蝶裝本也。四庫總目ニ、此書久佚、今從永樂大典裒次、釐爲六十卷トアリ。彼ニ佚シテ吾ニ傳フノ、久キコトヲ知ルヘシ。又本傳ニ集百卷ト稱シ、宋志及ヒ文獻通考共ニ百五十卷トシ、陳氏書錄及ヒ焦氏經籍志マタ百卷ト稱シテ、記載互ニ殊ナリ。今殘編中卷百二十五アルヲ以テ見レハ、宋志及ヒ通考ニ稱スル所、百五十卷本ノ眞面目タルコト昭昭タリ。殘闕多シト雖トモ、希珍ト云ヘキ也。
元板ニテ、刻板ノ年月ヲ載セス。總目ノ後ニ、建安魏忠卿刊梓于家塾トアリ。撫刻分明ニシテ、元刻ノ善本也。官庫、藏書、龜字ノ印記アリ。　本邦收書家ノ印ニシテ、其人ヲ考ヘス。又簡端ニ古譯アリ。
元板。撫印楮墨トモニ精潔ニシテ、刊刻ノ年月ヲ載セス。重屋、宗珍、宗通、宗栢ノ印記アリ。皆茶事ニ聞エアリ。右八種倶ニ、毛利出雲守（高翰）獻本中ノ書也。
宋板ニテ、刊刻ノ年月ヲ載セス。紙墨共ニ美ナリ。每卷首ニ、賜盧文庫＊ノ印記アリ。誰氏ノ藏ナルヤ詳ナラス。其他、印記亦詳ナラス。新見豐前守（正興）獻本五種ノ一ナリ。
元板ニテ、撫刻楮墨、トモニ佳ナラス。刻板ノ年月ナシ。四向庵＊、吟風弄月ノ印記アリ。篇首ニ、芳春常住ト記ス。釋家ノ收藏ナリ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。

宋板ニテ、金澤文庫ノ印記、每卷首後ニアリ。柴野彥助邦彥（栗山）自筆鑑定ノ文、是ニ附ス。其文中ニ、此本古色鬱紛、其爲當初原板、不可疑焉、首有金澤文庫印記、上杉氏舊藏也。流轉近歸于翫月堂小倉氏焉、凡宋刻傳者、唐人猶爲罕遘、況於萬里之外、其可不寶愛乎、借觀數十日、詳其編纂、僅止所職之文、制誥口宣批答及靑詞致語等之外、無一文及別題、蓋所謂制稾二十二卷者矣、其他奏議文集、知大體而剴切者、皆不可見、爲可惜已、小倉名祐利、以鬻書爲業ト記ス。附錄一卷、西垣類稾二卷ヲ倂セテ一本トシテ、金澤文庫ノ印記ナシ。新見豐前守獻本五種ノ一ナリ。
韓板活字本ナリ。宣賜之記ノ鈐印アリ。韓ノ賜本ナリ。卷首副葉ニ、嘉靖二十一年六月日、內賜司諫院正言閔起文朱子大全一件、命除謝恩、都承旨臣洪押字トアリ。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。
明嘉靖板。謝肇淛ノ藏本也。印記前ニ同シ。

元延祐刊本。板式前板ニ同シ。コレ又撫刻最初ノ本ナリ。
右二種倶ニ、毛利出雲守獻本中ノ書也。
明板。謝肇淛ノ藏本ナリ。印記前ニ同シ。
明萬曆刊本ニテ、徐■(火孛)カ藏本ナリ。徐■(火孛)、前ニ見エタリ。印記、前ニ同シ。

明萬曆板ニテ、內府藏書、王業浩印アリ。
右二種トモニ、毛利出雲守獻本ナリ。
慶長中、　命アリテ、五山ノ僧侶ヲシテ書寫令メラルル所ノ一ナリ。御本日記ニ、／（双擡）院御所ヨリ出ルト云フ、則是ナリ。

宋板。大本闊字ニテ、楮墨トモニ完好ナリ。廟諱缺筆セリ。卷一ノ後ニ、左從政郞充贛州州學敎授張之綱覆挍、州學司書蕭鵬挍對、鄕貢進士李大成挍勘トアリテ、刊板ノ年月ヲ載セス。宋時州學ノ監本ナリ。是書、駿府御文庫ヨリ遷サル。卷一後ニ、應永三十四四月三日、寫朱墨畢、重志、卷二後ニ、右卷應永三十四年丁未四月十二日、三更三點、於雲巢西窗寫點畢、重志、卷八後ニ、潛齋點之、卷二十六後ニ、舊本云、安元三年三月五、以文章博士敦周朝臣家本移點挍合畢、正五位下行助敎中原朝臣師直、又應永二十九菊月十一日、寫點畢、鼎子誌之ト記セリ。御本日記ニ、南化本ト題セルモノ是ナリ。僧南化玄興カ所藏ヲ上リシモノナリ。玄興カ印記アリ。

韓板活字ニテ、卷首ニ、嘉靖三十五年四月日、內賜承政院同副承旨臣朴押字トアリ。印記前ニ同シ。
右二種トモニ韓ノ賜本ニシテ、慶長賜書二十二種中也。
明板。朱墨本ニテ、釋獨立カ藏本也。獨立前ニ見エタリ。戴觀胤、字子辰、炎上人二印、亦前ニ出ツ。
明官板。四方寬大ニシテ、楮墨トモニ光潔ナリ。高靈申氏家藏ノ記アリ。其人ヲ考ヘス。毛利出雲守獻本ノ一也。
明泰昌刊板ニテ、字分明ニシテ初印ノ本ナリ。每册副葉ニ名媛ノ姓氏ヲ摘記ス。其書、細楷ニシテ最モ善書ナリ。
韓板活字ナリ。卷首ニ宣賜之記ノ鈐印アリ。韓ノ賜本ナリ。卷末ニ、圓光寺常住押字ト記セリ。南都一乗寺邑ノ、圓光寺ノ僧徒ノ藏本也。敬復齋ノ印記アリ。韓人ノ私印ナリ。

元至正年閒ノ槧本ニテ、字漫漶シ紙斷爛ス。榊原玄輔ノ藏本ニシテ、識語印記アリ。殘闕ノトコロ、玄輔補寫完全ス。玄輔最モ書名アリ。嘗テ官本ノ標題ヲ書セリ。今ニ存スルモノ少カラス。卷七十五ノ後ニ、此本數歷裝釘、紙幅減損、旣迫匡郭、釘痕甚多、不可復裝裁也、後之得焉者、勿改鑽之、元祿十三年重陽之後三日、榊原玄輔希翊識于江都紀邸之北玉照齋トアリ。又右以淸種德堂重訂行之本補完訖、近刻文字、尤多謬誤、此本雖苦麻沙、比近刻則最爲愈矣、古本可以其漫滅、而忽之如此矣、元祿十三年九月二十五日ト記セリ。玄輔、字希翊、篁洲ト號ス。木下順庵ノ門人ナリ。紀府ニ筮仕ス。最律學ニ長セリ。印記ハ其手刻スルトコロナリト云フ。
右三種、毛利出雲守獻本中ノ書也。

諺文ヲ以テ解ス。卷末副葉ニ、隆慶壬申抄冬、爲豚犬壽生買於瑞峯、僧淡慧ト記ス。表帙ニ遍明院ト記セリ。韓ノ浮圖氏ノ藏本ナリ。
右二種トモニ、毛利出雲守獻本ナリ。

Hōjō Echigo-no-kami Taira no Sanetoki was a grandson of Ukyō-gon-no-daibu Yoshitoki and a son of Mutsu-no-Gorō Sanayasu.
- Rekinin 1 (1238), 3rd month, 18th day: appointed Kamon-no-suke and a kurōdo of Sen'yōmon-in.
- Kenchō 5 (1253), 2nd month: added to the Hyōjō (Council of State).
- Year 7 (1255), 12th month, 13th day: appointed Echigo-no-kami.
- "Kōgen 3" (as written), 4th month: became head (shū-tō) of the Third Hikitsuke Division.
- Bun'ei 1 (1264), 6th month, 16th day: became head of the Second Division. 10th month, 25th day: became Ōso bugyō (magistrate of appeals).
- Year 2 (1265), 6th month, 27th day: raised to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade.
- Year 4 (1267), 4th month: resigned as Ōso bugyō.
- Year 10 (1273), 6th month, 25th day: became head of the First Division.
- Kenji 1 (1275), 5th month: because of illness, he went into seclusion at Mutsura.
- Year 2 (1276), 10th month, 23rd day: died at his villa in Mutsura, aged 53. [Source: *Kantō Hyōjō den*]

His son, Sakon-taifu Shōgen Akitoki:
- Kōan 1 (1278), 2nd month: added to the Hyōjō.
- Year 3 (1280), 11th month: appointed Echigo-no-kami.
- Year 4 (1281), 10th month: became head of the Fourth Hikitsuke Division. [Same source]

His son Sadaaki:
- Kengen 1 (1302): Nakatsukasa-no-taifu.
- 7th month, 26th day: entered Kyoto and resided at the Minamikata (Rokuhara South). He was styled "Kanazawa Taifu".
- Tokuji 1 (1306): Echigo-no-kami.
- Enkyō 2 (1309), 1st month, 17th day: arrived in Kamakura.
- Year 3 (1310): Sama-gon-no-kami.
- Shōwa 1 (1312): Musashi-no-kami.
- Year 4 (1315), 7th month, 11th day: "joint judgment" duties (*gōhan no koto*).
- Genkō 2 (1322): Shuri-gon-no-daibu.
- Shōchū 1 (1324): Shuri-daibu.
- Karyaku 1 (1326), 2nd month: Shikken (Regent). 4th month, 26th day: took Buddhist orders. [Sources: *Shikken-ki*, *Honchō tsugan*]

Variant notes: *Honchō tsugan* gives the 3rd month, 13th day for his becoming Shikken. *Azuma kagami* gives the 4th month, 16th day for his taking orders, under the name "Kanazawa-dono". *Honchō tsugan* says that on the 1st day of the 4th month he took the name Sōken (崇顯) and retired to Kanazawa.

Editor's comment (案): The colophon of *Gunsho chiyō* vol. 29, dated the 2nd month of Kagen 4 (1306), is signed "Junior Fifth Rank Upper, acting Echigo-no-kami, Taira no Ason Sadaaki". One should see from this that he was appointed Echigo-no-kami during the Kagen era. Also, the colophon of vol. 14, dated the 1st month of Tokuji 2 (1307), is signed "Junior Fifth Rank Upper", while the 2nd-month colophon is signed "Senior Fifth Rank Lower". That he was raised to Senior Fifth Rank Lower in the 2nd month of Tokuji 2 can be proved by the wording of these colophons.
Summary:
This is a biographical and official-career genealogy of the Kanazawa Hōjō (Sanetoki, Akitoki, Sadaaki), not an account of a book's movement. Its only book-related content is the editor's use of Sadaaki's dated colophon signatures in the *Gunsho chiyō* (vols. 29 and 14) to correct his dates of appointment to Echigo-no-kami (by 1306) and promotion to Senior Fifth Rank Lower (2nd month, 1307). No acquisition or transmission of a manuscript is described.

足利學校考
下野足利學ハ、承和六年、小野篁其國司タリシ時草創スト云ヒ、或ハ篁カ家塾ナリト云ヒ、或ハ天長九年八月、篁敕ヲ奉テ草創スト〈日本史ニ相傳、下野足利學校篁嘗讀書處、上杉憲實創爲學校、聖廟傍有一室、安置篁木主、今見存焉〉。大草紙ニ、承和九年、篁陸奧ノ守トナルヲ以テ廢スト云。文德實錄ニ、承和六年春正月、遂捍詔爲庶人、配流隱岐國トアリ。又日本史ニ、小野篁身奉綸旨、出使外境、而稱病不行、準據律條、可處絞刑、今特宥死罪一等、處之遠流、因免爲庶人、竄于隱岐トアレハ、其國司タリシトキ創立ト云フ、亦陸奧ノ守トナルヲ以テ廢スト云フ、皆誤ナルヘシ。年代綿邈ニシテ、其詳ナルヲ知ルヘカラス。又大草紙ニ、應仁元年、長尾爲景カ舊蹟存スルヲ以テ、今ノ所ニ移スト云〈爲景一作景久〉。文明中、釋快元、儒釋同一ノ學ヲ以テ中興ス。永享中、上杉憲實再興シ、釋菜ノ例ヲ行ヒ、生徒ノ庖廩ヲ次ス。又五經注疏等ノ書ヲ收ム。其子憲忠、其子憲房、相ヒ繼テ寄進ノ書アリ。其書今現存ス。慶長中、／神祖（德川家康）菜地ヲ　賜ヒ、又三要（閑室元佶）ニ活字十餘萬ヲ　賜フテ、剏メテ孔子家語ヲ刷印シ、繼キテ周易、貞觀政要、七書、東鑑等ヲ印行ス。三要及ヒ鹿苑ノ（西笑）承兌等ニ、跋語ヲ書セ令ラル。是ヲ慶長活字板、復ハ足利本ト云フ。林恕（鵝峯）カ續本朝通鑑、其顚末ヲ記セリ。左ニ附錄シ孝槪＊ニ示セリ。

永享十一年閏正月、憲實納五經注疏於下野國足利學校。傳稱、足利學者、小野篁家塾也。中葉以來、僧徒住焉。然不稱長老和尙、而稱先生、以敎授兒童。且有求者、講五經及六韜等。或曰、（足利）尊氏曾祈勝軍之事於足利學校、稱有驗。而招京師儒官管之。其人＊水土之變、而不幾早世。自是儒官厭東行而不來、故禪徒窺文字者領之云。
又學校有憲實文狀〈原書係諺語〉。
凡漢土自國學至鄕校、非儒者無司業。聞綿竹惟以僧爲之主。今本朝州學存者僅有數焉。率亦以僧爲之主、野之＊爲最。古者＊曰、畛服而爲縫腋之行、何乖戾甚。雖然文字敎授、有庶幾焉。故我以五經注疏本若干卷、安置于學舎。自今講習無怠、則文化之行、自家達于鄕、達于州、達于國天下、指日而可竢矣。嗟夫寶惜珍藏、壽齊金石。主者思之。
又有條目一通。其一曰、收蓄之固、其扃鑰針滕、勿浪借與人。若有志於披閱者、就舎內、看一册畢、可輙送還、不許將歸出閫外。其二曰、主事者進退時、新舊兩人相對、撿定每部卷數、而後可交代。其三曰、借讀者勿以丹墨加妄句、勿令紙背生毛、勿觸寒具手。其四曰、夏月梅雨濕糊櫃蒸、則至風凉可曝乾之、勿中屋瓦之漏濕。至冬月、則可嚴火禁之備。其五曰、或質于庫、或鬻于市、或爲穿窬所獲、則罪莫大焉。永享十一年己未閏正月初吉、前房州剌＊史藤原憲實。
〈此注疏本、每册首閫外有上杉安房守憲實寄進、每册後有不許學校出閫外、又郭上有足利學公用。〉
〈右注疏本中周易、題上杉右京亮憲忠寄進。蓋憲實所置之逸、憲忠補之乎。〉

Literal_English_Translation:
**Main entry**
- 永享十一年閏正月 / In the intercalary first month of Eikyō 11 (1439),
- 憲實納五經注疏於下野國足利學校 / Norizane deposited a set of the Five Classics with commentaries and sub-commentaries (五經注疏) in the Ashikaga School of Shimotsuke Province.
- 傳稱 / Tradition says:
- 足利學者、小野篁家塾也 / "The Ashikaga school was the family private school of Ono no Takamura."
- 中葉以來、僧徒住焉 / From the middle period onward, monks have resided there.
- 然不稱長老和尙、而稱先生 / Yet they are not called "elder" or "preceptor" but "sensei,"
- 以敎授兒童 / and they teach children.
- 且有求者、講五經及六韜等 / Moreover, when there are petitioners, they lecture on the Five Classics, the Six Secret Teachings (六韜), and the like.
- 或曰 / Some say:
- 尊氏曾祈勝軍之事於足利學校、稱有驗 / "Takauji once prayed at the Ashikaga School for victory in war, and it was said to be efficacious,"
- 而招京師儒官管之 / and so he summoned a Confucian official from the capital to administer it.
- 其人＊水土之變、而不幾早世 / This man [character illegible, perhaps "suffered"] the change of water and soil, and before long died young.
- 自是儒官厭東行而不來 / Since then Confucian officials, disliking the journey east, have not come,
- 故禪徒窺文字者領之云 / so Zen monks who had a glimpse of letters took charge of it, it is said.

**Norizane's document**
- 又學校有憲實文狀〈原書係諺語〉 / The school also has a written statement by Norizane. (Note: the original is in vernacular language.)
- 凡漢土自國學至鄕校、非儒者無司業 / "In China, from the state academies down to village schools, no one but a Confucian holds the post of director of studies (司業).
- 聞綿竹惟以僧爲之主 / I hear that only at Mianzhu are monks made the head.
- 今本朝州學存者僅有數焉 / In our country now, only a few provincial schools survive.
- 率亦以僧爲之主 / Mostly they too make monks their heads,
- 野之＊爲最 / and the [illegible] of Shimotsuke is the foremost of these.
- 古者＊曰 / An ancient [illegible] said:
- 畛服而爲縫腋之行、何乖戾甚 / 'Wearing [monastic] dress yet acting as a wide-sleeved scholar: how very perverse!' (畛服 is uncertain; probably a corruption or variant for a monk's garb.)
- 雖然文字敎授、有庶幾焉 / Even so, in the teaching of letters there is something to be hoped for.
- 故我以五經注疏本若干卷、安置于學舎 / Therefore I have placed several volumes of the Five Classics commentary edition in the school building.
- 自今講習無怠 / If from now on lecturing and study are not neglected,
- 則文化之行、自家達于鄕、達于州、達于國天下、指日而可竢矣 / then the spread of culture will go from the household to the village, to the province, to the state and all under heaven, and may be awaited within a few days.
- 嗟夫寶惜珍藏、壽齊金石 / Alas! Treasure them, guard them, store them; may their longevity equal metal and stone.
- 主者思之 / Let the head think on this."

**Regulations (five articles)**
- 又有條目一通 / There is also one set of regulations.
- 其一 / First: keep the collection secure, with locks and seals; do not lend it carelessly to others. If someone wishes to read, he should do so inside the building, finish one volume, and promptly return it; taking it out past the threshold is not permitted.
- 其二 / Second: when the person in charge enters or leaves office, the old and new men face each other, inspect and fix the number of volumes of each work, and only then hand over.
- 其三 / Third: borrowers must not add red or black marks to fanciful phrases, must not let fuzz or mold arise on the back of the paper, and must not touch the books with hands that have handled oily fried dough (寒具).
- 其四 / Fourth: in the summer plum rains, when paste is damp and cabinets steam, air-dry the books once the breeze turns cool, and do not let them be wetted by roof leaks. In winter, strictly prepare against fire.
- 其五 / Fifth: if they are pawned at a storehouse, sold in the market, or taken by a thief, no crime is greater.
- 永享十一年己未閏正月初吉 / First day of the intercalary first month, Eikyō 11, year kinoto-hitsuji (己未);
- 前房州剌＊史藤原憲實 / former governor of Bōshū (Awa), Fujiwara Norizane. (The character after 剌 is illegible.)

**Notes on the volumes**
- 此注疏本、每册首閫外有上杉安房守憲實寄進 / On this commentary edition, at the head of each volume, outside the frame, is inscribed "Donated by Uesugi, Governor of Awa, Norizane."
- 每册後有不許學校出閫外 / At the end of each volume is "Not permitted to leave the school's threshold."
- 又郭上有足利學公用 / Also on the frame is "For public use of the Ashikaga School."
- 右注疏本中周易、題上杉右京亮憲忠寄進 / Among the above commentary volumes, the Book of Changes is inscribed "Donated by Uesugi Ukyō-no-suke Noritada."
- 蓋憲實所置之逸、憲忠補之乎 / Probably it was a piece Norizane had placed that was lost, and Noritada supplied it to make up the lack.
Summary:
In 1439 Uesugi Norizane donated a set of the Five Classics with commentaries to the Ashikaga School in Shimotsuke, with a written statement and five rules to keep the volumes within the school, protected and unsold. The volumes carry donor and no-removal inscriptions, and the Book of Changes volume was later supplied by Uesugi Noritada to replace a lost original.

倶ニ慶長寫本ニシテ、／（双擡）院御所ヨリ出トアリ。
古寫本ニシテ、原本ハ、（藤原）定家ノ眞筆ヲ賴仲ノ寫セルナリト云フ。上＊卷ノ後ニ、大永二年九月書寫訖、令附與及愚也、卜雲謹書トアリ。下＊卷ノ後ニ、大永三年於武陵野屋書寫畢、卜雲令及愚老衲矣、及愚押字トアリ。年月ノ久シキ蠹蝕甚シクシテ、殆讀ヘカラス。享和二年、奉行成島仙藏（峯雄）ヲシテ新ニ一通ヲ寫サシメテ、是ヲ副ス。又命アリテ、撿挍（塙）保己一考勘書ヲ附セリ。
享保御小納戸本ニシテ、卷末ニ、吉野吉水院什物、古寫本也、享保十八年十一月、依／台命謹而書寫、沙彌充長トアリ。充長、姓ハ仁木、俗稱省二、冷泉爲綱、爲久二世ノ門人ニシテ、和歌ヲ以テ名アリ。

Title_and_Author: 新古今竟宴和歌懷紙寫
Volume_Info: 享保御小納戸本ニシテ、卷尾ニ、本書爲藤卿自筆、里村昌迪所藏也。先祖昌叱有故、自秀吉公所賜、本紙者曾有／（双擡）禁裏回祿、戊午之春了延呈上シ寫之ト記セリ。蓋戊午ハ元文三年ニシテ、成島道筑此書ヲ影寫セシナリ。
卷後ニ、以二十一代上人御本寫之、梧窗ノ印記アリ。
倶ニ南都興福寺ヨリ出ト云。其中、樂舞雜著ノ跋ニ、樂書二十二卷、古來祕傳也。藏在南都興福寺、不妄示人、今度新寫一部、以正本令挍合、所納江戸御文庫也、寬文六年正月ト記セリ。
舊藏ノ掌中要錄、錯誤多ニヨリ、元文五年、命アリテ京師伶官豐（豐原倫秋）伊賀守藏本ヲ新寫令メ、閏七月、御庫ニ收ム。原跋ニ、弘長三年九月日於安位寺花藏院書寫、執筆海王丸押字トアリ。
延慶二年、釋因空書スル所ニシテ、文永中、釋心空ノ傳ナリ。曾テ泉州坂本村ノ禪寂寺ノ舊藏ナリ。卷末ニ、延慶二年己酉八月十三日普一ヘ授クル跋、因空ノ押字アリ。竝河五一郞永正、搜索シテ獻ス。年月詳ナラス。
舊說ニ云フ、天正十八年、豐臣秀吉公小田原ノ北條氏政ヲ征伐ノ時、黑田勘解由孝高〈後薙髪號如水〉ヲシテ和平ヲ整ヘシム。氏直、其謝儀トシテ佩刀〈號日光一文字〉、白貝〈軍陣所用〉、書本東鑑ヲ以テ孝高ニ贈ル。其子筑前守長政ニ至リテ、東鑑ヲ／（双擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ニ獻スト云フ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案スルニ、黑田家譜云フ、慶長九年三月、備前守長政父勘解由孝高沒後、遺物トシテ／（単擡）東照大君（德川家康）ニ備前長光ノ刀、木丸ノ茶壺ヲ獻シ、／（単擡）台德大君ニ東鑑一部ヲ獻スト云フ、卽是ナリ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案スルニ ("Respectfully, upon examination,")
- 黑田家譜云フ ("the *Kuroda Kafu* (Kuroda genealogy) says:")
- 慶長九年三月 ("In the third month of Keichō 9 [1604],")
- 備前守長政 ("Nagamasa, Governor of Bizen,")
- 父勘解由孝高沒後 ("after the death of his father Yoshitaka [Kageyu],")
- 遺物トシテ ("as keepsakes of the deceased,")
- ／（単擡）東照大君（德川家康）ニ ("[line break, with the name raised one character in honor] to the Great Lord Tōshō (Tokugawa Ieyasu),")
- 備前長光ノ刀 ("a sword by Nagamitsu of Bizen,")
- 木丸ノ茶壺ヲ獻シ ("and a tea jar called Kimaru, he presented;")
- ／（単擡）台德大君ニ ("[line break, with the name raised in honor] and to the Great Lord Taitoku [Tokugawa Hidetada],")
- 東鑑一部ヲ獻スト云フ ("one set of the *Azuma Kagami* he presented, so it is said.")
- 卽是ナリ ("This is precisely the [item in question].")

Notes: The bracketed "単擡" marks are typographic or editorial notes on honorific line-raising. The text gives 備前守 for Nagamasa, though he is usually known by other titles. I have kept the text as written.
Summary:
According to the *Kuroda Kafu*, in 1604, after Kuroda Yoshitaka's death, his son Nagamasa presented a Bizen Nagamitsu sword and the Kimaru tea jar to Tokugawa Ieyasu and a set of the *Azuma Kagami* to Tokugawa Hidetada as keepsakes, and the annotator identifies this gift as the provenance of the book in question.

Volume_Info: 古寫本ニシテ、城方流ノ句讀アリ。
元文中、水府ノ藏本ヲ影抄セシメラルヽト云フ。
文和四年ノ寫本ニシテ、原本ハ建武四年ノ寫本ナル事ヲ、終卷ニ記セリ。歳月久ク、蠹蝕讀ムヘカラス。別ニ一通ヲ寫シテ副セラル。
此書、名存シテ其所在ヲ知サルコト久シ。寬政ノ初メ、老臣松平越中守定信、京師ヘ　令ヲ傳ヘテ探索アリシ＊、仁和寺ノ宮ニ藏スルヨシ、因リテ所司代ヨリ鷹司關白（輔平）ヘ白シ、關白ヨリ仁和寺ノ宮ヘ達シ、漸ク其書ヲ江戸ヘ送レルニヨリ、多紀永壽院（藍溪）ニ　命シ、其子弟及ヒ門人等相共ニ二本ヲ影鈔令メラレ、正本ヲ御庫ニ收メ、副本ハ永壽院ニ賜ハルト云フ。
紫野大德寺ノ藏書ナリシヲ、岡本玄冶買ヒ得タルコト、野（人見）卜幽軒カ東見記ニ見エタリ。其後享保中、繕寫シテ獻ス。
戸田要人祐之著ス。本草綱目ニ載スル品物ヲ辨論シ、其形狀ヲ圖シ、書成テ庶物類纂圖翼ト云フ。蓋シ草木ノ根葉ヲ寫眞シ、其種類ヲ分チ方名ヲ附セリ。安永中、命アリテ獻ス。八年四月、收ム。
岩本石見守正倫獻ス。／（双擡）有德大君、嘗テ白牛ヲ房州峯岡ノ野ニ放タシメラル。後頗ル蕃息ス。寬政中、石見守正倫、　命ヲ奉シ牛酪ヲ製シテ、四方ニ公行ス。醫生桃井寅（桃庵）ヲシテ、本草諸書ニ因リ主治ヲ鑑セシメ、其始末ヲ記ス。
肥後熊本ノ醫、村井杶（琴山）カ著ス所ナリ。享和中、細川越中守（齊茲）ニ　命アリテ、杶乃チ繕寫シテ獻スト云フ。
慶長寫本ノ一也。御本日記ニ、／（双擡）院御所ヨリ出トアリ。

Title_and_Author: 曾我物語〈一名報恩謝德集〉
Volume_Info: 享保御小納戸本ニシテ、天文中ノ寫本ナリ。富士山本門寺ノ什物ニテ、每卷、天文二十三年某月寫ト云フ。竝ニ日義押字トアリ。卷十ノ後ニ、當山第十在日殿座人、初名日義、天文十年二月六日ト記セリ。
文化四年、　命アリテ華蠻ノ諸圖ヲ參訂シ、是ヲ銅ニ鐫シム。略圖ハ其稾本ナリト云フ。
文化中、奧御右筆所詰屋代太郞弘賢、　命ヲ奉シテ編集スル所ニシテ、本朝ノ類書ナリ。部門ヲ十八ニ分チ、全部一萬餘册ト云フ。大業ナルヲ以テ、先ツ每歳稾本ヲ以テ／御覽ニ備フル所ノ本、凡數百册。天保辛巳、弘賢沒ス。故ニ未卒業。ソノ／御覽ニ經ル者、常ニ奧ニ停メラル。天保十五年炎上ノ砌、燒失シテ、缺殘纔ニ四册、御庫ニ收メラル。
新井君美（白石）カ著ス所ニシテ、寬政七年十月、其子抱義ニ至テ是ヲ獻ス。／（双擡）文昭大君（德川家宣）、初メ櫻田邸ニ於テ、君美ニ詩經ヲ講セシムル日、／御覽ニ備ヘタルモノニシテ、圖ハ狩野春湖ノ筆ナリ。君美ノ書セル目錄一卷アリ。圖皆片紙ニシテ、散逸セシ＊コトヲ恐ル。後　旨ヲ得テ裝褙、帖本トナセリ。
御本日記ニ載スル、道春（林羅山）所司ノ書ナリ。
倶ニ享保御小納戸本ニテ、新井君美、撰幷ヒニ書スル所也。
林衡（述齋）編ス。此書ハ、唐土ニ佚シテ本朝ニ傳ハリタル典籍ヲ輯メ、活字板ヲ以テ刷印スルモノナリ。

御文庫ノ設ハ／（三擡）東照大君（德川家康）、駿府御在城ノ時ニ始マル。林道春信勝（羅山）、ソノ管鑰ヲ掌トルコト、載テソノ年譜ニ見ユ。慶長十九年七月、駿府ヨリ／（三擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ニ御書籍三十部ヲ賜フ。コノ時ニ、道春ト與安法印宗哲ト、連署ノ書アリ。江戸ヨリモ、永喜（林東舟）ト閑齋法印トノ答簡アリ。是ヲモテ考フレハ、與安法印モマタ、道春ト共ニ典籍ヲ司トリシナルヘシ。當時江戸御文庫ノコト、今詳ニシカタシ〈永喜、初名ハ信澄。道春ノ弟ニシテ江城ニ奉仕ス。與安、名ハ宗哲。醫ヲモテ駿府ニ奉仕ス。閑齋ノ履歷、詳ナラス〉。抑慶長元和ノ閒、四方多事ノ日ニ當リテ廣ク典籍ヲ蒐メ、駿府官庫ニ藏メテ、稽古右文ノ用ニ備ヘタマフ。元和二年／（三擡）東照大君薨去ノ後、道春　遺命ヲ奉シテ、（德川）義直卿、（德川）賴宣卿、（德川）賴房卿ニ分チ、日本ノ舊記オヨヒ希世ノ書ハ、江戸ノ御文庫ニ收メシヨシ、信勝カ年譜、駿府日記等ニ載ス。コレヨリ駿府御文庫ハ遂ニ廢シヌ。今御文庫ニ存スル道春ノ御本日記ハ、コノ時ノ目錄ナルニヤ、明據ナシ。寬永十年十二月二十日、奧向勤仕關兵三郞（正成）〈ノチ兵左衞門ト改ム〉、御納戸星合豬左衞門（具枚）、大御番三雲內記（成賢）、西尾加右衞門（正保）ヲモテ、始メテ御書物奉行ニ　命セラル。コレ司籍ノ官ヲ置ル權輿ナリ〈始メテ奉行ヲ　命セラレヽ＊ヲモテ書ス。ソノ餘ハ後ノ履歷ノ條ニ詳ナレハ記セス。モシソノ異常ノ者アレハ特書ス〉。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案スルニ、豬左衞門等カ家譜ニ云フ、寬永十三年丙子／（三擡）仙洞御所ヨリ律令ノ書ヲ求メ給フ。松平伊豆守（信綱）　旨ヲ奉シ、十月鎌倉ノ建長寺、圓覺寺ノ西堂オヨヒ緇徒二十餘人ヲ江戸ノ海禪寺ニ招キ、金澤文庫ノ律令ヲ書寫セシメラレ、林道春（羅山）、林永喜（東舟）コレヲ挍正シ、豬左衞門等ソノ事ヲ奉行ス。マタ十八年庚辰、太田備中守（資宗）　旨ヲ奉シテ、諸家ノ系圖ヲ撰フ。豬左衞門等、ソノ席ノ奉行タリト云フ。今採錄シテ考據ニ備フ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案スルニ: "Respectfully considering this,"
- 豬左衞門等カ家譜ニ云フ: "the family genealogy of Inosaemon and others says:"
- 寬永十三年丙子: "In the 13th year of Kan'ei (1636, hinoe-ne),"
- （三擡）仙洞御所ヨリ律令ノ書ヲ求メ給フ: "(three-character raised honorific space in the original) the Retired Emperor's Palace (Sentō Gosho) requested books of the Ritsuryō (legal codes)."
- 松平伊豆守（信綱）旨ヲ奉シ: "Matsudaira Izu-no-kami (Nobutsuna), receiving the order,"
- 十月鎌倉ノ建長寺、圓覺寺ノ西堂オヨヒ緇徒二十餘人ヲ江戸ノ海禪寺ニ招キ: "in the tenth month summoned the senior monks (seidō) of Kenchōji and Engakuji in Kamakura, together with some twenty black-robed monks, to Kaizenji in Edo,"
- 金澤文庫ノ律令ヲ書寫セシメラレ: "and had them copy the Ritsuryō held in the Kanazawa Bunko."
- 林道春（羅山）、林永喜（東舟）コレヲ挍正シ: "Hayashi Dōshun (Razan) and Hayashi Eiki (Tōshū) collated and corrected it,"
- 豬左衞門等ソノ事ヲ奉行ス: "and Inosaemon and others administered the affair."
- マタ十八年庚辰: "Again, in the 18th year (1641, kanoe-tatsu),"
- 太田備中守（資宗）旨ヲ奉シテ: "Ōta Bitchū-no-kami (Sukemune), receiving the order,"
- 諸家ノ系圖ヲ撰フ: "compiled the genealogies of the various houses."
- 豬左衞門等、ソノ席ノ奉行タリト云フ: "Inosaemon and others are said to have been the administrators of that session/office."
- 今採錄シテ考據ニ備フ: "I have now excerpted and recorded this, to provide for reference and verification."
Summary:
According to the family record, in 1636 the Retired Emperor requested Ritsuryō texts, so Matsudaira Nobutsuna had Kamakura monks copy the Kanazawa Bunko's Ritsuryō manuscripts at Kaizenji in Edo, with the Hayashi scholars collating them and Inosaemon's family overseeing the work, and the same family later oversaw the 1641 genealogy compilation.

Volume_Info: 十一月、始メテ屬吏四人ヲ置カル。今御書物同心ト稱スル者、コヽニ始マル〈コレヨリサキ、曝書ノ日コトニ　御本丸ヨリ坊主四五人來リテ、典籍ヲ出納ス。コノ後ソノ事ヲ停メテ、屬吏ヲシテソノ役ニ給セシム〉。
七月、林大學頭緘封セシ御書橱、モト十八アリ。本月十一日ヨリソノ家ニ送リテ、コレヲ曝サシム。十五日、事畢リテ還納ス。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案スルニ、在昔御書橱ヲ緘封スルニ、五等ノ別アリ。老中、若年寄、林大學頭、御小納戸オヨヒ奉行等ナリ。特ニ大學頭ノ封函ハ、ソノ第ニ送リテ凉曝アリシト云フ。コノコト中コロ停ミテ、マタ官庫ニテ曝書スル事トナレリ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案スルニ — "Respectfully considering (this)..."
- 在昔御書橱ヲ緘封スルニ — "in former times, when sealing the honorable book-cabinets,"
- 五等ノ別アリ — "there were distinctions of five ranks."
- 老中、若年寄、林大學頭、御小納戸オヨヒ奉行等ナリ — "[they] were: the Rōjū (Senior Councillors), the Wakadoshiyori (Junior Councillors), Hayashi Daigaku-no-kami, the O-konando (Attendants), and the Bugyō (Magistrates) and the like."
- 特ニ大學頭ノ封函ハ — "In particular, as for the sealed cases of the Daigaku-no-kami,"
- ソノ第ニ送リテ凉曝アリシト云フ — "[they] were sent to his residence, where cool-airing/airing-out took place, it is said."
- コノコト中コロ停ミテ — "This practice, in the middle period, ceased,"
- マタ官庫ニテ曝書スル事トナレリ — "and it again became the case that book-airing was carried out at the official storehouse."
Summary:
The text records no acquisition; it describes how the shogunal book cabinets were sealed by five ranks of officials, with the Hayashi Daigaku-no-kami's sealed cases sent to his residence for airing, a practice that lapsed and was replaced by airing the books at the official storehouse.
---

Volume_Info: 十月十九日、西丸御書物奉行淺井半右衞門（淸盈）〈ノチ請フテ石川ニ復姓ス〉、平井五右衞門（次久）二人　命アリテ、／御本丸ノ同僚ニ入ル。其屬吏四人、亦從フ。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案スルニ、コノ二人櫻田邸ノ時ヨリ／（三擡）文昭大君（德川家宣）ニ奉仕シ、西丸ニ徙ラセタマフ。後一時西丸御書物奉行トナリシモノナルヘシ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案スルニ: "Respectfully considering (this)…"
- コノ二人: "these two men"
- 櫻田邸ノ時ヨリ: "from the time of the Sakurada mansion"
- ／（三擡）: [a line break, with the editorial note that the following was raised three spaces in the original, a convention of honorific elevation]
- 文昭大君（德川家宣）ニ奉仕シ: "served Lord Bunshō (Tokugawa Ienobu)"
- 西丸ニ徙ラセタマフ: "and when he (honorific) moved to the Nishinomaru (the Western Citadel)…"
- 後一時西丸御書物奉行トナリシモノナルヘシ: "afterward, for a time, they probably became Nishinomaru Keepers of Books (shomotsu bugyō)."
Summary:
The note reasons that these two men, who had served Tokugawa Ienobu since his Sakurada residence days and accompanied him to the Nishinomaru, were probably the ones who briefly held the post of Nishinomaru book magistrate. This ties the books' custody to Ienobu's household and the Nishinomaru collection. The passage records personnel and custodial links, not a physical transfer of books.
---

Volume_Info: 七月十九日、櫻田邸ノ典籍ヲ御文庫ヘ轉搬アリ。曝書ノ日、　御本丸ヨリ御小性一人來リテ監視シ、事訖レハ御書目ヲ返納ストイヘリ〈櫻田邸ヨリ移サルヽノ書籍、凉曝ノ事ヲ奉行等司トルヘキヨシ、去年ソノ　命アリ。ソノ後、御小性監視ノ事止ミテ、曝書ハナホ舊ニ依ル〉。
十一月、御庫ノ愚管抄ヲ月光院（勝田輝子）殿ヘ贈ラセラル。此ノ本モト／（三擡）禁裏ヨリ賜ハルトコロナルヲモテ、後チ復御庫ヘ返シ納メラル。
十一月十日、稾本ヲモテ　呈ス。重テ再訂ノ　命アリ。
＊二月二日、御書籍副本、數部アルモノハ二部ヲ存シ、古寫本、古譯本、別本等ハ、數部重複ストイヘトモ、ナホ貯フヘキヨシ、左兵衞佐（土岐朝直）　命ヲ傳フ。
九月十三日、重複本査勘オハリ、凡例オヨヒ目錄ヲ作リテ、左兵衞佐ヘ達ス。
（九月）二十九日、文獻通考、正續トモニ／（三擡）禁裏ヘ進獻ノ　命アリ。闕本ハ、大學頭（林榴岡）足シ成スヘキヨシヲ　命セサル＊。
九月二日、重複本ノウチ、右衞門督（田安宗武）殿、小五郞（德川宗尹）殿ニ賜フノ餘ハ、書賈ニ下スヘキヨシ、若年寄本多伊豫守（忠統）達ス〈十二月、賜書ヲ兩邸ニ送リ、ソノ餘ハ明年二月、書賈ニ下ス〉。
十一月二日、諸家ノ進本モ、重複セルハ刪除スヘキヨシ　命アリ。
四月二日、御書目改正ナル。正副二部トモニ、左兵衞佐（土岐朝直）ヘ達ス。四月二十九日、ソノ囑ニヨリテ、マタ伊豫守（本多忠統）ニ呈ス。伊豫守ヨリ兵庫頭（有馬氏倫）ニ附シテ進　覽ス。體裁　旨ニ叶ヘリトナリ。
六月二十二日、　命アリテ、／御年譜五部ノウチ、林大學頭獻本ヲ存シ、ソノ餘ノ三部ヲ火ニ投スヘキヨシ、左兵衞佐達セリ〈ノチ挍勘オハリテ、御臺所石之閒ニオイテ火中ス〉。
十二月二十日、今ヨリノチ、每日一人詰番スヘキヨシ、伊豫守（本多忠統）コレヲ達ス。
正月十日、御書目ニ闕本ヲ記スルノハシメヲ問ハシメタマフ。年月詳カナラサルヲモテ奉答ス。
（正月）十四日、明月記闕本、水府藏書ヲモテ補正スヘキノ　命アリ〈サラニ內命アリテ、桂山三郞左衞門（義樹）、水府儒臣ニ議シ、明月記附錄補遺ヲエテ呈ス〉。
六月十四日、享保七年以來、諸家獻書ノ內、類聚國史、日本後紀、弘安禮節等、僞撰ノ議サダマリシ書ハ、火中スヘキコトヲ、左兵衞佐（土岐朝直）ヘ白ス。
三月二十八日、類聚國史挍定ノ　命アリ。六月五日、園太曆、日本後紀纂挍正ノ　命アリ〈水府ナラヒニ林大學頭（榴岡）藏書ヲ以テ挍正ス〉。十九日、類聚國史挍オハル。每卷跋文ヲ加ヘテ進　呈ス〈ノチ　命アリテ、僞撰オヨヒ重複ニ屬スルモノ二十五册、湯方ニオイテ火中ス〉。又林大學頭家藏ノ類聚國史、屬吏ヲシテ影寫セシムヘキノ　命アリ。
九月十二日／（三擡）文昭大君（德川家宣）　御手澤本、新ニ別函ヲ設テ收ムヘキノ　命アリ。
四月六日、京師ノ伶官、豐（豐原倫秋）伊賀守藏本掌中要錄影寫ノ　命アリ。

十二月二十六日、奉行等、西丸御用多ヲモテ、オノオノ金一枚ヲ賜フ〈屬吏ノ賜、差アリ〉。
今ヨリノチ、御條目、御法令、三四年ニ一度曝書スヘキヨシ、老中本多中務大輔（忠良）、コレヲ達ス。是ヨリ御黑書院ニテ曝書シ、老中緘封スル故事トナレリ。
五月、伊豫守（本多忠統）　命ヲ傳ヘテ、寬文、貞享、正德ノ御朱印副本ヲ、平川口御櫓ニ移ス〈近年新收ノ書多ク、御庫ニ充牣スルヲモテ、請フトコロヲ允セラルヽナリ〉。
二月十一日、享保、延享中ノ御朱印副本ヲ、例ニヨリテ平川口渡御櫓ヘ轉置ス。
六月二十五日、寫本羣書治要ヲ尾藩ヘ借サル。八月十日、返納アリ。
六月十一日、今度御朱印ノ副本收貯ノ命アリ。ヨリテ寶曆中ノ御朱印ヲ、平川口渡御多門ヘ移サンコトヲ、若年寄靑山大膳亮（幸完）ヘ言ス。十八日、ソノ請ヒヲ許サル。
七月十一日、御朱印副本、平川口渡御多門ヨリ、百人組番所後二重御櫓ヘ轉置ス。
二月十九日、地圖ノ蠹敗ヲ總計シテ進言スヘキヨシ、老中格本多彈正大弼（忠籌）、仙藏（成島峯雄）ヘ達ス。
（三月）二十八日、舊本諸國地圖等修補スヘキヨシ、攝津守コレヲ達ス。
十月六日、慶長中／（三擡）東照大君（德川家康）ヨリ／（三擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ヘ御讓リノ御書籍三十部ヲ査檢スヘキヨシ、攝津守（堀田正敦）達ス。同月十一日、仙藏（成島峯雄）三十部ノ御書籍有無、異同等ヲ錄シ、本書ニソヘテ攝津守ヘ呈ス。
四月九日、新收古寫本禮記注疏、蠹食アルヲ以テ、裱背修理センコトヲ攝津守（堀田正敦）ヘ進言ス。ノチ言フトコロヲ可セラル。
（十二月）二十三日、新訂御書目副本一部ヲ、御次ニ置ルヘキノ　旨アリ。乃チ其副本ヲ、御小性神尾豐後守（守富）ニ授ク。コノ事ニ與ル者、ノチ皆賜アリ。
四月二十七日、新收ノ無版書、乾隆四庫全書無版本ト題シ、竝ニ小目ヲ掲記シ撿閱ニ便ナランコトヲ、攝津守（堀田正敦）進言シ、二十八日、言ストコロヲ允ルサル。
七月十一日、屬吏江西文藏、無版本標題竝ニ小目ヲ書スルニヨリテ、賞賜アリ。
十一月二日、成島邦之助（東岳）、容臺文集奧御本、御文庫本トモニ脫落多キヲモテ、補寫スヘキノ　命アリト云フ。
六月二十九日、醫官杉本忠温（樗園）、多紀安長（桂山）等カ請ヒニヨリテ、幼幼新書、醫學集成二書ヲ、醫學館ニ借サル。
七月八日、／御前本、駿府御文庫本等、貴重各種ノ目錄ヲ周防守（京極高備）ニ示ス。マタ詩經圖〈新井筑後守（白石）進講ノ日、御覽ニ備ヘシトコロ也〉オヨヒ金澤本法曹類林等、軸子モシクハ帖本トナサハ可ナランコトヲ、若年寄植村駿河守（家長）ニ白ス。ソノ請ヒヲ可セラル。
（七月）二十五日、式部卿（德川齊順）殿紀藩ニ入ラルヽニヨリ、四書、五經、小學、近思錄、三大全、十三經注疏、大學衍義正補、二十一史、七編通鑑、三大書等、副本アルハ査勘スヘキヨシ、老中酒井若狭守（忠進）達セリ。
八月二日、先ニ／御前本、駿河御文庫本、金澤本等ハ分ケテ貴重アルヘキヨシ、書目ヲモテ周防守ヘ進言セシニ、マタ來歷ヲ記シテ言スヘキ旨アリ。
十一月二日、式部卿殿賜書ノウチ、大學衍義ハ林大學頭（述齋）所藏ノ本ヲ獻セシメラレ、ソノ餘ハ御庫ノ書ヲ賜フ。二十一史、册府元龜、文苑英華ノ如キ、副本ナキ者ハ、舶來ヲマチテ御庫ノ缺ヲ補ハルヽムネ、周防守（京極高備）達ス。
二月十一日、是レヨリサキ、北條本東鑑、慶長活字版、駿府本、享保新寫本等、顚末ヲ記シテ架ヲ別チ、貴重トセンコトヲ請フ。コヽニオイテ命アリ。東鑑ヲ北條本ト稱シ、駿府二十二部ヲ御讓本ト稱シ、享保新寫本ヲ享保新寫挍合本ト稱シ、金澤本、宋元槧本、慶長活字版、ミナ架ヲ別チテ貴重スヘキムネ、周防守（京極高備）達セリ。
三月五日、逍遙院（三條西實隆）寫本史記、元槧史記、前後漢書、韓版北史、唐書ヲ、松平加賀守（前田齊廣）ニ借サル〈コレヨリサキ、加賀守、官庫ノ書ヲモテ十七史ヲ挍讎センコトヲ請フ。土井大炊頭（利厚）、ソノ書ヲ下シテ舊例ヲ問ハル。ノチ松平伊豆守（信明）、挍讎ノ考據トナルヘキ書名ヲ問ハレシコトアリ。竝ニ書ヲモテ答フ〉。
四月十五日、／御前本、慶長寫本、活字版、每種別函ヲ造ランコトヲ、周防守ニ言ス。マタ曾テ、天文方吉田勇太郞（秀賢）ニ借サレシ圖書集成ノウチ、乾象、庶徵、曆法ノ三典、別ニ一通ヲ抄寫シ、原本ハ御庫ニ還納シテ可ナランコトヲ言ス。
八月七日、御書籍中ノ、書帕本及ヒ第本等ノ陋本ヲ芟除シ、正本ノミヲ重訂ノ書目ニ載センコトヲ、周防守ヘ言ス。
九月十一日、醫書、國書ノ目ヲ、醫學館ノ主事杉本忠温（樗園）、多紀安長（桂山）オヨヒ、和學講談所塙保己一ニ下シテ、正僞ヲ挍勘セシメンコトヲ言ス。スナハチ允サルヽニ因リテ、書目ヲ致シ、ナホ辨シ難キハ、忠温等ニ面說シ、コレヲ定メシム。
六月十五日、淳化閣法帖、年月ノ久キ表背損壞ス。前ニ星鳳樓帖等修理ノ如ク、表背修飾ヲ新ニセン事ヲ、周防守（京極高備）ニ言ス。允セラルヽヲモテ、御書物師唐本屋淸之丞ニ官金ヲ與ヘ、自宅ニ下シテ修理セシム。
二月八日、サキニ紀伊宰相（德川齊順）殿、藩ニ入ラルル時賜フトコロノ御書籍、御庫ニ副本ナキハ、唐刻ハ舶齎ヲモテソノ缺ヲ補ンカ爲メ、ソノ書ヲ載セ來ルヘキコトヲ、長崎奉行等ヘ　命セラルヘキコトヲ言ス。ソノ言フトコロヲ允セラル。
三月、書目挍正ニヨリテ諸書ヲ檢閱スルニ、慶長刊版和玉篇ハ／（三擡）大猷大君（德川家光）　御前ニ置ルヽノ書ニシテ、享保中御小性土岐左兵衞佐（朝直）ノ證書アリ。ヨリテ今　御手澤本中ニ置キ架ヲ分タンコトヲ、周防守（京極高備）ニ言ス。後　旨ヲ得タリ。
九月五日、先ニ文化八年、對州ニオイテ朝鮮聘禮ノ來翰摹本オヨヒ／（三擡）儲君（德川家慶）ヘ上ル別幅一緘ヲ御庫ニ收メラレ、來翰眞本ハ收メラレス。古常ニ從ヒ御庫ニ置ルヘキコトヲ、周防守ヘ言シ、マタ琉球ノ簡書モ、正德以後ハ收メラレサル事ヲ言ス。
三月二十日、天明以後、御用部屋等ニ畱メラレテ、今御庫ニ目錄ノミ存スルハ、ソノ目ヲ刪ルヘク、オヨヒ天文方、醫局等ニ借サルヽモノハ、寫シ取リテ、本書ヲ還納セシメラルヘキヨシヲ白ス。
五月三日、貞享版近思錄ヲ收ム。前ノ賜本ノ闕ヲ補フトコロナリ。
十一月二十一日、全唐文四十套三百二十本ヲ收メラルヽ旨ヲ、若年寄林肥後守（忠英）達ス〈コレヨリサキ、奉行等カ建言ニヨリテ、唐商ニ令シテ舶齎セシムルトコロナリ〉。
七月十二日、出雲守進本、經史子集スヘテ八百八部一萬四千二百本、道藏經全部四千百五帖、收貯ニ備ハリシ事ヲ、上總介（京極高備）〈コレヨリサキ、周防守ト稱ス〉ヘ言ス。
（七月）十九日、新訂御書目錄ノ挍正、旣ニ業ヲ卒リ、淨書過半ニ至ルトコロ、出雲守進本收貯ニヨリ、御書目ニ追錄シ、書ノ可否オヨヒ撰人名氏ヲ考訂セシメン事ヲ、林右近（復齋）〈ノチ式部ト改ム〉一人ヲシテ、モツハラ司トラシメハ便ナラン事ヲ、上總介ヘ言ス。ノチ命アリテ、右近オヨヒ勝田彌十郞（獻）二人、事ヲ司トルヘシトナリ。
八月十五日、進本考訂ニヨリ、御書目挍正ニ與ル屬吏ノ員、二人ヲ增サン事ヲ、上總介ヘ請フテ、スナハチ允セラル。
（八月）十八日、出雲守進本、ステニ一萬册餘ニ及ヘハ、コレカタメニ造ルノ書筐モマタ夥シ。然レハ曩ニ建言スル陋本、重本ヲ刪除シテ書筐ノ數ヲ減シ、ナカンツク生徒敎育ノ用トナルヘキモノハ學問所ニ送リ、ソノ餘ハ、享保、寬保ノ例ヲモテ、書賈ニ下サンコトヲ、上總介ヘ請フテ可セラル。
五月九日、毛利出雲守（高翰）獻本書目ナリテ、大和守（堀親寶）ヘ呈ス。カツソノ蠹敗アル者ハ、修理センコトヲ言ス。
十二月二十八日、サキニ上總介（京極高備）、重本、陋本刪除ノ請ヒヲ可セラル。今再ヒソノ書目ヲ添ヘテ、大和守（堀親寶）ヘ言ス。ソノ言ストコロヲ允セラルヽ旨、田中龍之助（良顯）ヲモテ達セラル〈後ニ林左近將監（檉宇）、御庫ニ來リテ一一撿閱ス。明年六月、ソノ書ヲ學問所ニ送リ、餘ハ書賈ニ下ス〉。
（十二月）二十九日、毛利出雲守（高翰）獻本目錄訂正ノ賞トシテ、林式部（復齋）、勝田彌十郞（獻）ニ、オノオノ銀五枚ヲ賜フ＊〈屬吏ノ事ニ與カル者五人、オノオノ金一兩ヲ賜フ〉。
八月十日、陋本ノ金ヲモテ、御庫中闕卷補寫オヨヒ、新貯ノ費ヘニ充ンコトヲ、大和守（堀親寶）ニ白ス。ソノ言ヲ充セラルヽ＊旨、田中龍之助（良顯）ヲモテ達セラル。
（八月）二十日、重訂御書目中ヘ毛利出雲守（高翰）獻本ノ目ヲ加ヘンコトヲ言シテ、可セラル。
十二月二十日、陋本ノ金ヲ、假ニ御金藏ヘ收ム。
三月二十三日、出雲守（毛利高翰）獻本四千册餘、修理ナルコトヲ、大和守（堀親寶）ヘ白ス。
十二月十九日、出雲守（毛利高翰）獻本修補ノコトヲ賞セラレ、林式部（復齋）、篠田藤四郞（懋）ニ、各銀七枚ヲ賜フ〈屬吏ノ事ニ與ル者、ミナ金ヲ賜フ。差アリ〉。
十二月八日、重訂御書目成功シテ、本篇目次トモニ十九册、始末記一册、來歷志四册、彙刻目十八册、アハセテ四十二册ヲ、重訂御書籍目錄ト題シ、五通ヲ進呈ス。一通ハ御前ニ畱メラレ、一通ハ副本トシ、二通ハ御庫ニ置カレ、一通ハ林大學頭（述齋）ニ授ケラル。
二月、サキニ御金藏ニ假リ收メトセシ陋本ノ御拂ヒ代金ヲ、アラタメテ本收トス〈假リニ御金藏ニ收メテ、書籍購求、缺卷補寫等ノ費用ニアテシ、殘餘ノ金ナリ〉。
十一月、奉行ノ建言ニヨリテ、陋本三十三部ヲ書賈ニ下サシメラル。コノ代金ヲモテ、書櫃ノ不足ヲ補ヒ、蠹敗ヲ修補セシメラル。
／御本丸炎上ノ時、燒失セシ御書物數十部アルヲモテ、寫本ハ補寫シ、刊本ハ書賈ニ購求センコトヲ、若年寄大岡主膳正（忠固）ニ建言シテ、言フトコロヲ可セラル〈屬吏九人、舊例ノ如ク月俸金ヲ賜ハランコトヲ請フテ、允サル〉。
十月十二日、出雲守（毛利高翰）獻本道藏經ノ蠹敗ヲ修繕セン事ヲ、主膳正（大岡忠固）ニ建言ス。後、云フ所ノ如ク命セラル〈屬吏ノ事ニ習フ者、十一人ヲ撰テ從事セシム。因テ舊例ノ如ク、月俸金ヲ賜ハラン事ヲ請テ允サル〉。

十二月廿七日、出雲守（毛利高翰）獻本道藏經、修繕成功ニヨリ、其賞トシテ木村薫平（定政）、石井內藏允（至穀）ニ、各銀十枚、武島安左衞門（茂潤）ニ同七枚、島田帶刀（政富）ニ同五枚ヲ賜フ。又二丸御畱守居金井伊太夫（俊有）ニ卷物五、御廣鋪番ノ頭、水野新衞門（忠篤）ニ銀十五枚、同佐山源右衞門（正武）ニ銀二十枚ヲ賜フ。此三人ハ、前ニ御書物奉行勤務中、修繕ノ事ニ與リシニ因テナリ〈屬吏ノ事ニ與ル者、十一人ニ賜金、差アリ〉。
十二月廿一日、去月　御本丸炎上ノ時、燒亡セシ御書籍數部アルヲモテ、去ル弘化元年丙辰ノ例ニヨリ、寫本ハ補寫シ刊本ハ書賈ニ購求センコトヲ、若年寄諏訪因幡守（忠誠）ニ建言シテ、同月廿八日、言フトコロノ如ク　命セラル〈屬吏七人ヲ撰ヒテ、從事セシム。月俸金等ノコト、弘化元年丙辰ノ例ニヨル。ノチ百辟譜略ハ、奉行等ノ建言ニヨリ、御系圖調所ニテ補寫ノ命アリ〉。

〈寶曆元年十月二十七日、大御番ヨリ　命セラル。安永九年四月六日、病ニヨツテ免ス。〉

北條越後守（實時）、武州久良郡六浦庄金澤ニ文庫ヲ建テ、和漢ノ書ヲ收儲シ金澤文庫ノ印記ヲ蹈ス〈金澤ノ稱名寺、其遺蹤ナルヲ以テ稱名寺文庫トモ云フ〉。一ニ越後守實時カ建ル所ナリト云ヒ、一ニ其子顯時カ建ル所ナリト云フ。又ハ其子貞顯カ建ル所ナリト云フ。當時ノ記載、徵スヘキモノ無ケレハ、其然否ヲ必トセス。今其儲藏ヲ以テ考ルニ、卷子本アリ、册本アリ。官ニ收スル卷本左傳、羣書治要、令義解、本朝文粹＊等ノ識語ニ、弘長、文永、建治中書寫挍合畢、越州剌史＊押字ト記スルハ、實時カ自記スル也。羣書治要卷二十九ノ識語ニ、嘉元四年二月二十八日以右大辨三位經雄卿本書寫點挍畢、此書祖父越州之時被終一部之功處、後年少少紛失、仍書加之而已、從五位上行越後守平貞顯ト自記セルヲ以テ考フレハ、實時ナルコトヲ知ルヘシ。又左傳卷十四ノ識語ニ、弘安元年九月二十二日以音博士俊隆眞人之本書寫點挍畢、從五位下行左近衞將監平朝臣押字トアリ。又弘安元年十月十二日授申越後左近大夫將監尊閤畢、此書至二十九卷捧說先畢、而十四十五先君御時回祿成孳＊、重以有書點之閒、越卷有訓說之故也ト淸原俊隆記セル等ヲ以テ見レハ、顯時ナリ。又嘉元德治中ノ識語ニ、從五位下或ハ正五位下行越後守貞顯ト記シ、或ハ某年某月書寫挍合畢、貞顯ト自識スル識語ニヨリテ、父子三世相ヒ繼テ、好學ナルコトヲ見ルヘシ。然トモ文庫經始ノコト見ル所ナシ。册本ハ、上杉安房守憲實管領タル日、置モノナラム〈憲實ハ、上杉民部大輔房方カ三男ナリ。憲基嗣ナシ。八歳ニシテ越後ヨリ鎌倉ニ至リ、其封ヲ襲キ、應永二十六年、關東管領トナリ、永享十年、領國上野ニ退居ス。十一年、管領職ヲ弟兵庫頭淸方ニ讓リテ、長棟庵主ト號ス。後諸國ヲ周流シ、周防ノ山口大寧寺ニ住ス。文正元年卒、年五十四、其子右京亮憲忠、寶德元年、職ヲ襲キテ管領トナリ、享德三年、害ニ遇フ。年二十二〉。故ニ金澤ノ印記アリテ跋語ナシ。後文庫ノ廢蕪ニ至ルハ、貞顯執權ヲ致シ、其子貞將戰沒ノ後、廢スルナルヘシ〈釋義堂（周信）カ空華集ニ、觀金澤文庫而作ノ詩ヲ載ス。其詩ニ、玉帳修文講武餘、遣人來覓舊藏書、牙籤映日窺科斗、■（糸偏稟）帙＊乘晴走蠹魚、圯上一編看不足、鄴侯三萬欲何如、照心古敎君家有、收在胸中壓五車トアリ。義堂ハ、相州崇福ニ住持ス。貞治康曆ノ閒ニアリ。貞顯致仕ヲ距ルコト三十餘年ナレハ、此詩崇福ニ住セサル以前ノ作ナリヤ、詳ニセス。文庫三閣アルヨシ、元亨三年、稱名寺ノ住僧湛睿カ結界作法圖ニ見エタリ。茲ニヨリテ考レハ、元來稱名寺ノ中ハ、文庫ヲ建ル所ト見ユ。又釋萬里（集九）カ梅花無盡藏ニ、文明龍集丙午十有八年小春二十有七己亥、進入金澤稱名寺ト見ユ。又太田持資カ慕京集ニ、二月釋菜、金澤文庫ニテ行ヨシ見エタリ。然ハ寺中ニテ緇流ノ徒、コノ禮ヲ主サトリ、修セルコトヽ見エタリ〉。再興ハ、應永二十六年、上杉憲實將軍持氏ノ管領トナリ、相州山內ニ邸ヲ搆ルトキ、復古セルナルヘシ。惜カナ、是亦往日ノ記載ナケレハ、其詳ナルコトヲ知ルヘカラス。鎌倉大草紙ニ、武州金澤ノ學校ハ、北條氏繁盛ノ日學問ノ所ナリ。野州足利學ハ〈大草紙、鎌倉志共ニ上州足利ニ作ル。今改正ス〉、京鎌倉將軍家ノ稱呼ニ係ルヲ以テ其學ヲ再興シ、文籍ヲ異域ニ捜索シテ收ムト云フ。是故ニ、兩學宋槧ノ書ハ、皆憲實ノ置モノナルヘシ。再ヒ廢スルハ、憲實ノ子憲忠、結城成朝等カ爲ニ害ニ遇シ後、廢スルナルヘシ〈按ニ、前ノ如ク、文明ノ比マテハ、浮屠氏釋菜ノ禮ヲ修シテ、其庫ノ廢頽ニ至ラサルヲ見ルヘシ〉。北條氏ノ事詳ナラス。其槪略ヲ附記シテ、金澤本ノ考證ニ備フト云。
北條越後守平實時ハ、右京權大夫義時カ孫、陸奧五郞實泰カ男ナリ。曆仁元年三月十八日任掃部助宣陽明院藏人、建長五年二月加評定、七年十二月十三日任越後守、康元三年四月爲三番引付眾頭、文永元年六月十六日爲二番頭、十月二十五日爲越訴奉行、二年六月二十七日敍從五位上、四年四月辭越訴奉行、十年六月二十五日爲一番頭、建治元年五月依所勞籠居六浦、二年十月二十三日卒於六浦別業、年五十三〈關東評定傳〉。其子左近大夫將監顯時、弘安元年二月加評定、三年十一月任越後守、四年十月爲四番引付眾頭〈同上〉。其子貞顯、乾元元年中務大輔、七月二十六日入洛住南方、號金澤大輔、德治元年越後守、延慶二年正月十七日下著鎌倉、三年左馬權頭、正和元年武藏守、四年七月十一日合判事、元亨二年修理權大夫、正中元年修理大夫、嘉曆元年二月執權、四月二十六日出家〈執權記〉。〈本朝通鑑、三月十三日執權。東鑑、四月十六日出家、號金澤殿。本朝通鑑、四月朔日號崇顯、退居於金澤。案ニ、羣書治要卷二十九嘉元四年二月跋ニ、從五位上行越後守平朝臣貞顯ト署セリ。嘉元中越後守ニ任スルコト、見ルヘシ。又卷十四德治二年正月跋ニ從五位上ト署シ、二月跋ニ正五位下ト署ス。德治二年二月正五位下ニ敍セラルヽコト、跋語ニヨリテ證スヘシ。〉

Literal_English_Translation:
Hōjō Echigo-no-kami Taira no Sanetoki was a grandson of Yoshitoki, Ukyō-gon-no-daibu, and a son of Mutsu-gorō Sanayasu.
- Rekinin 1 (1238), 3rd month, 18th day: appointed Kamon-no-suke and Sen'yōmon'in kurōdo.
- Kenchō 5 (1253), 2nd month: added to the Council of State (Hyōjō).
- Year 7 [as written], 12th month, 13th day: appointed Echigo-no-kami.
- Kōgen 3 [as written], 4th month: became head of the Third Hikitsuke Council.
- Bun'ei 1 (1264), 6th month, 16th day: became head of the Second Council. 10th month, 25th day: became Esso magistrate (appeals).
- Year 2, 6th month, 27th day: raised to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper.
- Year 4, 4th month: resigned as Esso magistrate.
- Year 10, 6th month, 25th day: became head of the First Council.
- Kenji 1 (1275), 5th month: because of illness, he went into seclusion at Mutsura.
- Year 2, 10th month, 23rd day: died at his villa at Mutsura, aged 53. [Source: *Kantō Hyōjōden*]

His son, Sakon-taifu Shōgen Akitoki:
- Kōan 1 (1278), 2nd month: added to the Council of State.
- Year 3, 11th month: appointed Echigo-no-kami.
- Year 4, 10th month: became head of the Fourth Hikitsuke Council. [Same source]

His son Sadaaki:
- Kengen 1 (1302): Nakatsukasa-no-taifu. 7th month, 26th day: entered the capital and lived in the Southern Office (Rokuhara Minamikata); styled "Kanazawa Taifu."
- Tokuji 1 (1306): Echigo-no-kami.
- Enkyō 2 (1309), 1st month, 17th day: arrived in Kamakura.
- Year 3: Sama-gon-no-kami.
- Shōwa 1 (1312): Musashi-no-kami.
- Year 4 (1315), 7th month, 11th day: took part in joint adjudication (gōhan).
- Genkō 2 (1322): Shuri-gon-no-daibu.
- Shōchū 1 (1324): Shuri-daibu.
- Karyaku 1 (1326), 2nd month: Shikken (Regent). 4th month, 26th day: took Buddhist vows. [Sources: *Shikken-ki*, *Honchō Tsugan*]

Notes in small print:
- *Honchō Tsugan* gives the 3rd month, 13th day for his becoming Shikken.
- *Azuma Kagami* gives the 4th month, 16th day for his taking vows, under the name "Kanazawa-dono."
- *Honchō Tsugan* says that on the 1st day of the 4th month he took the name Sūken and retired to Kanazawa.
- Compiler's remark: the colophon of vol. 29 of the *Gunsho Chiyō*, dated the 2nd month of Kagen 4 (1306), is signed "Junior Fifth Rank Upper, acting Echigo-no-kami, Taira no Ason Sadaaki." One can see from this that he was appointed Echigo-no-kami during the Kagen era.
- Likewise, the colophon of vol. 14, dated the 1st month of Tokuji 2 (1307), is signed "Junior Fifth Rank Upper," while the one dated the 2nd month is signed "Senior Fifth Rank Lower." His promotion to Senior Fifth Lower in the 2nd month of Tokuji 2 can be confirmed from the colophon wording.
Summary:
This passage is not a record of book movement or acquisition. It gives the official careers of three Hōjō/Kanazawa figures (Sanetoki, Akitoki and Sadaaki) and cites Sadaaki's signed colophons on the *Gunsho Chiyō* volumes (1306 and 1307) as evidence for dating his appointment as Echigo-no-kami and his promotion in rank.

Volume_Info: 御文庫ノ設ハ／（三擡）東照大君（德川家康）、駿府御在城ノ時ニ始マル。林道春信勝（羅山）、ソノ管鑰ヲ掌トルコト、載テソノ年譜ニ見ユ。慶長十九年七月、駿府ヨリ／（三擡）台德大君（德川秀忠）ニ御書籍三十部ヲ賜フ。コノ時ニ、道春ト與安法印宗哲ト、連署ノ書アリ。江戸ヨリモ、永喜（林東舟）ト閑齋法印トノ答簡アリ。是ヲモテ考フレハ、與安法印モマタ、道春ト共ニ典籍ヲ司トリシナルヘシ。當時江戸御文庫ノコト、今詳ニシカタシ〈永喜、初名ハ信澄。道春ノ弟ニシテ江城ニ奉仕ス。與安、名ハ宗哲。醫ヲモテ駿府ニ奉仕ス。閑齋ノ履歷、詳ナラス〉。抑慶長元和ノ閒、四方多事ノ日ニ當リテ廣ク典籍ヲ蒐メ、駿府官庫ニ藏メテ、稽古右文ノ用ニ備ヘタマフ。元和二年／（三擡）東照大君薨去ノ後、道春　遺命ヲ奉シテ、（德川）義直卿、（德川）賴宣卿、（德川）賴房卿ニ分チ、日本ノ舊記オヨヒ希世ノ書ハ、江戸ノ御文庫ニ收メシヨシ、信勝カ年譜、駿府日記等ニ載ス。コレヨリ駿府御文庫ハ遂ニ廢シヌ。今御文庫ニ存スル道春ノ御本日記ハ、コノ時ノ目錄ナルニヤ、明據ナシ。寬永十年十二月二十日、奧向勤仕關兵三郞（正成）〈ノチ兵左衞門ト改ム〉、御納戸星合豬左衞門（具枚）、大御番三雲內記（成賢）、西尾加右衞門（正保）ヲモテ、始メテ御書物奉行ニ　命セラル。コレ司籍ノ官ヲ置ル權輿ナリ〈始メテ奉行ヲ　命セラレヽ＊ヲモテ書ス。ソノ餘ハ後ノ履歷ノ條ニ詳ナレハ記セス。モシソノ異常ノ者アレハ特書ス〉。
Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案スルニ、豬左衞門等カ家譜ニ云フ、寬永十三年丙子／（三擡）仙洞御所ヨリ律令ノ書ヲ求メ給フ。松平伊豆守（信綱）　旨ヲ奉シ、十月鎌倉ノ建長寺、圓覺寺ノ西堂オヨヒ緇徒二十餘人ヲ江戸ノ海禪寺ニ招キ、金澤文庫ノ律令ヲ書寫セシメラレ、林道春（羅山）、林永喜（東舟）コレヲ挍正シ、豬左衞門等ソノ事ヲ奉行ス。マタ十八年庚辰、太田備中守（資宗）　旨ヲ奉シテ、諸家ノ系圖ヲ撰フ。豬左衞門等、ソノ席ノ奉行タリト云フ。今採錄シテ考據ニ備フ。
Literal_English_Translation:
- 謹案スルニ: "Respectfully considering / I humbly note that…"
- 豬左衞門等カ家譜ニ云フ: "The genealogical record of the family of Inozaemon and others says:" (the reading of the name 豬左衞門 is uncertain, so it is given as written.)
- 寬永十三年丙子: "In the 13th year of Kan'ei, the hinoe-ne (bingzi) year [1636],"
- （三擡）仙洞御所ヨリ律令ノ書ヲ求メ給フ: "[three-level raised-line honorific] from the Sentō Gosho (the Retired Emperor's palace), books of the ritsuryō (legal codes) were requested."
- 松平伊豆守（信綱）旨ヲ奉シ: "Matsudaira Izu-no-kami (Nobutsuna), receiving the directive,"
- 十月鎌倉ノ建長寺、圓覺寺ノ西堂オヨヒ緇徒二十餘人ヲ江戸ノ海禪寺ニ招キ: "in the tenth month summoned the senior monks (seidō) of Kenchōji and Engakuji in Kamakura, together with some twenty-odd black-robed monks, to Kaizenji in Edo,"
- 金澤文庫ノ律令ヲ書寫セシメラレ: "and had them transcribe the ritsuryō of the Kanazawa Bunko."
- 林道春（羅山）、林永喜（東舟）コレヲ挍正シ: "Hayashi Dōshun (Razan) and Hayashi Eiki (Tōshū) collated and corrected it,"
- 豬左衞門等ソノ事ヲ奉行ス: "and Inozaemon and others administered the matter as officials in charge."
- マタ十八年庚辰: "Again, in the 18th year [of Kan'ei], the kanoe-tatsu (gengchen) year [1641],"
- 太田備中守（資宗）旨ヲ奉シテ: "Ōta Bitchū-no-kami (Sukemune), receiving the directive,"
- 諸家ノ系圖ヲ撰フ: "compiled the genealogies of the various houses."
- 豬左衞門等、ソノ席ノ奉行タリト云フ: "Inozaemon and others are said to have been the officials in charge of that session."
- 今採錄シテ考據ニ備フ: "Now I have selected and recorded this, to provide for reference and evidence."
Summary:
According to the family record of Inozaemon and others, in 1636 the Retired Emperor's request for ritsuryō books led Matsudaira Nobutsuna to have Kamakura monks transcribe the Kanazawa Bunko ritsuryō manuscripts at Kaizenji in Edo, with the Hayashi scholars collating the copy and Inozaemon's family administering the work, after which the family was also involved in the 1641 compilation of the daimyo genealogies.

Volume_Info: 北宋槧本。端洪元年秦奭等カ表文アリ。廟諱ノ字缺筆セリ。密行疏字、字格楷正ナリ。卷三、卷四、卷六、卷十一ニ、僧圓種朱點ヲ加ル識語アリ。其卷六ニ、嘉元二年甲辰卯月二十二日、拭老眼粗加朱點畢、佛子圓種流年六旬ト記セリ。餘卷點ヲ施サス。　本邦ニ傳リテ尙五百年ノ書也。久シク散落シテ殘闕セシカ、各所ノ寺院、民家等ヨリ出ルヲ聚テ全本トス。林大學頭衡（述齋）獻言シ、享和三年二月、御庫ニ收ム。金澤文庫ノ印記アリ。歸源ノ印記、鎌倉圓光寺＊ノ子院、歸源院ノ藏印ナリ。此書、舊ト金澤文庫ヨリ散シテ浮屠氏ノ收藏トナリシニヤ、亦浮屠氏ノ本金澤ニ入レルニヤ、共ニ知ルヘカラス。金澤文庫ノ印記、各卷ニ散見ス。是ヨリ後、金澤文庫本ト云モノ、復印記ヲ錄セス。餘コレニ倣フ。
金澤文庫ノ收藏。軸本ニシテ、淸家ノ古譯本ナリ。每卷ノ後ニ、仁平、久壽ヨリ建長ニ至リテ、識語ノ摹アリ。又文應、弘長、文永、弘安、嘉元中、淸原博士以家說授越後守ノ識語及ヒ、應永中、釋怡於相之醉醒軒一覽セルノ識語アリ。初メ駿府御文庫ニ收メラレ、後今ノ御庫ニ收メラル。林信勝（羅山）カ御本日記ニ、此名ヲ列ス。御本日記ハ、駿府御文庫ノ書目ナリ。今其中ニアルモノハ、每每コレヲ書シテ、其書ノ傳來ヲ明ス。
仁治、弘長、正安、延慶年閒、明經博士淸原家古譯ノ書ヲ原本トシ、嘉曆二年釋禪澄、加州白山八幡院玉泉坊ニ書スルノ識語、第一、第二、第三、第八、第九ニアリ。其第九ニ、嘉曆三年九月十八日、於燈下亥刻書之畢、筆者禪澄押字、同夜與霄、莫加＊朱墨點了、此編爲硏幼童之愚眼、先挑五常之燈、寄庄老＊之敎誨、令滯釋門之規矩矣トアリ。

元大德九年ノ刊本ニシテ、應德、保安、保元、壽永、建長、弘安、文安年閒古博士識語ノ摹アリ。壽永ノ識語ニ、壽永二年夾鐘二十一日、以說授猶子隆才子、于時夜雨新霽、今日朝覲之行幸也、人皆觀輦路、予獨畱文窗矣、散位敦經トアリ。件ノ本ヲ以テ、大永元年十月二日加點ト、卷三十ノ後ニ記セリ。又文永六年二月十四日天子御讀畢云云、以件天龍寺本加點、于時享祿三年五月二十日都督郞ト記セリ。駿府御文庫本ニシテ、御本日記ニ記セル、前後漢書七十册トアルモノ、是ナリ。

Exact_Provenance_Language_JP: 謹案ニ、羣書治要、唐書藝文志雜家ニ入ル。宋史ヨリ以下其書ヲ逸ス。又諸家ノ書目ニ見ル所ナシ。三代實錄貞觀十七年、先是天皇讀羣書治要、至是講竟トアレハ、此書、彼ニ佚シテ我ニ傳フルコト、久シキヲ知ルヘシ。
Literal_English_Translation:
謹案ニ (Respectfully, I note / In my humble opinion:)
羣書治要、 (the *Qunshu zhiyao* [*Gunsho chiyō*],)
唐書藝文志雜家ニ入ル。 (is entered under the "Miscellaneous Schools" (zakka) category in the Bibliographic Treatise [Yiwenzhi] of the *Tang shu*.)
宋史ヨリ以下 (From the *Song shi* onward,)
其書ヲ逸ス。 (this book is lost.)
又 (Moreover,)
諸家ノ書目ニ見ル所ナシ。 (there is nowhere it appears in the catalogues of the various [bibliographers/collectors].)
三代實錄貞觀十七年、 (In the *Sandai jitsuroku*, the 17th year of Jōgan [875],)
先是天皇讀羣書治要、 (it says: "Previously the Emperor had been reading the *Gunsho chiyō*,)
至是講竟トアレハ、 (and at this time the lectures were completed"; since it says this,)
此書、 (this book,)
彼ニ佚シテ (having been lost in that country [China],)
我ニ傳フルコト、 (its being transmitted in ours [Japan],)
久シキヲ知ルヘシ。 (one should know has been [the case] for a long time.)
Summary:
The annotator argues that the *Gunsho chiyō*, which disappeared in China after the Song period and is absent from later bibliographies, must have been transmitted to and preserved in Japan since long before, as shown by the *Sandai jitsuroku*'s record that the Emperor finished a lecture course on it in Jōgan 17 (875).

北條越後守（實時）、武州久良郡六浦庄金澤ニ文庫ヲ建テ、和漢ノ書ヲ收儲シ金澤文庫ノ印記ヲ蹈ス〈金澤ノ稱名寺、其遺蹤ナルヲ以テ稱名寺文庫トモ云フ〉。一ニ越後守實時カ建ル所ナリト云ヒ、一ニ其子顯時カ建ル所ナリト云フ。又ハ其子貞顯カ建ル所ナリト云フ。當時ノ記載、徵スヘキモノ無ケレハ、其然否ヲ必トセス。今其儲藏ヲ以テ考ルニ、卷子本アリ、册本アリ。官ニ收スル卷本左傳、羣書治要、令義解、本朝文粹＊等ノ識語ニ、弘長、文永、建治中書寫挍合畢、越州剌史＊押字ト記スルハ、實時カ自記スル也。羣書治要卷二十九ノ識語ニ、嘉元四年二月二十八日以右大辨三位經雄卿本書寫點挍畢、此書祖父越州之時被終一部之功處、後年少少紛失、仍書加之而已、從五位上行越後守平貞顯ト自記セルヲ以テ考フレハ、實時ナルコトヲ知ルヘシ。又左傳卷十四ノ識語ニ、弘安元年九月二十二日以音博士俊隆眞人之本書寫點挍畢、從五位下行左近衞將監平朝臣押字トアリ。又弘安元年十月十二日授申越後左近大夫將監尊閤畢、此書至二十九卷捧說先畢、而十四十五先君御時回祿成孳＊、重以有書點之閒、越卷有訓說之故也ト淸原俊隆記セル等ヲ以テ見レハ、顯時ナリ。又嘉元德治中ノ識語ニ、從五位下或ハ正五位下行越後守貞顯ト記シ、或ハ某年某月書寫挍合畢、貞顯ト自識スル識語ニヨリテ、父子三世相ヒ繼テ、好學ナルコトヲ見ルヘシ。然トモ文庫經始ノコト見ル所ナシ。册本ハ、上杉安房守憲實管領タル日、置モノナラム〈憲實ハ、上杉民部大輔房方カ三男ナリ。憲基嗣ナシ。八歳ニシテ越後ヨリ鎌倉ニ至リ、其封ヲ襲キ、應永二十六年、關東管領トナリ、永享十年、領國上野ニ退居ス。十一年、管領職ヲ弟兵庫頭淸方ニ讓リテ、長棟庵主ト號ス。後諸國ヲ周流シ、周防ノ山口大寧寺ニ住ス。文正元年卒、年五十四、其子右京亮憲忠、寶德元年、職ヲ襲キテ管領トナリ、享德三年、害ニ遇フ。年二十二〉。故ニ金澤ノ印記アリテ跋語ナシ。後文庫ノ廢蕪ニ至ルハ、貞顯執權ヲ致シ、其子貞將戰沒ノ後、廢スルナルヘシ〈釋義堂（周信）カ空華集ニ、觀金澤文庫而作ノ詩ヲ載ス。其詩ニ、玉帳修文講武餘、遣人來覓舊藏書、牙籤映日窺科斗、■（糸偏稟）帙＊乘晴走蠹魚、圯上一編看不足、鄴侯三萬欲何如、照心古敎君家有、收在胸中壓五車トアリ。義堂ハ、相州崇福ニ住持ス。貞治康曆ノ閒ニアリ。貞顯致仕ヲ距ルコト三十餘年ナレハ、此詩崇福ニ住セサル以前ノ作ナリヤ、詳ニセス。文庫三閣アルヨシ、元亨三年、稱名寺ノ住僧湛睿カ結界作法圖ニ見エタリ。茲ニヨリテ考レハ、元來稱名寺ノ中ハ、文庫ヲ建ル所ト見ユ。又釋萬里（集九）カ梅花無盡藏ニ、文明龍集丙午十有八年小春二十有七己亥、進入金澤稱名寺ト見ユ。又太田持資カ慕京集ニ、二月釋菜、金澤文庫ニテ行ヨシ見エタリ。然ハ寺中ニテ緇流ノ徒、コノ禮ヲ主サトリ、修セルコトヽ見エタリ〉。再興ハ、應永二十六年、上杉憲實將軍持氏ノ管領トナリ、相州山內ニ邸ヲ搆ルトキ、復古セルナルヘシ。惜カナ、是亦往日ノ記載ナケレハ、其詳ナルコトヲ知ルヘカラス。鎌倉大草紙ニ、武州金澤ノ學校ハ、北條氏繁盛ノ日學問ノ所ナリ。野州足利學ハ〈大草紙、鎌倉志共ニ上州足利ニ作ル。今改正ス〉、京鎌倉將軍家ノ稱呼ニ係ルヲ以テ其學ヲ再興シ、文籍ヲ異域ニ捜索シテ收ムト云フ。是故ニ、兩學宋槧ノ書ハ、皆憲實ノ置モノナルヘシ。再ヒ廢スルハ、憲實ノ子憲忠、結城成朝等カ爲ニ害ニ遇シ後、廢スルナルヘシ〈按ニ、前ノ如ク、文明ノ比マテハ、浮屠氏釋菜ノ禮ヲ修シテ、其庫ノ廢頽ニ至ラサルヲ見ルヘシ〉。北條氏ノ事詳ナラス。其槪略ヲ附記シテ、金澤本ノ考證ニ備フト云。

Literal_English_Translation:
Hōjō Echigo-no-kami Taira no Sanetoki was a grandson of Udaikyō-gon-no-daibu Yoshitoki and a son of Mutsu Gorō Sanyasu [Sanetaru]. / In Ryakunin 1 (1238), 3rd month, 18th day, he was appointed Kamon-no-suke and kurōdo of Senyōin. / In Kenchō 5 (1253), 2nd month, he was added to the Hyōjō (Council of State). / In Kenchō 7, 12th month, 13th day, he was appointed Echigo-no-kami. / In "Kōgen 3," 4th month, he became head of the Third Hikitsuke (Judicial Section). / In Bun'ei 1 (1264), 6th month, 16th day, he became head of the Second Section. / 10th month, 25th day, he became Ossо Bugyō (magistrate for appeals). / In year 2, 6th month, 27th day, he was raised to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade. / In year 4, 4th month, he resigned as Ossо Bugyō. / In year 10, 6th month, 25th day, he became head of the First Section. / In Kenji 1 (1275), 5th month, because of illness, he went into seclusion at Mutsuura. / In year 2, 10th month, 23rd day, he died at his villa in Mutsuura, aged 53 (from the *Kantō Hyōjōden*).

His son, Sakon-taifu Shōgen Akitoki: in Kōan 1 (1278), 2nd month, he was added to the Hyōjō. / In year 3, 11th month, he was appointed Echigo-no-kami. / In year 4, 10th month, he became head of the Fourth Hikitsuke (same source).

His son Sadaaki: in Kengen 1 (1302), he became Nakatsukasa-no-taifu. / On the 26th day of the 7th month he entered Kyoto and lived at the southern Rokuhara office, and was called "Kanazawa Taifu." / In Tokuji 1 (1306), he became Echigo-no-kami. / In Enkyō 2 (1309), 1st month, 17th day, he arrived in Kamakura. / In year 3, he became Sama-gon-no-kami. / In Shōwa 1 (1312), Musashi-no-kami. / In year 4, 7th month, 11th day, he joined in judgments (gōhan). / In Genkō 2 (1322), Shuri-gon-no-daibu. / In Shōchū 1 (1324), Shuri-no-daibu. / In Karyaku 1 (1326), 2nd month, he became Shikken (Regent). / On the 26th day of the 4th month he took the tonsure. (Sources: *Shikkenki* and *Honchō Tsugan*: "3rd month, 13th day, became Shikken." *Azuma Kagami*: "4th month, 16th day, took the tonsure and was called Kanazawa-dono." *Honchō Tsugan*: "4th month, 1st day, took the name Sūken and retired to Kanazawa.")

Note ("An"): The colophon of *Gunsho Chiyō*, vol. 29, dated Kagen 4 (1306), 2nd month, is signed "Junior Fifth Rank Upper, acting Echigo-no-kami, Taira no Ason Sadaaki." One should see from this that he was appointed Echigo-no-kami during the Kagen era. Again, the colophon of vol. 14, dated Tokuji 2 (1307), 1st month, is signed "Junior Fifth Rank Upper," while the 2nd-month colophon is signed "Senior Fifth Rank Lower." That he was raised to Senior Fifth Lower in Tokuji 2, 2nd month, can be verified from the colophon wording.
Summary:
This passage is not a record of a book's movement or acquisition but a biographical genealogy of the Kanazawa Hōjō line (Sanetoki, Akitoki, Sadaaki), whose only book-related content is the editor's use of Sadaaki's signed colophons on *Gunsho Chiyō* vols. 29 and 14 (1306–1307) to confirm his Echigo-no-kami appointment and his promotion to Senior Fifth Lower.
